name: Phoenix of the Volcano EX1
description: Out of the Caldera

name: Patrol the Plain
description:
Rayas has been ordered to patrol the Isliid Plain. 
Monsters have been increasing lately!

name: An Unexpected Visitor
description: A certain someone showed up when Rayas was exploring the plains...

name: An Unsettling Image
description: Rayas finds something unexpected in the far reaches of Isliid Plain...

name: Follow Valzandes!
description:
Something huge is heading toward Reigrad. 
The city is in peril. Hurry!

name: Rayas' Resolve
description:
Rayas continues his pursuit. 
Can he handle this alone?

name: A Frantic Morning
description:
Rayas is worried about Iris.
Hurry and get the supply you were told to!

name: Follow Liese
description:
Rayas heads to support Liese.
However, he is curious about Iris.

name: At the Fire Mountaincat
description:
Now Rayas is headed toward Sophie.
Ask about where Iris went.

name: Sensitive Iris
description:
Rayas is looking for clues of Iris.
Now, head to Giliam for more information!

name: What Iris Found!
description:
Look for Rem.
Maybe she might now something about Iris.

name: Curiosity Killed the Cat
description:
Iris must be here.
Now let's find out the truth.

name: Dangerous request
description:
Orders from the Adventurer's Guild is very dangerous.
Still, the two head to the ruins.

name: Head in the Clouds
description: Rayas is excited to investigate the ruins. But Iris has her head in the clouds…

name: About Tiny Things
description:
Iris seems to be acting a bit strange.
Rayas asks her if she's doing alright.

name: Inside the Cave
description:
The two arrived at the cave inside the ancient shrine.
But there seems to be an unexpected guest…

name: To Protect, to be Protected
description:
What is in the depth of the ancient shrine?
And where does Rayas and Iris's heart lie?

name: The Day the Seal Broke
description: Ragsherum appears, though he should be banished. Has Rayas returned to the world of the past?

name: To Revive the Lords
description: Ragsherum, released from the seal, gathers his strength to revive his lord and return the Demons to power.

name: The Demons Gather
description: Ragsherum is not the only demon to have returned.  He makes contact with some subordinates.

name: Commander comes to Gormarey
description: With Gormarey as a base, the demons gathered around Ragsherum begin to act.

name: The Masterless Dragon
description: With the terrifying dragon under his control, a calm smile comes to his face.

name: Rampage on the Twin Isles EX1
description: Landshaker

name: Submerged Remnants EX1
description: Protocol Activation

name: Phoenix of the Volcano EX2
description: Bird of Fierce Blazes

name: The Guild Entrance Exam
description:
The Guild Entrance Exam begins!
Defeat the monsters and show Ganan your stuff!

name: Hurry to the Plains
description: Lute's mom's in trouble! Hurry to the Isliid Plains!

name: Ganan's Guidance
description: After a nice lunch, it's time for some training.

name: The Little Adventurer
description: Rayas and Lute make it to the plains. There, they have a little adventure.

name: The Boy Adventurers
description: Help set up the Boy Adventurers' hideout. First, make sure the area's safe!

name: Keep It Secret
description: [The Boy Adventurers 2] Rayas reaches the hidden place. It's perfect for a hideout!

name: Danger Comes to the Plain
description: [The Boy Adventurers 3] Rayas reaches the enormous footprints. Could this presence be...?

name: The Journey Begins
description: Rayas' journey has begun, but the blazing hot volcanic cavern might kill his enthusiasm.

name: The Masters of the Cave
description: Fire monsters infest the cave. The heat and the monsters are both dangerous enemies.

name: Deeper into the Cave
description: The end of the cave is still out of sight. The enemies are getting stronger. Best stay on guard!

name: The Gobl Nest
description:
Deeper in the cave, Gobls grow numerous. 
Their nest must be near...

name: The Flame Beast
description:
The exit is in sight!
But a beast of flame blocks your way.

name: The Frozen Wastes
description: The path to the Demonseal Tower leads through frigid tundra. Rayas must press on through the snow.

name: Neither Snow Nor Monsters
description: Rayas keeps on, defeating Water-element wielding enemies every step. His resolve never freezes!

name: Blizzard Battle
description: Rayas' fever for adventure warms him in wind and snow, but his enemies strengthen with every step.

name: The Fishman's Garden
description:
Even a blizzard isn't safe from vicious sardines!
The frigid snowfield is a paradise to fishmen.

name: The Tundra's Edge
description: The weary, freezing journey continues, but now a fierce warrior blocks the way.

name: Deep in the Brilliant Green
description:
Beyond the tundra lies a beautiful forest,
but the green shadows hide vicious foes!

name: A Place of Spirits
description:
They say sneaky spirits love the deep woods.
Proceed with caution, lest they turn on you!

name: Conquer the Mossy Trail
description:
Even at midday, the forest stays dim. At times,
beasts howl in the distance but remain hidden from view.

name: A Hungry Thief
description: They say there's a thief who preys on adventurers in the woods. Be quick and turn the tables!

name: An Ominous Aura
description: The chase leads our heroes down narrow trails. The human bones scattered around offer mute warning.

name: Ancient Ruins
description: The Tower has come into faint view beyond the snow, but ancient ruins stand in the way.

name: Guardians of the Stones
description:
Stone enemies appear in the ruins. 
Perhaps they are guardians from ancient days?

name: The Winged Horse Neighs
description: Passing through the white-horse guarded ruins, the neighing of a huge winged horse overpowers Rayas.

name: Another Visitor
description:
Someone else is in these ruins. 
Follow the footprints!

name: Enter the Lady Knight
description: The footprints lead through a gargantuan gate. It looks dangerous to continue...

name: Rain-Swept Fortress
description:
Mira leads the party to Fort Goldoa.
The tower is in plain sight--the goal is near!

name: Nest of the Vampire Bats
description: Red eyes gleam in the dark. The fortress has become the lair of bloodthirsty bats!

name: Blind Battle
description: The party proceeds through the darkened fortress. But where has Ru gotten to?

name: The Skeleton Band
description: Perhaps victims of a forgotten battle, skeletons swarm the area. Proceed with caution!

name: The Necromancer
description: The party finally conquers the skeletons. Now, they sense the power behind the walking dead.

name: An Adventurer Grows Up
description: Rayas goes to check out Fort Goldoa with Ganan. It's a great chance to show his progress!

name: Various Rewards
description: [An Adventurer Grows Up 2] Ganan gives Rayas the lead, but he makes his opinions clear. It feels like the entrance exam all over again!

name: The Demonseal Tower
description: The party reaches their goal, but something's wrong with Iris. It'd be best to finish up quickly!

name: The Monsters of the Tower
description:
The party presses on while dodging traps. The enemies are few but stronger than every before.
Stay sharp!

name: Through the Miasma
description: This should be the middle of the tower. It's as if some ominous presence is disorienting everyone...

name: The Guardians of the Tower
description: Further up the tower, the enemies grow even more powerful. What could lie ahead?

name: What Awaits at the Top
description:
This enemy is far beyond any that came before. 
Rayas breaks out in a cold sweat.

name: Rampage on the Twin Isles EX2
description: Furious Blue Titan

name: Submerged Remnants EX2
description: Sanctuary Defender

name: Phoenix of the Volcano EX3
description: Scorching Cradle

name: Through the Hot Sands
description:
Rayas begins a journey through a new land.
It starts with the Dara Desert.

name: Fierce Desert Fight
description: The creatures of the parched heat are fearsome. Keep your guard up!

name: Attack of the Beasts
description: Beasts of flame come tearing through the burning air. Their spears are sharp and forgive no carelessness!

name: The Scorching Fist
description: The party has passed the desert's midpoint, but their trouble is not over. New enemies await!

name: Princess of the Flaming Axe
description: The harsh desert is almost behind them, but the harshest fight still remains!

name: Paradise of Water and Light
description: The ocean breezes are soothing on the party's burnt bodies. Now, they set sight on the Coroc Road.

name: Fishmen of the Sea
description: The fishmen from the tundra make another appearance. Clearly, they're more powerful in water than snow...

name: The Beautiful Seaside
description: A walk on the beach... It appears the Gramenian soldiers have left this lovely seashore.

name: Gunner of the Waters
description: As the end of the beach, a single gunman comes into view. He looks mighty confident...

name: The Master Tactician
description: The Gramenians didn't show up on the Sadahl Coast. Perhaps they gave up?

name: Path of the Great Trees
description: Beyond the coast was a peculiar path born of the great trees. It awakens Rayas' adventurous spirit.

name: A Dangerous Road
description:
The idyllic scenery belies the danger at every turn.
Be ready for surprise attacks!

name: Within the Tunnel
description: Progress down this natural roadway is difficult. Attacks can come from anywhere.

name: Heavy Troops Await
description: This lone path is lined with perfectly outfitted heavy troops. For a simple route, it's certainly dangerous.

name: Battle in the Treetops
description: The final great tree is in sight. It's the end of the road, but the air is thick with enemies...

name: On the Road Again
description: Rayas returns to Coroc Road to escort a client. Stay sharp and keep going!

name: The Ecosystem of the Road
description: [On the Road Again 2] The two walk happily down the road. But they'd best watch their feet!

name: The End of the Road
description: [On the Road Again 3] The end of the road is near. Was it a good trip?

name: The Waste of Whirling Sand
description:
After the Coroc Road, the party enters a wasteland of whirling sand.
They hear monsters howling in the distance.

name: Foes in the Sandstorm
description:
The flying sand scatters the sunlight.
The mystical veil of light hides dangers beyond.

name: Traverse the Desert
description: They approach the middle of the wasteland. Hopefully they make it through without incident...

name: The Hunter's Shot
description: They say great hunters stalk this land. It's easy to stand out, so choose your path carefully...

name: Goliath of the Wastes
description: The journey through the wasteland continues, but they hear bloodcurdling howls from somewhere...

name: Marsh of Thunder
description: It looks like Mira and Fen have gained some mutual respect. Time to get through this marsh and reach the tower!

name: Dragon Troops in the Dark
description: This battlefield is cruel. Along with mud, the rain cuts visibility. The harsh fighting never ends...

name: Endless Rain
description: The rain never ends in this marsh. Perhaps even the heroes of old felt this rain on their shoulders.

name: A Flash in the Dark
description: Suddenly, a tree explodes with lightning before your eyes. An act of nature, or evil magic?

name: Warrior of the Marsh
description: A sharp spirit fills the marsh like the sound of thunder. An extraordinary enemy awaits.

name: The Second Tower
description: The tower appears out of the thunderclouds. It exudes an overpowering aura of silent calm.

name: Beyond Endless Corridors
description: The massive corridors continue on. Their seamless design creates the illusion of infinity.

name: A Creeping Menace
description: It feels like they've come far, but the path leads ever onward. Is Iris OK?

name: Machine-gun Girl of the Skies
description: This girl wields a weapon of mass slaughter. The bizarre sight sends a chill down the spine.

name: An Ominous Presence
description: The menacing aura from below grows stronger. Hurry to meet up with Fen!

name: Rampage on the Twin Isles EX3
description: Arms of Destruction

name: Submerged Remnants EX3
description: Inorganic Impulse

name: A Meeting with the Magician
description: On the way to Famelle, the party reaches a volcano. A line of shapes approach in the heat haze.

name: Conquer the Blazing Trail
description: Melia's words twist in the mind.  They lead the party astray on the path to the Beast King.

name: The Blazing Fist Returns
description: The Warrior of the Blazing Fists stages a comeback with two fists full of passion. It won't be easy getting past.

name: The Flamewyrm Field
description: After talking through everything, feelings are high. There's no hesitation in taking that next step.

name: The Truth of the Tremors
description: The party feels shaking as they traverse the rocky land. Something massive this way comes.

name: The Forgotten Ship
description: The party boards the ghost ship to gain Zeorg's aid. Unsettling creaks fill the air.

name: What's Behind Mira's Mood
description:
Iris pays no mind to the eerie surroundings.
Mira, on the other hand...

name: The Siren's Call
description: The Siren has a beautiful, if cursed, voice. They say she's even stolen the souls of some, twisting their bodies as well.

name: Border of the Netherworld
description: They proceed through the gloomy ship. At times they feel someone's gaze, and they have the sense they aren't alone here...

name: Pirates and Their Treasure
description: As the investigation ends, pirates show their ugly faces. Perhaps they heard rumors of treasure?

name: A Trap of Many Colors
description: The party enters a verdant forest of giant trees. Its beautiful scenery drips with deadly poison.

name: In the Shade
description: The monsters have prepared a rough welcome. It appears this poison-soaked primeval forest has a master...

name: The One-Eyed Giants
description: Cyclopes appear, trampling the trees underfoot. Shields offer no protection from their mighty arms.

name: Under Verdant Trees
description: The forest air is heavy with damp and heat. Fen's thoughts race, but his face shows no change.

name: Lady of the Forest
description: Fallen foes tell of a woman taming the beasts and ruling the forest. What beasts does she control?

name: A Magnificent Bedchamber
description: The Phoenix's Rest overflows with grandeur and beauty. It would be a lovely sight, if not for all the monsters...

name: The Legend of the Phoenix
description: There is a legend in Famelle saying all those who see the Phoenix will find luck. Could it be true?

name: Death from the Phoenix
description: It seems luck isn't all the great bird brings. With a shriek of wind from above, deadly talons descend.

name: Thunder Demon Swordsman
description: He rained down mighty blows from the moment he took up the sword. The air around him sparks with electricity.

name: Rematch with a Beast
description:
A heart-stopping aura fills the air. 
Grad is likely just ahead...

name: A Dazzling Den
description: Roy joins the party, and they set out for the Demonseal Tower. Before them, a mysterious light-filled cave overlooks the ravine.

name: Purifying Light
description: The light filling this cavern shines in brilliant colors. Could it be enchanting the monsters?

name: To Cast A Devilish Light
description: It appears Roy has some ideas about Fen. The mysterious light shines over his friend's face....

name: With Friends Like These
description:
Roy and Fen have worked things out.
Now to make up with Mira...

name: The End of the Cavern
description: The party spots daylight, but of course, nothing is that easy. What enemy awaits them?

name: The Third Tower
description: This tower hosts more monsters than any before. Clearly, investigating it won't be easy.

name: Defensive Enemies
description: The violence in this tower is unlike any before. There must be something important here!

name: The Trinity Torrent
description: An attack comes in an open hall. A trinity of Fire, Water and Earth falls on the party.

name: The Black Knight
description: The party barely dodges a blow from his greatsword. The blade is as black as night itself.

name: The Awaiting Mistress
description:
The crack of a whip breaks the silence.
The party must head to the top floor and settle things with Nier.

name: The Captured Royal Library
description: The sullying of this house of knowledge must not go unavenged! Defeat the monsters and free the library.

name: Battle in the Library
description:
Fighting indoors has its own challenges.
Best be careful of that fire magic!

name: Beyond the Sea of Insight
description: Proceed on between the ever-reaching bookcases. Could anyone ever read all of these books?

name: The Fallen Knight of Light
description: A splendid knight attacks. This duel with a possessed foe won't have a storybook ending!

name: No Light in Their Eyes
description: Fen seems pleased with the results of his investigation. Meanwhile, the party is being watched by inhuman eyes...

name: Where East Meets West
description: The party reaches the sand sea that divides the east from the west. Their target is yet another tower: Liima.

name: Survival of the Fittest
description: The heat of the sand sea plays no favorites. The bones scattered about show there are no exceptions.

name: The Blazing Sand Sea
description: The heat and heavy sand wear away the party's stamina. Iris' face starts showing the strain.

name: The Flame-Clad Fist
description: A blazing god of war awaits his targets. The rising haze of heat confuses the eye...

name: An End to the Sand Sea
description: The border of the wide sand sea is in sight. There don't appear to be any powerful foes--perhaps the worst is over.

name: The Mountains of Tribulation
description: It appears Zeorg has gone ahead. To distract from his irritation, he treads on thin ice...

name: Beyond the Blizzard
description: The party is tormented by the endless blizzard, but if Iris waits ahead, they can't stop.

name: Lurking in the White Gloom
description: The blizzard worsens near the peaks. Enemy attacks and perilous falls are equally dangerous!

name: A Pure White World
description: A burning passion fills the party's hearts. Not even the frigid air can cool it down!

name: Warrior of the Snowy Peak
description: It seems the trail has started to descend! Perhaps this frozen mountain range has an end after all.

name: Lake of Secrets
description: A hidden lake fills this cavern. The tranquil scenery is breathtaking.

name: Monsters of the Cavern Lake
description:
There is a dark aura in the otherworldly air.
This is no time to take in the scenery!

name: Journey to the Truth
description: The future is always uncertain. All they can do is keep going and hope that the truth awaits them at their destination.

name: Attack from the Dark
description: Great beasts leap out from the thickets ahead. Get ready for a fight!

name: The Master of Nomoris
description: The party has reached the very end of the cavern. Here they find the blades of the enemy!

name: Ruins of the Gods
description: The party follows Zeorg into an ancient ruin. It appears they're almost out of time.

name: Of Another Nature
description: With water on the ceiling and cubes moving through space, this place is not of our world.

name: Hunter of the Ruins
description: Deeper in the ruins, something feels off... Perhaps it's just the otherworldly nature of the place...

name: Guardian of the Ruins
description: Halfway through the ruins, Zeorg and Iris are nowhere to be found. The party's unease grows stronger.

name: The Crafty Warrior
description: The party spots familiar figures in the corridor. Iris and Zeorg are standing there...

name: The Flying Magic Fortress
description: When the falling light stops, a massive machine belching steam comes into view. Clearly, they've succeeded in activating it.

name: The Inhuman Garden
description: The fortress is filled with metal and machines. The party quickly realizes they don't belong...

name: The Magician Sneaks In
description: It's difficult to notice when enemies approach with the noisy machinery. Sneak attacks can come at any time!

name: Zeorg, the Hero
description: A face-off with Zeorg in the narrow hall. The time has come to settle just who is on the side of right.

name: Fortress of Suspicion and Treachery
description: The Hero has finally faced facts, but then alarms ring through the fortress.

name: The Fourth Tower, Liima
description: Iris says she feels a massive power from this tower, like none before. The party must find out what it is.

name: In the Quiet
description: It is dead silent inside the tower. Faint sunlight fills the desolate, empty hallways.

name: The Beastly Presence Grows
description: Iris won't say anything, but her face shows her fatigue. If only there was somewhere to rest...

name: Breaking Through Defense
description: They're almost there. Countless monsters are coming to mount the defense.

name: Confronting the Truth
description:
Beyond this door, everything may be revealed.
Everyone feels uneasy, but they still reach for the door.

name: Phoenix of the Volcano EX4
description: Sunset Wings

name: Storm the Demon Stronghold
description: The journey has finally reached the Demon stronghold. It is time to seize the future and defeat Ragsherum.

name: The Demon Lands
description: Thunder fills the air, and lava bubbles up from cracks in the earth, as if they were escaping from hell.

name: Attack of the Volcano Bird
description: The party follows the dim volcano trail. Suddenly, the low-hanging clouds are ripped by an attacking volcano bird!

name: Bursting Magma
description: Terrain, heat, monsters... The volcano hosts a triple threat. The slightest misstep could prove deadly.

name: The Flamewyrm's Howl
description: Suddenly, the blazing hellscape resounds with a roar. The volcano's master descends blazing to the quiet earth.

name: A World of Absolute Zero
description: A beautiful shrine of ice. Yet again, the party enters a region inimical to life.

name: Aging Spirit Sword Master
description: A white-haired swordsman appears in the icy corridor. His sword flows like water as he attacks!

name: Memories of War
description: It's as if time has stopped in the shrine. And so, perhaps, have the hopes of the Hero.

name: The Flash of the Ice Spear
description: The party reaches a wide hall. The master of the shrine lies in wait.

name: What Waits in the Depths
description: The exit from the shrine must be beyond this sanctuary hall. The party rushes forth, as if to outrun the cold.

name: Storm the Sea of Trees
description: Even without Roy, the party pushes through the trees, but their steps are slow, and words are few.

name: Advance in Despair
description: The party proceeds through the trees, fighting every step, but their movements lack spirit. Mira unleashes her rage...

name: Machine Guardians of Trees
description: The sound of motors is out of place in the deep forest. It appears machine troops are after the trespassers!

name: Demonic Tree Sea Spirit
description: Whispers can be heard from within the forest. Could it be evil spirits living in the trees?

name: Surrounded by Spirits
description:
The whispers grow louder and closer.
It appears the party is completely surrounded!

name: The Corridors of Dawn
description: The party's talk seems to have had some effect. They set off through the corridor with new resolve.

name: In Search of Clues
description: Iris says she remembers these ruins. In search of her memories, the two start exploring.

name: The True Will of the Gods
description: There is meaning in every structure, but the meaning of these ruins is beyond the ken of man.

name: Toward That Memory
description: In faint memories, it appears this ruin has some connection to Rayas, as well. Although this is his first visit...

name: The Old Ways
description: In search of more memories, the two keep exploring. Before their eyes, their greatest friend reappears.

name: The Black Gate
description: After searching the ruins, the party reaches the Black Gate. Beyond it lies Demon territory.

name: Signs of Pursuit
description: The party proceeds through the dark miasma, toward the castle. It appears someone is following them.

name: One Charge to End It
description: The party heads straight for the castle, avoiding Demon attacks. They have no time to stop.

name: The Soulless Girls
description: The girl from the library makes a reappearance, but this time, something's different...

name: The Serpent's Feast
description: Grad and Nier stand in the way, murder in their eyes. The time has come to end this dark bond!

name: Storming the Demon Castle
description: Now to defeat Ragsherum and stop the return of the Demon Lord. The party breaks into the castle, resolve in their hearts.

name: The Dark Land
description: The castle interior seems filled with manifested darkness. The party proceeds through the stifling atmosphere.

name: Return to the Ravaged Land
description: The party revisits a place already destroyed by the Corps. Has Roy made it back to the Isliid Empire?

name: The Master of the Castle
description: An unspeakable power emanates from beyond this ominous gate. The master of this castle lies ahead.

name: The Battle with Ragsherum
description: The battle for humanity's future has begun. Rayas must fight with all his body and soul and defeat Ragsherum.

name: To the Sealed Land
description: The party passes the dimensional warp and reaches the Sealed Land. It is filled with infinite stillness.

name: The Garden of Stillness
description: The Sealed Land is being thrown into instability. A mistake could cost everyone their lives here...

name: Warped Time and Space
description: The sense of time is becoming unclear. Even the flow of time is distorted here.

name: Signs of Gods and Demons
description: Iris guides the party through the Sealed Land. The time to settle things with Auge draws near.

name: Auge, the Demon Lord
description: Demon Lord Auge shows himself, clad in an aura of quiet death. This is the final battle.

name: Rampage on the Twin Isles EX4
description: Living Skyscraper

name: Submerged Remnants EX4
description: Lethal Program

name: Memories of the Desert
description: Rayas and Iris have arrived at Barmint. Their journey brings back memories of a trip long ago...

name: Footprints in the Red Sand
description: Walking through the never-ending desert, their lively banter knows no end, much like the sand stretching before them.

name: The Dune Continues
description: The steep slopes and heat can't stop these two, but violent enemies also stand in their way.

name: How's Our Friend Doing?
description:
As the hot desert wind burns their cheeks,
Rayas and Iris think about their friend, Roy.

name: The Figure Behind the Storm
description:
The two continue to trudge through the desert...
Who watches them from the stormy plains?

name: The Overflowing Temple
description:
The majestic scenery of Bamint welcomes them.
After the burning desert, it is a respite.

name: Unbreakable Silence
description: At the bank of the quiet sunken temple, Rayas and Iris discuss trouble brewing in lands afar.

name: The Decaying Shrine
description: They bask in the wealth of knowledge at the temple. Unfortunately, there is no time to enjoy it.

name: Monster in the Water
description:
Monsters quiently emerge from the quiet pond.
Be careful to take one step at a time.

name: The One Who Awaits
description: Someone awaits Rayas and Iris in the temple depths. Who are they, and what is their purpose?

name: Emerald Breeze of Summer
description: A gentle summer breeze blows through the trodden path. Quite the opportunity to ask Melia some questions...

name: A World Gripped by Conspiracy
description:
Rayas and Iris have a foreboding feeling after
Melia tells them of a shocking truth...

name: Evil in the Forest Shadows
description: Monsters appear by the riverbank alongside the path. Be very careful moving forward.

name: The True World Order
description:
Melia reveals the complex situation of the world...
What will be Mira's fate in this uncertain time?

name: Behind the Negotiations
description:
The ancient Bamint path nears its end.
A powerful foe awaits them.

name: Shadow of Its Former Glory
description:
The castle ruins stand in the far distance.
Inside it awaits the person Melia told them about.

name: A Wasteland Sunset
description: The sun sets and shines its last light on the wasteland. Don't let your guard down... Monsters rule the night!

name: Golden Days No More
description:
As Bamint furiously seeks the glory of its past,
this ruinous castle quietly shows its future.

name: A Path to Ruin
description: The party heads to the Shattered City. It's a long path, but all journeys start somewhere.

name: The Unexpected Guest
description: Rayas and the others reach the heart of the castle ruins and find somebody unexpected awaiting them!

name: Through the Shattered City
description: Under the shining red moon, Rayas and the others go onward looking for Mira in the Shattered City.

name: The Noblewoman's Surprise
description: Along their path, the group sometimes gets to see an unexpected side of Celia.

name: Cries Under the Red Moon
description:
The bloody moon casts the world bright red,
making monsters more ferocious than ever.

name: Rise and Fall of an Empire
description:
There is a mysterious tradition in this
ruinous city that was once filled with glory.

name: Celia's Question
description: Celia seems curious about Rayas and Iris, since she does not usually have the chance to meet people like them.

name: Searching for Mira
description: Arriving at the underground ruins, the site's oddness is otherworldly... Is Mira really here?

name: Inside the Lost Edifice
description: It appears magic was practiced here long ago... Now it is teeming with monsters!

name: Bygone Days
description: Celia speaks of her good memories with Mira. She seems nostalgic, but there is also a certain sadness in her eyes.

name: Creatures in the Dark
description:
Monsters hide in the shadows of the ruins.
Be careful not to disturb them.

name: A Tragic Reunion
description: The party finds Mira and wants answers, but first they will have to defeat the ancient relic standing before them.

name: Difficulties in La Riiz
description: Rayas and the others arrive at La Riiz, only to find difficulties facing them right away.

name: Threat of the Assassin
description: It seems that the Cult hired assassins. Keep an eye out for them.

name: The Cult's Real Intentions
description: Why is the Cult attacking Rayas and the others? It must be a long story.

name: Through the Burning City
description: Concentrate on passing through the burning city while keeping an eye out for assassins.

name: The Hidden Truth of La Riiz
description: What truth are they hiding in La Riiz? Melia seems to know something...

name: A Magical Cityscape
description: Beyond the burnt city is a view completely unique to La Riiz.

name: Beyond the Magical Swamp
description: Magic Stones can be found in the wetlands. Keep an eye on the path to find them.

name: Melia's Melancholy
description: Melia talks about Magic Stones but seems a little down...

name: Cloudy as Always...
description: Melia teases Rayas in good fun, but it's hard to shake the feeling that something is wrong.

name: What is Your "Favorite"?
description: Melia still seems a bit down, but on the other hand, how's Iris doing?

name: Forest in a Magic Country
description: Rayas and the others reach the Lost Forest of La Riiz.

name: The Frightening Forest
description: Created after an unsuccessful experiment, the forest is indeed very dangerous.

name: Stick Together!
description: A little lost, the party moves foward little by little. Who awaits them?

name: A Path of Hardship
description: The assassin appears in the Lost Forest, but Rayas is exhausted already...

name: At the End of the Lost Forest
description: You're almost there! So close to the end, but trouble lies ahead...!

name: An Abandoned Mine
description: Beyond the forest, there is an abandoned mine of Magic Stones.

name: The Dimly Lit Cave
description: Still aware of the assassins, Rayas and the others proceed through the mine.

name: An Awkward Moment
description: Moving through the mystical mine, everyone's worried about Melia...

name: Heading Toward the Exit
description: Melia seems to be feeling better. There is light at the end of the tunnel!

name: Melia's Destination
description: No assassin attacks yet, but they may attack at any moment.

name: Where the Devil Sleeps
description: There's an anecdote about the training hall where Melia's headed...

name: The Rumored Training Hall
description: A training hall for wizards and hideout for witches... The air is heavy here.

name: [Challenge] Melia's Past
description: The beast's ferocious claws are guided only by pure malice.

name: Hurry to the Magic Lab
description: An intruder suddenly attacks! Hurry to the magic lab now!

name: Guest in the Shadows
description: The Cult's actions come to light through Melia's story, but she is interrupted...

name: Melia's Past
description: Melia has started to reveal her past. What did the Cult do to young Melia?

name: A Memorable Place
description: They reach the place where Melia spent her childhood. It's time to go further in.

name: Iris' Worries
description: Iris has a bad feeling about this place... Keep an eye out for danger!

name: Melia's Thoughts
description: There is a disturbing air to the place, but the party must go on. What is on Melia's mind?

name: The End of the Lab
description: One more step until the transfer device! Can Rayas and company get there safely?

name: An Undesired Battle
description: The comrades Rayas fought with are now challenging him. Don't back down!

name: To a New Place
description: Rayas and the others are teleported to the Aerial City. Immediately, a problem occurs.

name: Temple Full of Flames
description: The temple is so large that no one knows where to go.

name: Encounter with the Unknown
description: The party is wandering the temple cluelessly when somebody suddenly calls out to them.

name: A Mysterious Guide
description: The mysterious woman forces the crew to come with her. They don't know what's happening, but they follow her directions.

name: The Indicated Path
description: The mysterious woman directs them to their next location. Meanwhile, Melia is hurt...

name: A Mission to Fulfill
description: Rayas follows the path that Norn mentioned. On the way, he thinks about his mission.

name: Underwater Corridors
description: There are watery hallways full of monsters, but why?

name: A Beautiful Place
description: Rayas arrives at a mystical place that he has never seen before, and he notices its beauty.

name: Fish Swimming in the Sky
description: Fish are swimming in the sky. Is this a gift from La Riiz?

name: Where Is He...?
description: Rayas reaches the end of the underwater corridor and realizes something...

name: Shadows in the Forest
description: Once they get out of the corridors, they arrive at a forest garden. What awaits them there?

name: The Gorgeous Path
description: The party fights off the attacks from the assassin. Colorful flowers surround them.

name: Delicious Fruits
description: There seems to be all sorts of delicious-looking fruits in this forest garden...

name: A Beautiful Fruit Orchard
description: Plants grow despite the weather and the environment. Rayas and Iris admire their beauty.

name: [Challenge] The Magical Plant's Target
description: The tree seeps poison laden with its hatred for the world.

name: The Magical Plant's Target
description: The party progress through the forest garden. A plant tainted with magic blocks their way.

name: Iris in Bad Condition
description: The party reaches a sunny hill, but Iris seems to be faring badly.

name: Two People, Two Legs
description: Iris is still feeling unwell, so Rayas carries her on his back. Their progress is slow.

name: The Sunny Hill
description: Iris seems to have fallen asleep on Rayas' back.

name: Sunlight through the Trees
description: They go through the path with sunlight coming through the trees. It is a brief respite.

name: The Garden of Riiz
description: Norn called this place a graveyard. The huge garden is lit up with peaceful sunlight.

name: The Silent Waste Plant
description: Iris seems to feel better with Norn's help, but something seems to be wrong with her.

name: In the Dark Waste Plant
description: The waste treatment plant is full of monsters!

name: The Awkward Duo
description: Rayas is interested in the wasteland, but Iris' heart is somewhere else...

name: A Disquieting Atmosphere
description: There's an awkward air between Rayas and Iris at the spooky waste plant.

name: Where Iris' Heart Is
description: Things are still awkward between Rayas and Iris, and Rayas has had enough.

name: A Dreadful Scene at the Garden
description: Suddenly an enormous sound roars throughout the city. What is going to happen to La Riiz?

name: Dark Clouds
description: There's nothing left of the beautiful garden... With tense feelings, the party moves forward.

name: Facing the Demon Lords
description: Rayas and Iris felt the presence of a Demon. Will they fight?

name: Brace Yourself!
description: It's not like Gormarey--only Rayas and Iris are here. They will have to stop the Demon themselves.

name: Battle above the Clouds
description: When the party reaches the middle of the garden, something unexpected happens...

name: Vast Underground World
description: Rayas and friends reach the great caverns under Isliid.  An unimaginable sight awaits them!

name: Agrana's Fiery Caves
description: The heat of the Agrana Caves robs the group of their stamina.

name: Fen's Plan
description: What did Fen have his sights on when he sent Ru to La Riiz?

name: Where Lava is Born
description:
Where ravaging lava is formed.
These searing caves are its birthplace.

name: Demons Unseen
description: The Demons seem to be moving faster than imagined. The group is thrown into worry.

name: The Buried Lake
description: A beautiful and mysterious lake awaits them after the searing heat.

name: Frozen Underground
description:
The area around the lake is frigid. 
Be careful not to freeze!

name: Mystery of the Cavern
description: This vast space which extends under Isliid seems to hide a grand mystery.

name: Shadows in the Underground Lake
description: The lake is deeper than the eye can see. What is casting these shadows on the surface?

name: Legends of the Witches
description: Iris shows interest in the Six Great Witches. What tales of them survive?

name: Hill of Mystery
description: After the lake, the group finds a grand, mysterious hill.

name: Green Beneath the Earth
description: This area is filled with light and greenery, almost as if they were above ground.

name: Celia's Wish
description: The noblewoman Celia comes to the rescue. What is the dream that drives her?

name: Too Far to See
description: The group still has not found the Demons. Their unease grows even greater.

name: Signs of Struggle
description: The group continues to climb the hill. Will they be able to catch the Demons?

name: The Glittering Palace
description: The group reaches the Palace of Light. Is the secret of summoning hidden within?

name: Demons Rampant
description: Demons fill the palace. Don't let them have their way!

name: The Astonishing Truth
description: Norn explains things to Rayas and Iris. However, her explanation just raises more questions!

name: Anxiety Eats the Soul
description: Norn continues to drop bombs of truth. Rayas is unable to find any calm.

name: The Waiting Shadows
description: Only the depths of the palace remain.  Who awaits the group there?

name: Underground Shrine
description: The group departs for the Temple of Darkness after a signal from Celia.

name: Hidden Paths
description: The shrine is enveloped in an unsettling aura. What hides in the dark and gloomy corridors?

name: Divine Shrine of Dark
description: How did the Gods make this dark-enshrouded shrine? No one knows...

name: Unsettled Hearts
description: Celia remains hidden. Rayas' heart is a storm of fears and anxiety.

name: No Time to Breathe
description: After braving Nier's assault, the group discovers a familiar sight.

name: At the Realm of Gods Again
description: This is the Realm of Gods, last seen in the fight at Gormarey. Rayas sets foot once more on those strange soils.

name: Where the Demon Lord Resides
description: The group senses a Demon Lord. There seems to be no way to avoid a fight to the death.

name: Memories of Battle Reborn
description: The group has come to the Realm of Gods.  They can't help remember that old battle.

name: The End Approaches
description: The Demon Lord's strength grows every greater.  The final battle is at hand.

name: [Challenge] Giaveil, the Grand Prince of Sin
description: The Prince of Sin judges impartially, granting death to all that lives.

name: Giaveil, the Grand Prince of Sin
description: Defeat the demon and bring peace to the world.  Accept the fate that awaits you!

name: Phoenix of the Volcano EX5
description: Cry of the Phoenix

name: The Sealed Land Returns
description: Rayas and the others chase Celia to the Sealed Holy Land.

name: Divine Attack
description: After watching the fight with Lord Fongion of the Ten Divine Forces, Ru gives Rayas a shocking report.

name: Pillar of Fire
description: Flames come billowing from pillars before them. The solemn and unsettling sight spreads across the scenery.

name: Spirits and Machines
description: Ru is of the Spirits, and Norn of the Machines. What is happening between the non-Human races?

name: Hopeless Fight
description: The team continues walking, searching for a way to oppose Lord Fongion.

name: River of Confusion
description: Rayas and his friends somehow avoid Lord Fongion's assault, and now they stand before a massive river.

name: Earth-Piercing Torrent
description: The rushing current seems to tear through the very land. It would be dangerous to fall in.

name: Rayas is Worried
description: As he gazes at the raging torrent, Rayas can't help but worry about Norn.

name: Heading Upstream
description: Following the current upstream might lead them to Celia's location.

name: Isliid's Shadow Policy
description: The river's mouth has come into sight. Roy begins to discuss Isliid's goals.

name: Sundrenched Meadow
description: They have reached a beautiful forest and meadow. They are getting close to their goal.

name: Seal Magic and Summoning
description: There seems to be a close connection between seal magic and summoning. Rayas waits for Roy to speak...

name: Mystery of the Ancients
description: Seal magic, summoning, the Ancient Blood and the Otherworld. All these mysteries are connected.

name: Things to Ponder, Things Ungraspable
description: Roy's words confuse Rayas. He needs to straighten things out in his head.

name: No Questions
description: Rayas tries to question Roy and Norn but is interrupted by an unexpected intruder.

name: Lying in Wait...
description: Rayas and friends reach a road leading to a massive castle. A voice they know echoes through the heavens.

name: Castle in the Holy Land
description: Celia is waiting in the castle. Its divine silhouette shows itself in the distance.

name: Rayas Hesitates
description: Rayas speaks, seeming as carefree as usual. However, Roy alone feels that something is amiss.

name: The Time Has Come
description: Rayas approaches massive castle, one step at a time. Soon it will be time to settle things.

name: The Ruler Incarnate
description: The ruler who has been waiting for Rayas and the others appears before them.

name: Paths to Peace
description: Rayas wants to disagree with Celia, but the strength of her conviction challenges his own.

name: The Monster of Bamint
description: As Mira joins Fen's group in their pursuit of Celia, she recalls certain events from her youth.

name: The Royal Sword
description: Mira trudges through the murky swamp with a single purpose in mind.

name: Dark Certitude
description: Celia seeks power to build her ideal world, and no force can stop her.

name: Lost in Thought
description: Rayas is stuck fast in his brooding, so Roy tries to shake him out of indecision.

name: Diverging Paths
description: In the deep mists of the wetlands, Rayas is surprised to see some familiar faces.

name: The Other Route
description: Norn begins to second-guess her reasons for following Rayas.

name: Her Determination
description: Mira's group finally arrives at their destination. The final test of resolve is at hand.

name: The Dreaded Rematch
description: Rayas' party races towards Celia only to be stopped by their greatest obstacle.

name: [Challenge] Guardian of Time
description: The feathered deity steals from its prey hope, faith, and future.

name: Guardian of Time
description: Finally solving the mystery of Fongion's power, Norn prepares to defeat him for good.

name: Recollection
description: A vision of unfamiliar memories comes to Rayas after the temporal explosion.

name: No Turning Back
description: Although Fongion has been overcome, Norn gives Rayas and Iris unfortunate news.

name: The Two Princesses
description: At the top of the tower, Mira boldly wields Bamint's royal blade against her sister.

name: [Challenge] Shadowy Pall
description:
The confrontation is here. Take your honed
blade and surpass the transcendent one!

name: [Challenge] Borne by Wishes
description: The sword of creation seethes with power that rivals all.

name: Borne by Wishes
description: Rayas, in order to fulfill his friends' expectations, finally makes his decision.

name: Shadowy Pall
description: Rayas arrives to the battle only to be greeted by eerie silence.

name: Rampage on the Twin Isles EX5
description: The Great Azure Deity

name: Submerged Remnants EX5
description: Steel Arbitrator

name: At the Tower's Base
description: The lands around this tower rarely know peace. War is an ongoing affair.

name: Mass-Produced Soldiers
description: The Cult's new mass-produced army approaches. Stop them to keep the tower safe!

name: An Equal Madness
description: The horde of artificial soldiers attacks, mindlessly and relentlessly.

name: Abnormal Standards
description: Even subpar strength can become overwhelming with enough numbers.

name: An Unnoticed Friend
description: An unfamiliar young girl stands at Rayas's side. Who could she be?

name: Defense of the Sand Sea
description: Famelle's army fights to protect the capital against the Cult's invasion.

name: Staining the Parched Land
description: Soldiers' blood spills on the chaotic battlefield, only to be absorbed by the dry sands.

name: Unexpected Reinforcements
description: As Rayas' group nears the front line, an unforeseen enemy rises to meet them.

name: The Power of Faith
description: The Cult boasts only a fraction of their strength is on display. Can you hold out?

name: New Force
description: The sandstorm brought with it unfamiliar faces.

name: Iris, Abducted
description: Rayas runs to rescue Iris after her sudden kidnapping.

name: Through the Nest
description: Who are these intruders who have taken Iris, claiming to keep her safe?

name: Self-Appointed Guards
description: Rayas caught up with the kidnappers, but the reason for their actions shocks him.

name: Sand Sea Struggle
description: Meanwhile, Zeorg and the others continue to fight the Cult's army.

name: Plans for the Capital
description: Zeorg, the general of Famelle's armies, is a hero of legend. But even heroes face hard choices.

name: An Anxious Feeling
description: The Imperial Knights' aid is reassuring but a portent of the threats ahead.

name: Fleeing with the Sandstorm
description: Rayas and his companions run from the Famelle army, but the monsters of the desert have no mercy.

name: Refuge in the Dark
description: Having fled into the Magic Cave of Valdan, Rayas and Noel argue without restraint.

name: Through the Cavern
description: In order to reach the port, the group must first defeat the monsters dwelling in this cave.

name: Seaside Path
description: The faint scent of sea air pushes them forward. Defeat the foes and hurry to the port!

name: New Harbor
description: On Famelle's pristine docks, the heavy guard does not seem to be intent on keeping the peace...

name: Transporting Chaos
description: Rayas and his friends sneak into the port dressed as porters. Can they deceive the sharp-eyed guards?

name: For the Emperor
description: Noel of the Imperial Zero Guard fights out of pure devotion to a single person...

name: The Power of Devotion
description: The Cult's battle strength seems endless, but Noel wields his blade with unwavering loyalty.

name: Trust Between Allies
description: The group escapes the chaos of Famelle. Though filled with frustration, they press on.

name: [EX1] The Engineer
description: Marika has just moved into Reigrad. Watch out for her variety of gizmos.

name: [EX2] The Young Inventor
description: Technical limitations fall to her will. This young innovator is disrupting the way to a new future.

name: [SPEX] Growing Frenzy
description: The spreading chaos cannot go on. You must put a stop to the mass-produced soldiers' rampage!

name: Unsafe Harbor
description: Seeing the harbor seized by the cult, Rayas' party lands further along the coast.

name: Running from the Cult
description: The group flees across the muddy wetlands.

name: Northbound Hope
description: The journey will be difficult, but reaching the north region should offer respite.

name: Marsh March
description: The quagmire stretches endlessly. Wiping off sweat and unease, Rayas' crew presses on.

name: The Distant Tower
description: Oluon fades behind them. The edge of the swamp is close.

name: Parched Soil
description: After the damp swamp is a dry wasteland. The group pushes their weary bodies ahead.

name: Threading a Path
description: The towering rock walls obstruct not only their view but also the enemy's.

name: Sand in the Eyes
description: Grit sticks to their sweat-drenched skin as they pass along the deserted path.

name: The Hidden Tunnel
description: The party enters a concealed route through the mountains. Safety awaits on the other side.

name: Ambush at the Exit
description: Fight through the cult soldiers and clear a path towards the future.

name: Fleeing up the Mountain
description: Clear your mind of distractions and focus on escaping.

name: Rocky Path
description: Step quick and sure along the uneven road. Ignore the pain -- be grateful you can feel at all.

name: Breakthrough
description: Never stop, no matter how difficult the journey gets. Smother your fears and charge forward.

name: Running on a Prayer
description: You can carry on as long as you have hope. Always hold it tight.

name: [Challenge] Sinful Puppet
description: Throw open the cell of chaos and fill the world with death once more.

name: Sinful Puppet
description: What was once a powerful foe now stands at the will of another.

name: Riding the Arcana Express
description: The Shadow Guardian comes to the aid of Rayas and his party.

name: Lulling Vibrations
description: Aided by relief and exhaustion, everyone falls into a deep sleep.

name: Night in the Capital
description: Kane's story casts a grim pall over the meeting.

name: The Value of Reliance
description: A sleepless Iris talks to the Shadow Guardian about her fears.

name: The North Port
description: Regardless of what doubts linger, one must always move with the dawn.

name: All Aboard
description: Preparations for the ship arranged by President Kane finish with solemn silence.

name: A Quiet Departure
description: The ship glides calm and steady from the shores of Gramenia.

name: Gentle Waves
description: Rayas' crew breathes easy, expecting time to rest until arrival in Isliid.

name: The Unsinkable Schemer
description: It is just as important to know who can you trust as who you must doubt.

name: Into the Depths
description: Fen's craft carries everyone towards Bamint while he explains the reason for the detour.

name: [EX1] Knight of the Zero Guard
description: See the secret behind the talented young Noel's strength.

name: [EX2] The Emperor's Blade
description: Not just anyone can join the Zero Guard. Observe the skill of an elite soldier.

name: [SPEX] Return of the Nightmare
description: That unforgettable chill returns. Defeat the Demon Lord once more.

name: Return to Bamint
description: Walking along the paved road to the castle brings back memories, both good and bad.

name: The Sword's Call
description: Grand Scale sleeps deep underground, waiting for the time it is needed once more.

name: Out of Harm's Way
description: With the principiality still free of the Cult's influence, Iris can finally be at ease.

name: Laying the Groundwork
description: Batiste and Fen put their minds together to devise a brilliant plan.

name: A Lady's Welcome
description: Mira longed to see her friends again, if only so she could lower the usual veneer of cold dignity.

name: Two Reunions
description: He heads down the winding steps to be reunited with the sword of destiny.

name: The Dozing Experiment
description: A strange shadow moves left, then right. Its flickering eyes searches for prey.

name: Quiet Blade
description: Rayas holds Grand Scale once more. After all the preparation he has made, he silently takes in its majesty.

name: Bursting from His Chest
description: Rayas has been chosen by the sword to defend Iris. Never before has he felt such exhilaration.

name: Sadistic Appraisal
description: The enemy suddenly appears to indulge in her favorite pastime.

name: Hairline Fractures
description: What seem to be small cracks along the surface reach to the bottom of his heart.

name: Beyond Boundaries
description: People of different nations are united in a single purpose: to protect Iris.

name: Deserving Protection
description: Although he always did nothing but look ahead, at some point that began to change.

name: To Meet Again
description: They would only be separated for a brief time, but he could not contain his worry.

name: Never Say Good-Bye
description: What appeared to be mere small talk contained hints of deeper sentiment.

name: Four Nations
description: People of different lands must stand together against an unprecedented threat.

name: Bamint's Defense
description: The tsunami of the Cult's invasion threatens to swallow the principality whole.

name: Haphazard Invasion
description: What their siege lacks in finesse is more than made up by sheer numbers.

name: Iris on the Run
description: The Zero Guard escorts Iris to the harbor, fully aware of their mission's importance.

name: The Ancient's Trail
description: She releases the whole of her power, intent on taking the shortest route to victory.

name: Another Foe
description: As both land and ocean burn, no route is truly safe.

name: The Devastated Port
description: Enemies attack in droves. Spells fly and swords clash. Seawater turns red.

name: The Battle Continues
description: With unstoppable force and fierce determination, Mira, Fen, and Rayas fight on.

name: Ancient Fury
description: Humans are weak and insignificant. Any sign of arrogance demands punishment.

name: [Challenge] Minced Words
description: Her body changes into that of a towering horror.

name: [EX1] The Zero Guard's Policy
description: Fast, precise, efficient. The emperor's men carry out their missions with perfect execution.

name: [EX2] Black Flash
description: The wolf of the Zero Guard barks silently. His edged shadows attack without warning.

name: [SPEX] Transcendental Terror
description: Despite her Human appearance, the madness within her small body is immeasurable.

name: Minced Words
description: Emotions left unshared that night are their motivation to meet again.

name: Back to the Magus Empire
description: Rayas' determination to turn the chase around gives the others energy to follow.

name: Aquatic Navigator
description: Marika creates a remarkable gadget that leads the party to their destination.

name: Nostalgic Landscape
description: La Riiz is just as beautiful as he remembers, but there is no time to admire the view.

name: Into Enemy Territory
description: Although the path is easy to traverse, no rest can be found anywhere.

name: The Quagmire
description: They advance with caution, keeping their eyes on the road and their senses on alert.

name: A Familiar Face
description: They reach the indicated place only to find an old comrade.

name: The Sorceress' Intent
description: Melia soon proves she is no longer on Rayas' side.

name: Clouded Consciousness
description: Her hypnotic magic leaves them not even the time to regret their blunder.

name: The Land of Sorcery
description: A false signal fooled Marika's radar, demonstrating the extent of La Riiz's magical mastery.

name: A Mysterious Dream
description: Events that happened long, long ago in a land far, far away suddenly appear before him.

name: More Dreams
description: Rayas sees yet another vision of the past that feels strangely familiar.

name: Running Simulations
description:
Fen suggests practicing under various conditions. 
They must succeed no matter what.

name: Within Expectations
description:
Five guards or more is the likely case. 
Matching the number of captives is common sense.

name: Beyond Expectations
description:
Three guards or less is unlikely. 
Melia would not dare underestimate them...

name: Another Familiar Face
description: Twin blades rip through the silence of the subterranean dungeon.

name: Overestimated
description: He appears to be lost in thought, focusing on the words she said that day.

name: Unshakable Unease
description: Something warns her about that one Human, as shocked as she is by the very idea.

name: Sudden Reaction
description: Rayas' group gropes through the dim cavern until they spy a faint gleam.

name: The Crumbling Cavern
description: Walls creak and strain with the violent tremors. Before long, the entire place will become rubble.

name: [Challenge] The Blade Awakens
description: She sneers down at the adventurer. Everything will be over once she crushes him.

name: The Blade Awakens
description: The spirit within Grand Scale emerges, its will mingling with Rayas'.

name: Dramatic Pursuit
description: Rayas has Emi on the run. He can't let this chance slip away.

name: Road of Red
description:
The rugged mountain trail continues. 
Their scarlet hue reflects his burning spirit.

name: Dig Deep
description: Though he is wounded and winded, he must keep moving.

name: Imminent Conclusion
description: The path runs into a sheer wall. Within moments, their battle will be decided.

name: A Surprise Reunion
description: It is neither a dream nor an illusion. The one he has fought so hard to see stands before him.

name: [EX1] The Silence Breaker
description: She has never known warmth. She has never known peace. All she knows is hatred and ruin.

name: [EX2] The Six Demons' Ruler
description: She expects only one thing from others: complete obedience.

name: [SPEX] Looming Shadow
description: Power beyond compare envelops the area. Behold the true influence of the Cult.

name: Timeless Voice
description: When the light called out, he found himself walking towards it.

name: The Blade's Inheritor
description: He continues to seek his identity, his mission, and his worth.

name: Silent Darkness
description: Meanwhile, Misette keeps her indescribable discomfort locked inside.

name: Separate Ways
description: Their lack of allies in La Riiz makes staying updated of the current situation difficult.

name: Following the Beacon
description: Without a map, the radar in Marika's hands provides invaluable direction.

name: The Hidden Gate
description: Experience has taught him reality is more than what meets the eye.

name: Loneliness & Curiosity
description: Marika's legs trembled as she prepared herself to face the truth.

name: Groitz's Irritation
description: Although he believes himself superior, he appears to be mentally distressed.

name: Hillside Melody
description: The sound of the wind is soothing, but tainted with the faint scent of darkness.

name: Stories of the Sky
description: The clear blue expanse is an ever-present reminder someone is waiting for him.

name: Destinations Beyond
description: The voice and the light carry them far, far away. In the distance, the sound of footsteps grows louder.

name: Commotion in the Capital
description: The sudden appearance of Rayas and Noel in the courtyard causes quite a stir.

name: Nature of the Crime
description: Rayas is flabbergasted by his charges, but knows someone is up to something.

name: Noel's Report
description: Noel is equally shocked. He begins to fear his mission was truly in vain.

name: The Imperial Arena
description: Rayas is about to find out why Isliid's colosseum is the grandest in the empire.

name: Distant Vision
description: The emperor's incredible foresight leaves Rayas in utter awe.

name: Red-Stained Goddess
description: Her name is carved into history -- bloodily, violently, coldly.

name: The Supreme Witch
description: The emperor reveals Misette's past, including her sins.

name: Awaited Struggle
description: An obstacle appears before Rayas: Groitz, still stewing in his anger.

name: [Challenge] The Sword's Will
description: The Ancient has taken many creatures into his body, just as a predator consumes prey.

name: The Sword's Will
description: Through with being controlled by the whims of another, Rayas takes control himself.

name: Promise after the Rain
description: He swears to rescue her. Amidst all of the chaos, that alone remains clear.

name: Faces of the Grand Master
description: They search for their next opponent, but the path to him is not a straight line.

name: The Emperor's Intent
description: His words lead them on, but his actual purpose is yet unknown.

name: Conference of Light & Shade

name: Shrine of Remembrance 【INT】
description:
A forbidden power rests in this ominous shrine.
The voices of deathgods whisper from beyond the black veil.

name: Shrine of Remembrance 【ADV】
description:
A forbidden power rests in this ominous shrine.
The seal is weakening, and greater power seeps through.

name: Shrine of Remembrance 【PRO】
description:
A forbidden power rests in this ominous shrine.
Their power unleashed, the demons attack!

name: Shrine of Remembrance【AWK】
description:
A forbidden power rests in this ominous shrine.
The blades that even slash nihility sneers at you.

name: Sanctuary of the Princess 【INT】
description:
This Exploring temple leads to the land of the dead.
The scent of deadly poison fills the air!

name: Sanctuary of the Princess 【ADV】
description:
This Exploring temple leads to the land of the dead.
The Pest Princess has unleashed her miasma!

name: Sanctuary of the Princess 【PRO】
description:
This Exploring temple leads to the land of the dead.
The fearsome hunters show their true power!

name: Sanctuary of the Princess【AWK】
description:
This Exploring temple leads to the land of the dead.
The awoken princess is ready to defeat you!

description:
Volcanic ruins emerge from another world.
What legend sleeps in their depths?

name: The Crimson King 【ADV】
description:
Volcanic ruins emerge from another world.
The Dragon of ruin bares its fangs to all intruders!

name: The Crimson King 【PRO】
description:
Volcanic ruins emerge from another world.
The Divine Fire Dragon's fearsome power is unleashed!

name: The Crimson King【AWK】
description: Blazing volcanic ruins have appeared in the Exploring. The Divine Fire Dragon's crimson roars burns everything down!

name: Holy Land of EXP 【BGN】
description: Gain EXP to strengthen your units!

name: Holy Land of EXP 【INT】
description: Gain lots of EXP to strengthen your units!

name: Holy Land of EXP 【ADV】
description: Gain lots of EXP to strengthen your units!

name: Looking for Ganan
description: Rayas sets out for Sergen cave to look for Ganan on Giliam's request.

name: Search the Cave
description: The enemies in the cave are amazingly strong. Rayas takes his time and stays on his toes.

name: Deeper Inside
description: Traces of battle puzzle Rayas. Make no mistake, Ganan is near.

name: Unexpected Foe
description: Ganan challenges Rayas! He's unexpectedly strong!

name: Devil of War Ganan
description: Ganan is demanding a rematch. The feared "Devil of War" comes for you!

name: [EX1] Pride of the Warrior
description: After training, comes more training. This path demands resolve!

name: [EX2] Feast of the Warrior
description: This warrior's banquet has just begun. Learn the true meaning of "Devil of War"!

name: [SPEX] Rhapsody of the Warrior
description: Can Rayas really get through this training? The march of the Warrior rings out.

name: [AWK] Howl of the Warrior
description: The Devil of War--his Twin Axes crush everything. Keep up with the balde of the howling warrior!

name: [DREAM] The Legendary Guildmaster
description:
That man has overcome numerous trials.
That axe has decimated many opponents.

name: In Search for Another Me
description: Roy and Rayas set out to discover the truth of an odd rumor circulating among the knights.

name: What's Up, Roy?
description: As the pair goes on their adventure, Roy begins to show a seldom-seen side of him.

name: Something Strange Approaches
description: Some strange things start happening to Rayas and Roy as they investigate the cave.

name: The Illusion's Truth
description: What is behind the mysterious sight standing before Rayas?

name: [EX1] The Illusion Attacks
description: Roy's doppelganger has appeared... No doubt a powerful enemy is nearby!

name: Duel with the Silver Wolf
description: As the Ravenous Silver Wolf, Roy has drawn Rayas into a duel. He must be faced!

name: [EX2] Roy, Knight of the Empire
description: Roy, the most powerful of the knights, will require all of Rayas' skill to fight!

name: [SPEX] Howl of the Ravenous Wolf
description: The Ravenous Silver Wolf has revealed his true nature. Can anyone defeat him?

name: Attack of the Fraids!
description: Take down the waves of fearsome exploding rock monsters!

name: Search the Fortress
description: Visit Fort Goldoa to investigate the source of all these skeletons! Proceed with caution!

name: The Monsters in the Fortress
description:
Enemies increase deeper in the fort.
What's drawing them in?

name: An Unsettling Aura
description: This mysterious feeling is new... It certainly feels like something bad is happening!

name: What Awaits in the Fortress
description: A faint voice can be heard... Is it chanting some spell? It raises a cold sweat on our heroes...

name: Plot of the Fallen Priest
description:
The sound of chanting grows clearer.
At the same time, a strange priest appears.

name: Madness of the Fallen Priest
description:
The party chases the Fallen Priest deeper into the fortress.
They must stop Karon's madness at any cost!

name: 【EX】Dragons and Divinities
description: This power strikes fear in the hearts of even skilled adventurers. And there's more than one...

name: 【SPEX】Priest's Final Weapon
description: The Fallen Priest's last resort is the terrible technique of "Copy Them!"

name: Attack of the Corocs!
description:
Ominous spirits loom near!
Take them down with all your strength!

name: Attack of the Mikyuon!
description:
The Mikyuon rush is endless!
Take them all down!

name: Attack of the Golcats 【BGN】
description:
Even cute cats will fight for gold!
Take down the greedy kitties!

name: Attack of the Golcats 【INT】
description:
Don't discount the power of greed!
These misers are running wild!

name: Attack of the Tasmons 【BGN】
description:
The food is fighting back!
Drive off the Tasmons!

name: Attack of the Tasmons 【INT】
description:
The herd has unleashed hidden power!
Don't hold back, fire it up!

name: "Break" Damage
description:
Damage increases during Break!
Fire off your Arts and do massive damage!

name: High DEF
description:
It's hard to damage enemies with high DEF.
Critical hits ignore DEF to do damage!

name: Arts Advice
description: If your enemy Breaks at the same time as their Arts activate, you can stop the Arts!

name: Massive Damage Advice
description: When you take massive damage, be sure to heal and regroup!

name: Quick And Decisive
description:
The longer a battle lasts, the worse off you'll be.
Make your victory quick and decisive.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Magic is weak against enemies with magic resistance. Hit them with physical attacks!

name: Advice on Freezing
description:
Freezing can stop you in your tracks.
Watch your Skill and Arts timing!

name: Attack Equipment
description: Damage bosses using Physical or Magic Attack Equip Skills.

name: Faster Arts
description: Use Support equipment to fill your Arts gauge and unleash your Arts!

name: Takedown Battle
description: Even if you lose you can try again, continuing where you last left off! Beat it with as few tries as possible!

name: Cross Battle
description:
Assemble 8 units to face a challenging foe!
Match races and elements for buffs and win!

name: Free Practice
description:
Test out new attacks and tactics
against a Boss dummy!

name: Attack of the Metal Chicken 【BGN】
description:
The eggs with knowledge started a counter-attack!
Don’t get swallowed into the silver crowd!

name: Attack of the Metal Chicken 【INT】
description:
The birds with knowledge won’t stop!
Face the silver birds and wipe them out!

name: Sophie's Truth
description: Although she's just a cook, Sophie stood bravely against the monsters, embarrassing Rayas...

name: Whence the Ingredients?
description: The forceful Sophie has revealed a shocking supply line for her ingredients...

name: Pride of the Adventurer
description:
Rayas is a humble adventurer...
But this won't end with some teasing!

name: Spores of Confusion
description: Rayas's carelessness spreads some mysterious mushroom spores...

name: The Master Chef
description: Sophie takes up her frying pan to teach Rayas one last lesson!

name: 【EX1】The Master Chef's Test
description:
Sophie's eye catches all.
Can Rayas demonstrate real skill?

name: 【EX2】Sophie's Teaching Tool
description:
Sophie's tongue is hard to please.
If the taste is off, her fry pan will guide you!

name: 【SPEX】Master Chef, Sophie
description:
Sophie is the Master Chef of the Firecat's Den.
Can Rayas gain her approval?

name: 【AWK】The Full Course
description: Loosen your belt and savor Sophie's signature smorgasbord!

name: [DREAM] Crème de la Crème
description:
She prepared this meal with heart and soul.
Clean the plate before it gets cold!

name: Checking Out the Beach
description: Mira and Rayas have come to Famelle's beach to investigate "ghost" sightings...

name: The Refreshing Seaside
description: With weather perfect for a swim, nothing unusual is appearing at the beach... But Mira is acting a little oddly...

name: Unhappy Mira
description: Rayas wants more clues, but Mira's mood is worsening and she just won't talk.

name: Shy Ghosts?
description: There's no sign at all of any "ghostly" apparitions. And Mira seems a bit too relieved...

name: A Familiar Sight
description: The beachcombing is fruitless. Instead of ghosts, Rayas spots a familiar figure.

name: Check Out the Ghost Ship!
description: On Ru's advice they head to the Ghost Ship, but Mira is clearly not happy...

name: After Mira!
description: Mira took fright and bolted after an unpleasant sound. Rayas needs to hurry and catch up as soon as possible!

name: A Lady's Place
description: Hurrying before it's too late, Rayas searches for Mira but can't find her.

name: Something Suspicious
description:
Someone has appeared in front of Rayas...
The closer he gets, the more obvious this isn't Mira.

name: Mira Turns the Tables
description: "Mira" has attacked Rayas! But who is she, really?

name: 【EX1】A Lady's Pastime
description: Mira has decided to test Rayas' sword arm. It appears she's just passing the time...

name: Mira's Weakpoint
description:
Mira's face is an open book.
What is it that she hates so much...?

name: Adieu, Ghost Ship
description: To work on Mira's fears, the pair moves away from the Ghost Ship.

name: A Haunted Getaway
description: Rayas encourages Mira as they head to a cave in Famelle said to be haunted.

name: The Vaunted Cave
description: Arriving at the cave, Mira starts to explain why she's so scared.

name: The Hidden Sisters
description: Mira feels inferior next to her older sisters, and Rayas wants her to feel better.

name: The Speechless Lady
description: Mira hasn't said a word since leaving the cave. She must have been terrified!

name: Once More Ghost Ship!
description: With no improvement in Mira's weakness, the two return. But Mira's knees are knocking...

name: Push On, Ghost Ship!
description: Mira is as afraid as ever, but this time she's set on solving this mystery.

name: Fear vs Curiosity
description: Rayas has no fear of ghosts, his adventurous heart is too strong!

name: The Ghostly Truth
description: The two confront the master of the Ghost Ship. Scared as she is, Mira won't back down.

name: [EX2] The Promised Game
description: "This time, we're settling this!" Mira says, facing down Rayas.

name: [SPEX] The Princess's Trial
description: If you win the battle against the Lady, you'll gain her approval! But don't say you didn't ask for this...

name: [Limited EX1] Never Ending Battle
description: Mira continues to fight although she won in numerous battles. Now it's time to challenge her!

name: [Limited EX2] Encounter with Legend
description: All the strongest warriors are now here! It's your time to become a hero!

name: Awoken Mira
description: Awoken Mira is here! Wage a splendid battle with the Third Lady!

name: Return to the Demonseal Tower
description: Receiving a report of mysterious monsters seen, Rayas comes to Demoneseal Tower "Medera" once again…

name: The Back of the Demon
description:
Rayas fights off Grad which was acting weird, and hurries back home.
However, another known face stands in his way.

name: Different Memories
description:
Grad stands in Rayas's way for the third time.
He doesn't remember the conversation  they just had…

name: Battle of Fort Goldoa
description:
Rayas chases Grad and arrives at the Battle of Fort Goldoa.
What awaits him is countless numbers of…

name: Real x Fake
description:
While fighting off hundreds of Grads, there seems to be one strong one!?
Is he the real Grad or not?

name: [SPEX] Who is the "Real" One?
description:
Is there really the "real" Grad in this crowd?
And yet, what is the true meaning of "real"?

name: [SPEX Hyper] The Proof of Demon
description:
Is the Grad in front of you real?
He is the only one left for true.

name: [AWK] The Pride of Demons
description:
Power is everything, the true source of pride.
With a single blow, the mighty bestows despair.

name: [DREAM] None Stronger
description:
He believes the quickest way to prove
his might is complete and total slaughter.

name: Dungeon of Trials 1F
description: The beastman of flames stands in the way at the entrance of the Dungeon.

name: Dungeon of Trials 2F
description: Defeat the green fairy and blade wolf from the jungles and proceed to the next floor.

name: Dungeon of Trials 3F
description: A deathly shadow stares back. You cannot move forward if this miasma is not defeated.

name: Dungeon of Trials 4F
description: The deeper you go, the stronger your enemies become. Be careful of the swordswoman and her water-blade.

name: Dungeon of Trials 5F
description: You need courage more than anything to proceed. Stay brave because the awakened ice giant will overpower you.

name: Dungeon of Trials 6F
description: Once the swordswoman of light releases her powers of her treasured sword, no one can stop her attack.

name: Dungeon of Trials 7F
description: The magical knight has revealed himself. What awaits you...hope or despair?

name: Dungeon of Trials 8F
description: The sealed mechanized fortress in the other world has opened. Horrifying weapons protect their territory.

name: Dungeon of Trials 9F
description: The dragon said to preside over all life has appeared. Do you have the resolve to overcome this desperate battle?

name: Dungeon of Trials 10F
description: The guardian beast of the ice palace has flown into this world. The beast's cry casts the world into absolute coldness.

name: Dungeon of Trials 11F
description: Winning this fight earns you the respect of Mira. It's a one-shot battle...not that you wanted to face her to begin.

name: Dungeon of Trials 12F
description: Sophie is the master chef of the "Mountaincat Diner". Do your battle skills meet her tastes?

name: Dungeon of Trials 13F
description: The silver hungry wolf has shown its true self. Is there anyone who can defeat this beast?

name: Dungeon of Trials 14F
description: Can you really overcome this trial? The warrior's wild dance now starts…

name: Dungeon of Trials 15F
description: Grad stands before you, but is this really him? All that's known is he was the only one to stay behind…

name: Dungeon of Trials 16F
description: Burn away the ghost soldiers that keep arising and defeat the dark wizard.

name: Dungeon of Trials 17F
description: Vicious power permeates this world. Is this nightmare eternal?! Fight with all your might!

name: Dungeon of Trials 18F
description:
Once a experimental subject, now an enemy against you!
Stop the raging living weapon!

name: Dungeon of Trials 19F
description:
From the fire emerged the true One to rule all flames.
The fire of truth will reduce all to ash.

name: Dungeon of Trials 20F
description: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Evade the deadly bolts to safety.igh

name: Dungeon of Trials 21F
description:
Why does the created life stand in the way?
The girl who looks like Iris says nothing…

name: Dungeon of Trials 22F
description:
The crimson flames of the Blade Master from the Ancient War is in your way.
Nobody can stop his flames of anger…

name: Dungeon of Trials 23F
description:
The Queen of the Dead leads her spider army against you. 
Any who fall before them will be consumed.

name: Dungeon of Trials 24F
description:
Evade the counterattack of Death dressed in black
and shatter its soul together with the cloak.

name: Dungeon of Trials 25F
description:
Climb over fallen remains of the Defeated
and stand against the hell-fire wreathed bird!

name: Dungeon of Trials 26F
description:
Vicious flames cover the whole place.
Now you reached the burning prison of the Fire Spirits.

name: Dungeon of Trials 27F
description: Your world approaches its end as the azure blade of the Silent Divine slashes through space and time.

name: Dungeon of Trials 28F
description:
Fend off the horde of rampaging dragons.
Those who hesitate will never face their ruler.

name: Dungeon of Trials 29F
description:
The forest spirit trembles with indignant rage.
Hack through the briars before they bury you!

name: Dungeon of Trials 30F
description:
When the deity's love overflows, the world will
become drowned in everlasting darkness.

name: Dungeon of Trials 31F
description:
A severing edge juts from the void. 
The overlord's seal comes undone.

name: Dungeon of Trials 32F
description:
The Grand Prince of Sin smiles under his mask
as he envisions the adventurers' utter ruin.

name: Dungeon of Trials 33F
description:
A wealth of murderous choices are presented:
