lashing, gouging, poisoning, or insanity.

name: Gormarey Again
description: A mysterious Armored Demon has appeared. Rayas heads to the Black Gate to find the truth.

name: Memories of War
description: Memories of his battle with Demons come back to his mind. Is such fierceness expected again?

name: The Lady's Sigh
description: While checking Gormarey, the party reunites an old friend. But why is she so exhausted?

name: Drowning in Greed
description: Adventurers who break in for a little grave robbing are par for the course. No wonder Mira's fed up...

name: Resurrected Memories
description: Iris and Rayas talk about their past adventures. It was full of danger, hardship, but also a bit of fun...

name: The Armor Unseen
description: Searching doesn't turn up the Armored Demon. Perhaps it's already left?

name: The Hero's Doubt
description: The Hero has also come to investigate Gormarey. The mystery of the Armored Demon deepens...

name: An Unspeakable Unease
description: The Armored Demon has not shown up, but with investigators from every nation here, it's clearly more than a rumor.

name: Unseen Goal
description: What is the Armored Demon after? Why is it attacking the adventurers and investigators?

name: Ragsherum Reborn
description: The Armored Demon was Ragsherum after all! But... something is strange.

name: Ragsherum... Gone
description: Melia brought up an unexpected possibility. What was that Ragsherum, really?

name: After Ragsherum
description: Leave Fen to check out the various possibilities, and go after Ragsherum!

name: To the Heart of Gormarey
description: The search for Ragsherum leads deeper into Gormarey. There's no turning back...

name: A Looming Fear
description: Something's wrong with Iris. Could there be traces of the Demon horde nearby?

name: The Demon Armor Grows
description: If Fen's study is right, the Demon Armor's power is growing. It has to be stopped... fast!

name: Iris' Premonition
description: Iris isn't looking well and makes a dire announcement. Their pace hurries as the Demon Armor draws near!

name: Demon Armor Ragsherum
description: Just as Fen predicted, the Demon Armor is trying to take its master's place!

name: The Ghost Runs Amok
description: Ragsherum's ghost, driven out of the Demon Armor, draws near... Rush to the pool of magical power!

name: Raging Hatred
description: Hatred powerful enough to reanimate Ragsherum from the dead... Don't let this hatred continue!

name: Phantom Ragsherum
description: Ragsherum's ghost has appeared at the pool of magic. No time to think, this fight will need every ounce of power!

name: 【EX1】Threat of the Armored Demon
description: A mysterious Armored Demon has appeared in Gormarey. Is it the one they already defeated?

name: 【EX2】Masterless Demon Armor
description: Surpassing its master, and taking his place, this Demon Armor is gathering endless power. Seal it away!

name: 【SPEX】The Phantom's Revenge
description: Ragsherum's obsession with Rayas has transformed him into a ghost of vengeance! This time, he must be destroyed!

name: The Smith's Curiosity
description: Rayas was all ready to escort Gilliam, but when monsters appear something odd happens...

name: Reason for Refusal
description: Rayas came to help Gilliam gather materials, but...

name: The Smith's Pickiness
description: While gathering materials, Rayas reveals his doubts to Gilliam.

name: The Smith's History
description: Rayas has found one answer for the questions Gilliam raises...

name: The Hero and the Smith
description: He said he's talked too much, but Gilliam still has one more important story...

name: [EX] The Worth of Arms
description: Gilliam has come to show Rayas the true worth of arms. Can he give a proper response?

name: [SPEX] Worthy of Dream Sword
description:
Gilliam will some day complete this hero's blade.
Can Rayas prove his worthiness?

name: [AWK] The Crucible
description: The massive, tempered warhammer rests on equally firm shoulders. Feel his fire-forged spirit!

name: [DREAM] The Legendary Blacksmith
description:
He knows both his gear and himself,
smiling fearlessly at the challenger.

name: 【Despair】 Atrocity of Dead Armor
description:
Will this nightmare of vicious power and despair ever end?!
Face Ragsherum with everything you got!

name: Investigate the Royal Library
description:
Lagan, the last place where Zeorg was.
Are there any clues?

name: The Upper Floors
description:
Rayas and Fen split up to investigate Lagan.
Fight off the monsters and move forward!

name: The Damaged Library
description:
The library should have been cleared by the Kingdom of Famelle.
What happened to Lagan?

name: The Promised Time
description:
It's time to meet with Fen.
Has he found any clues?

name: The Forbidden Area
description: Rayas and Fen head to the area where the forbidden books are held. Will there finally find some clues?

name: Go After the Priestess
description: Liese went toward the Demonseal Tower of Medela. Rayas and Iris go after her.

name: What's Happening in Medela?
description:
Iris feels something strange...
Definitely something is happening...

name: Shadows of the Priestess
description:
They still can't find Liese.
Trying not to worry too much, the two move forward.

name: A Little More until the Top
description:
They almost reached the last floor, but no trace of Liese.
Will she be there?

name: What Awaits at the Top
description:
Finally, Rayas and the others are at the top.
They hurry, hoping that Liese is fine.

name: [EX1] Beyond the Flash
description:
With a sudden flash, someone appears...
It is a High God Rayas once defeated...

name: Again, at Cudre Del Ohne
description:
As Roy ordered, Rayas and Iris arrived at Cudre Del Ohne.
What will be expecting them?

name: The Two Investigating the Ruins
description:
There seems to be nothing wrong.
Rayas recalls his memories here.

name: The Beautiful Ruins
description: Unlike their first visit here, now that they have time to spare, the party is enjoying the beautiful ruins... but don't forget to keep investigating.

name: Something Strange
description:
There is no trace of what Roy said.
Rayas is puzzled...

name: Iris Looks Down
description:
Iris is thinking hard and hasn't been talking...
Rayas tries to cheer her up...

name: To the Realm of Gods
description:
Now that Rayas and Iris are ready,
their next goal is to go to the Realm of Gods!

name: The Goddess' Request
description:
What is the soul of the High God trying to do?
Go find out about the Goddess' request!

name: The Goddess and Iris
description: Two souls in one body. Iris wants to grant the Goddess' wish. Help them fulfill their goal!

name: What Awaits in the Realm of Gods
description:
Whose soul is the one wandering the realm of Gods?
Rayas and Iris go further in to find the answer.

name: The Wish of a Soul
description:
The soul of the High God still doesn't show itself.
Will it finally appear to them?

name: [EX2] Lights of the Divine Soul
description:
Marzex might help you...
Believing those words, face him.

name: [SPEX] Ultimate Light of the God
description:
The light of Marzex becomes brighter.
Will you be able to stand before him?

name: Harbinger of Armageddon
description: The Harbinger of Armageddon of the Heavens appears, born of Marzex' hate...

name: [SPEX Hyper] Armageddon Descent
description: The Harbinger of Armageddon looks to consume and destroy the Merciful Marzex. Save the world from this peril!

name: Challenge Quest
description:
Light and Dark. Mercy and Hate.
Beware, for the judgment of the two Gods comes down on you--!

name: Botanical Panic at the Theater【BGN】
description: A raging menace interrupts a peaceful day... Stop it before someone gets hurt!

name: Botanical Panic at the Theater【INT】
description: What does the unstoppable monster want?! Don't let it get out of hand!

name: Botanical Panic at the Theater【ADV】
description: The report says it has newfound powers! Is it trying to show off on stage?!

name: Botanical Panic at the Theater【PRO】
description: It's said to resemble a normal Goldola, making it weak to burns and crtical hits...

name: Botanical Panic at the Theater【AWK】
description: MEGA Goldola β reveals its true powers! Use 8 Legends to slay it once and for all!

name: A Rumor of Danger
description:
Roy gives Rayas a job in Famelle.
Will the rumored enemy show its face?

name: Roy's Request
description:
A dangerous presence lurks in Famelle...
Rayas hurries in his search!

name: Scouring Famelle
description: Every corner of the kingdom must be scoured. An adventurer's intuition and a little legwork will save the day!

name: The Fabled Sword's Warning
description: Rayas joins Zeorg, who was prompted by a warning from the fabled sword Ryude Magus.

name: Guidance of the Fabled Sword
description: Ryude Magus has its own will and guides the pair. Not without questions, Rayas and Zeorg follow.

name: Zeorg's Premonition
description: The sword responds differently than before. Zeorg has a bad feeling...

name: A Hero's Courage
description:
The Hero of Famelle is truly stout of heart.
Rayas' is filled with admiration...

name: The Warrior and the Blade
description: This blade was key in the heroic sagas of Zeorg's youth. Its brilliance consumes Rayas' eyes.

name: An Old Soldier's Ways
description: The Hero never says he's anything more than an old soldier, no matter the tales he's lived to tell. It's just how Zeorg is...

name: A Looming Aura
description: Zeorg, holder of the fabled blade, speaks of the threat they approach. The time draws near!

name: 【EX1】 A Rough Reunion
description: Zeorg decides to test out Rayas' progress with a little swordplay.

name: Approaching the Demon Dragon
description: Fen is also pursuing the Demon Dragon the sword warned about. He splits up from Rayas and Zeorg to find it.

name: The Demon Dragon and the Hero
description: What connection does the Dragon have with Zeorg? Are these legends of yore hiding something?

name: The Secret of the Sagas
description: Is Famelle's great secret hidden in Zeorg's sagas? And what of the truth of the Demon Dragon?

name: Zeorg's Resolve
description: Zeorg is in no position to speak the truth, but Rayas' faith in the Legend never wavers.

name: The Truth of the Legend
description: Zeorg's heroism reveal the true terror of the Dragon. It must be stopped before it's too late!

name: The Dragon and the Tower
description: The party reaches Silkira, where the Dragon has taken refuge. The end is near... Stay sharp!

name: Following the Legend
description: The party prepares for the final showdown with the Dragon. Can Rayas defeat the Demon Dragon of the Legend?

name: Battle Plan
description:
The Demon Dragon is coming for Ryude Magus.
Can it be stopped?

name: The Demon Dragon is Near
description: As they approach the top, Ryude Magus grows anxious. The end is nigh!

name: Beyond Legendary
description: The Demon Dragon awaits them at the top of Silkira. It will take all their strength to defeat it!

name: 【EX2】 Pride of the Soldier
description: "I want to be stronger than anyone..." Rayas gives his all in a duel with Zeorg!

name: 【SPEX】 Those Who Succeed
description: Your eyes flame with ambition as you face Zeorg! Show the Hero your true strength!

name: Dakyuon Defensive Battle [INT]
description: A giant mutant Dakyuon appears in front of you! As you get closer, you realize it's not going to be easy...

name: Dakyuon Defensive Battle [ADV]
description: The Dakyuon devours everything in its path. you cannot leave it alone!

name: Dakyuon Defensive Battle [PRO]
description: The Dakyuon's rampage grows out of control. Can you handle the situation?!

name: Dakyuon Defensive Battle [AWK]
description: The giant Dakyuon attack continues! Don't hesitate to counter-attack!

name: Go Help Fen!
description:
A letter from Ru says that Fen's in danger! 
Hurry and head toward him!

name: Through the Desert
description: Dara Desert is full of monsters. Don't let your guard down!

name: What Danger is Fen in?
description: The letter only says "Fen is in Danger". What exactly happened to him?

name: In the Middle of the Desert
description:
The heat and monsters are getting to you.
But you can't stop now!

name: Beyond the Hot Desert
description:
You're almost there.
Hurry through Coroc Road!

name: The Place Written in the Letter
description:
Rayas and Iris arrived to the specified place,
but there seems to be no one around...

name: A Sudden Attack of Monsters
description: Countless monsters are attacking Rayas and the others. Is this what led Fen into danger?

name: Chaos in the Coroc Road
description:
Rayas and the others keep fighting against the monsters.
But they don't seem to stop.

name: So Many Monsters!
description: Coroc Road is full of monsters, even too many. What is happening?

name: Live-or-Die Battle in the Forest
description:
Rayas is still fighting against the monsters.
There seems to be even stronger ones coming.

name: [EX1] Strategist's Warm-Up
description:
The strategist points his sword to Rayas: 
"My skills may be a bit dull, but be my guest".

name: Going After Fen
description:
Going red, Fen rushes out of sight.
Rayas and the others go after him.

name: Iris Curiosity
description:
The party is now going through the wetlands.
Iris seems to be curious about Fen's past.

name: Struggling in Thought and On Foot
description: Rayas wonders about how Fen and Ru met in the first place...

name: The Past of Fen and Ru
description: While the party is going after Fen, Iris keeps asking Ru about their past...

name: Where Fen Awaits
description: Rayas and Iris are back on track after listening to Ru's story. Their goal is so close!

name: Who was Waiting?
description: Rayas and the others are now where Fen should be. But something happens out of the blue.

name: Unexpected Contingencies?
description: Ru disappearing? Leaving apologies, and then? A bunch of monsters... What is happening!?

name: Ferocious Attack in the Wilds
description:
Fen still cannot be found...
You must bear against the attacks of monsters.

name: A Sudden Turn
description: Still fighting against monsters, the situation that strikes Rayas and the others is highly unexpected.

name: The Truth
description:
Fen suddenly attacks Rayas.
You need to find out why!

name: [EX2] Fen Takes it Seriously
description:
"You cheeky guy. Suck it up!"
Fen becomes more ferocious.

name: [SPEX] The Solitary Strategist
description:
"From now is our true battle."
The smile disappeares from the strategist's face.

name: 孤高の道
description:
昔と今。変わりゆく心境に戸惑うフェン。
軍師は気付く。その力は何の為のものなのか。

name: 【限定EX2】戦慄の刻
description:
「生きて帰れたら褒めてやろう。」
その一言は確実な死の未来を予見させた。

name: Daily Quest!
description:
Limited attempts!  Get materials to enhance
and evolve your Units and Equipment!

name: 【EX】Watcher of the Ancient Forest
description:
Who is it that forbids entry to this forest?
It is said that this forest has existed since the world was born.

name: 【SPEX】The Ancient Dragon Defender
description: The Watcher standing quiet guard, has crossed the time's barrier to guard the Ancient Forest and its master.

name: 【AWK】A Protector's Pride
description:
What has this warrior transcended time itself
 to protect? See the answer yourself!

name: A Mysterious Beautiful Cilent
description:
Who exactly is this client waiting for
Rayas on the Plains of Isliid?

name: The Lady Demon was Alive
description:
The client was Nier?!  Lost in confusion,
Rayas revisits Gormarey.

name: The Sad Life
description:
"I want to stop Nier's rebirth..."
The clone says, her eyes filled with sadness.

name: A Clone's Pride
description:
Rayas, sensing that the clone is sincere and determined,
promises to fulfill her job request.

name: Towards Freedom
description:
The clone seems happy telling Rayas about the future.
The abominable device is just ahead!

name: 【EX1】A Shadow Stands in the Way
description:
Another clone of Nier lurks in the fortress, guarding the equipment.
Lay her pitiful soul to rest.

name: 【SPEX】 Clones Amok
description:
Having tasted power, the clone has grown arrogant.
Stop her rampage!

name: 【SPEX-Hyper】 Clone Arrogance
description:
She’s surpassed the original!
The clone smiles haughtily as she unleashes her true power!

name: 【AWK】The Serpent of Demise
description:
The true monster appears to devour the forged shell.
Her venom brings death to all it touches.

name: Where's the Receptionist?
description: Ganan orders Rayas and Iris to follow Est to Agrana Volcano.

name: A Worried Father
description: When it comes to Est, even tough old Ganan can't hide his fatherly side. It'd be nice to help him calm down, but...

name: Everyone Loves Est
description: Est, the beautiful receptionist, is quite popular at the Arena. Maybe Ganan's right to be worried...

name: Ganan's Wife
description: Neither Rayas nor Iris has seen Ganan's wife before... What is she like?

name: Warlike Receptionist
description: It looks like Est has thinned out the monsters around here... She certainly takes after her father!

name: Est's Goal
description: What is Est up to all alone out here? She's clearly had more than enough training...

name: What Kind of Pests?
description: Iris is intent on hearing more about Est, but Rayas isn't sure how to answer...

name: Where is Est Going?
description: Est is leaving a clear trail through the cavern. She's headed deep inside...

name: Depths of the Volcano
description: Only someone with a very good reason would come all this way. So what is Est's?

name: Save Est!
description: A colossus stands before Est! She's in danger alone... Back her up!

name: 【EX】To Be Even Stronger
description: Est is obsessed with greater and greater strength. Now she wants to challenge Rayas!

name: Ghosts of Medera
description: Est heads for Demonseal Tower Medela, with its rumored Demon ghost. Ganan joins the fight! It's not over yet!

name: Tracks in the Tundra
description: The friends follow Est's trail. Hurry to catch up before the weather erases all trace!

name: A Deadly Shortcut
description: It looks like Est is taking a shortcut to Medela. But this path is full of danger!

name: Fresh Tracks
description: Est's footprints are growing ever fresher. She must be near!

name: Mother's Presence
description: It looks like the reason for Est setting out has to do with her mother. But catching her comes first!

name: Father and Daughter
description: Rayas thinks back on the constant fighting between Ganan and Est. This probably won't go well...

name: The Hatted Woman
description: A mysterious woman in a hat waits at Medela. Who is this woman who seems to know Est...?

name: An Overpowering Aura
description: A feeling just like that time at Gormarey... Something very dangerous is here!

name: Catch up with Est!
description: With this powerful aura, Est is in huge danger on her own. She must be found soon!

name: The Sword Master's Daughter
description: Est's breath is taken away by the approaching aura. But she resolves to stay strong and stand her ground.

name: 【EX2】If I Defeat You...
description: Rayas has dealt with Demons before, he must have the strength! Or so Est thinks...

name: 【SPEX】Dark Twilight
description: Whether the Demon is real or fake, only one thing is clear. The time for battle is at hand!

name: 【EX1】Attack of the Androids
description: Ancient androids suddenly attack you. Fight with all your hidden power!

name: 【EX2】Invasion Anew
description: The rampage of the past is revives in the present. Can you survive these overwhelming attacks?

name: 【SPEX】Full Power
description: The androids unleash their full power. The legend rips away the veil!

name: 【AWK】Overdrive
description: Victory means not survival but annihilation. Full-power cannons perforate the sky, even at risk of self-destruction.

name: Just Another Patrol
description: Ru goes to town with Rolly, while Rayas leaves for his regular patrol.

name: A Quiet Afternoon
description: Gentle sunlight falls over the world. The plains seem to be the same as ever.

name: Strange Omens
description: While Rayas is on patrol, Ru and Rolly make a strange discovery.

name: Rayas' Worry
description: The plains seem the same as ever, but Rayas can't shake the feeling that something is wrong.

name: Unknown Creature
description: Something strange is happening in the plains. Rayas discovers the cause.

name: To the Cave of Lava
description: Fen joins Rayas. Could Rolly and Ru be here?

name: Scorched Path
description: The lava cave roils with blazing heat. Save your energy!

name: Disturbed Dwellers in Flame
description: The beasts living in the cave are acting oddly. It appears something is afoot...

name: An Approaching Emergency
description: The disturbance in the lava cave is making Rayas nervous. Are Rolly and Ru safe?

name: Cave Climax
description: Rolly and Ru are safe from the plants, but things can't be left like this...

name: [EX1] Mystery Plant
description: A rare plant bares its fangs at Rayas. Be ready for anything!

name: [EX2] Plants Attack!
description: Swarms of mysterious plants are on the attack. Stop them before they spread!

name: [SPEX] Plant Charmer
description: The boss of the monster plants finally shows itself. Prepare to face this incredible powerhouse!

name: A Funny-Looking Demon?!
description:
Reigrad is in an Autumn festival mood. But Ganan 
 has news of a strange Demon appearance!

name: One who Stands before the Demon
description:
The Demon they call Jack-O-Sherum
 has appeared again. It's a race to defeat it!

name: A Mixed Up Night
description:
Iris says she has an idea to get rid of 
 Jack-O-Sherum. And who is this mysterious swordsman?

name: 【EX1】 A Wandering Ghost
description:
The Spirit World is closest in this season. 
 And wandering spirits find their way here...

name: 【SPEX】 Indelible Tenacity
description:
The wandering spirits appear without cease. 
 There is only one choice... to fight.

name: 【Despair】 Violent Magical Armor
description:
Jack-O-Sherum has unleashed all his power. 
 Despair spreads before his awesome might!

name: 【Limited EX】 Evil Orange Eyes
description: Spooky light glows in the eye socket of the pumpkin. Don't be tricked by the sweet smell!

name: 【SPEX Hyper】Autumn of Suffering
description:
The colorful gourds cackle in unison.
Soon, the world will be swallowed by disaster.

name: 【EX1】 God's Pride
description:
A swordsman sworn to the Higher Gods appears. 
He assaults Rayas with cold murder in his eyes!

name: 【EX2】 The Azure Sword
description:
The azure swordsman wields a mighty blade and impenetrable shield. 
You must penetrate his defenses to find victory!

name: 【SPEX】 Peerless Loyalty and Bravery
description:
For the Higher Gods...
The swordsman's will surpasses
his own limits, to discover new strength!

name: 【AWK】A Garden of Waves
description:
He changes the battlefield into a blue orchard.
Each blade stroke carries the weight of his devotion.

name: 【DREAM】Streak of Devotion
description: It is not death he fears but dishonor. Therefore, he plunges faster and deeper into battle.

name: Prelude to Destruction
description:
The world of Raktehelm is threatened like never before when
Godzilla, the colossal Kaiju, attacks.

name: Despair and Hope
description: Each attempt to stop Godzilla only hastens his evolution. Even as despair sets in, everyone does their part to keep hope alive.

name: The Fated Demise
description: The ruler of ruin, Godzilla, wields fathomless power. The forces of Raktehelm gather for one last, desperate strike.

name: Return of Disaster
description: Godzilla rises once more from the forgotten depths. However, a new dragon-like monster also joins the fray.

name: Conclusive Clash
description: As Godzilla and King Ghidorah do battle, all of Raktehelm can only watch and pray that their own ends will be spared.

name: [SPEX] Monstrosity of Doom
description:
The terrifying legend has become reality....
Stand your ground and defend Raktehelm!

name: [SPEX Hyper] Terror of Raktehelm
description:
The horror that threatens all has awoken...
Fight its flames that will scorch all in its path!

name: Twin Knights of the Morning Star
description: The legendary Twin Knights of the Morning Star stand right there! But they don't seem to notice Rayas...

name: Passing the Magic Stone Marsh
description: The Twin Knights of the Morning Star are trying to cross the Magic Stone Marsh Ga Vaar. Where are they going?

name: After the War
description: The Knights survived the Ancient War and then traveled around the world.

name: A World without Gods and Demons
description: Rayas, who knows the true history, reconsiders his point of view in light of Regulus' doubts.

name: The Legendary Witness
description: Rayas' pursuit of the heroes leads him to a place he'd never imagined.

name: The Unwritten Story
description: Everyone knows the story of the Knights from books. But Rayas wants to find out what happened next.

name: The Curse of the God Eater
description: Regulus made a fatal error when facing the God Eater, but no one seems to have noticed...

name: The Twin Knights of Light and Dark
description: They may be called Twin Knights, but they are truly opposites...

name: The Sorrowful Crow
description: Unaware of the God Eater's curse, Regulus falls deeper into envy towards Feena.

name: The Last of the Twin Knights
description: Rayas witnesses the final unknown story about the two Knights. Their sad finale comes to light.

name: 【EX】 The Raven's Outcast
description: Defend yourself from this man called the outcast of the Raven's Aegis.

name: 【EX2】 The Holy Knight
description: Can you stop the blazing attacks of the Knight of Light, who once ascended to the ranks of the Gods?

name: 【SPEX】 The Twin Knights Stand
description: These opposing poles stand together... Can you go beyond the legends standing in your path?

name: Tailing with Disappointment
description:
Rayas doesn't feel like tailing Melia.
He starts moving with Roy's words in his mind.

name: No Clues
description:
No clues so far about Melia.
They don't call her the "Blue-eyed Black Fox" for nothing.

name: The Shadow in Gormarey
description:
Rayas has found Melia.
He follows her until Gormarey, where they once fought together...

name: The Black Fox Disappeared
description:
Rayas lost sight of Melia. She shouldn't be far.
Let's look around.

name: Secret Meetings with the Demons
description:
Melia is talking to Nier, the demon they once defeated.
What is going on...?

name: Ready to Face Each Other
description:
Melia is serious about this battle.
Rayas asks himself if he is ready for this.

name: The Black Fox at a Loss
description:
Rayas remembers Melia's attitude.
She definitely wasn't herself, what happened to her?

name: To Continue to Believe
description:
Rayas needs to clear Melia's suspicion.
That's because he believes in her.

name: The Black Fox Returns
description:
Although Rayas lost track of Melia,
he finds her once again, but...

name: What It is to "Believe"
description:
Melia forces Rayas to come after her. Who awaits them...?
Rayas's belief shows the truth.

name: 【EX1】The Blue-eyed Black Fox
description:
Melia, intelligence officer and vice-commander of the 3rd Magus Division of La Riiz.
Can you fight against her powerful attacks?

name: 【EX2】Her Dark Expressions
description:
You've never seen Melia in such facial expressions.
Can you go beyond her powers as a spy?

name: 【SPEX】La Riiz's Secret Precepts
description:
Melia chants the secret precepts of La Riiz.
Is it possible to win against her with all her powers released?

name: 1st Anniversary Limited Daily Quest
description:
1st Anniversary Limited Daily Quest!
Challenge every day and get awesome rewards!

name: Giant in the Snow
description:
A Giant has suddenly appeared and is pillaging the people.
Rayas heads to the snowfield to stop the atrocity.

name: Chasing Santa(?)
description:
For some reason the Giant is dressed as Santa.
No one knows why, but the Giant must be stopped.

name: Battle with Santa(?)
description:
The Giant continues to threaten the people.
Rayas must stop this, especially for Iris.

name: 【EX1】 Bout with the Giant
description:
Rayas has developed a friendship with the Giant.
So they decide to have a little bout to see who's stronger.

name: 【EX2】 Battle with a Friend
description:
Although it's a friendly bout, it's still serious business.
Give it your all to show respect for the opponent.

name: 【SPEX】 Truth of the Giant
description:
Rayas has set a fire in the Giant's heart.
Now the Giant shows it's true brutal nature towards Rayas.

name: The Girls' Holy Debate
description: They pick up their swords and hold tight their small yet unyielding beliefs.

name: Hime's Daily Crunch Quest!
description:
Crunchyroll-Hime challenges you!
Fight GS legends & Hime for rewards!

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 1
description:
Ruins are appearing in various places.
It seems there is special divine protection...

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 2
description:
Only those who belong to flames can enter.
There seems to be paintings on the walls...

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 3
description:
You can hear roaring sounds from where you are heading to.
You must brace yourself!

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 4
description:
It's getting hotter and hotter the more you go in...
Wipe off your sweat and move forward!

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 5
description:
You can hear roaring sounds from where you are heading to.
You must brace yourself!

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 6
description:
Suddenly, silence surrounds you. Even flames are silent...
The guardian has shown itself…

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 7
description:
Roars reverberate throughout the Hellfire Ruins. 
Their source, a Dragon of Ice, appears before the adventurers.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 8
description: Go through the flames, avoiding the Frozen Overlord, beyond the haze

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 9
description:
At the end of the path through the burning ruins.
A mysterious bird attacks, trying to drown out the flames with a blizzard.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 10
description: At the presumed endpoint, there was one last obstacle standing among the flames, its feet tangled in tough ivy.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 11
description:
At the end of the scorching ruins stands a giant wrapped in a biting chill.
Like an unstoppable glacier, he forbids all intruders.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 12
description:
Beyond the molten lava awaits a spirit of frost.
A silvery chill numbs even the intense blaze.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 13
description:
An artificial creature defiles the sacred flames.
With ice-blue claws, it mercilessly slaughters prey.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 14
description: A phantasmal dragon settles among the blaze, its own dark fires stifling all light.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 15
description:
The crazed scorpion crawls among the ruins,
roaring flames and deadly needle swaying.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 16
description: Acidic rain falls over the inferno, bringing not nourishment but ruin.

name: Inferno Ruins - Area 17
description: A great commander manifests in the red. Wielding her subordinate's might, she dyes the flames black.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 1
description:
Ruins are appearing in various places.
It seems there is special divine protection…

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 2
description:
Without the protection of water, no one can enter.
The beautiful insides somewhat make you uncomfortable…

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 3
description:
Am I seeing a mirage?
The scenery is so beautiful to think so.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 4
description:
The scenery does not change a bit no matter how long you walk.
Is this really the correct way?

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 5
description:
Suddenly a flash of sword light slashes the air.
There is no time to be flustered!

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 6
description:
You've fought off the countless enemies.
There the guardian is, as if it had been waiting for you.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 7
description: The adventurer proceed through the ruins, his ears battered by roars. And suddenly, a Dragon of Life appears from the earth.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 8
description: Defeat the Verdant Dragon and head deeper into the ruins. The shadow of a man standing in the spray of water has twin swords in his hands.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 9
description: The far end, led by the mysterious water-covered ruins.The evil bird manipulates the Thunderbolt to make the water surface surge.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 10
description: After driving away the evil bird, the ruins continued. Beyond, a fiery deity waited, its anger generating endless steam.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 11
description:
A storm-brewing beast tears through the mists.
Its prey has no chance of escape once in sight.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 12
description:
A hideous creature roars from deep within the mists.
End its miserable existence!

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 13
description:
Twin roars echo throughout the frozen temple.
Its razor-sharp tail rips through flesh like air.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 14
description: A dazzling beast appears from the waterfall. Its resounding roar brings death to mind.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 15
description:
The breath of the burning roc melts
adventurers and ruins alike.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 16
description: The silent ruins are overwhelmed by ivy's superior life force.

name: Aqua Ruins - Area 17
description: A great commander manifests in the blue. Wielding her subordinate's might, she illuminates the placid surface.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 1
description:
Ruins are appearing in various places.
It seems there is special divine protection…

name: Forest Ruins - Area 2
description:
Only the ones who life with nature can enter this ruin.
Be aware of the enemies in the shadows of evergreen.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 3
description:
It seems there are plants that you don't normally see.
Be careful not to touch them…

name: Forest Ruins - Area 4
description:
You've got used to moving forward  through the green.
So far there's nothing noteworthy…

name: Forest Ruins - Area 5
description:
With a cry so large it rips the air, the Emerald Bird flies in your way!
In order to move on, you must defeat it.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 6
description:
Strangely, hot wind blows against you.
The guardian quietly stands in front of you.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 7
description:
The lushly overgrown ruins are suddenly engulfed in flames. 
The flames of the divine Fire Dragon will burn all!

name: Forest Ruins - Area 8
description: Having defeated the Inferno Dragon, further into the forest. A shadowy figure peers at you with inferno blazes in their eyes.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 9
description:
The thickly wooded ruins come to an abrupt end.
A giant bird flies in to destroy the trees with scorching heat.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 10
description: The settling blazes opened a new path. A fortress of ice, disturbed by the intruders, opened its eyes.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 11
description:
The calm of the forest is interrupted by a wild inferno.
Even towering trees are consumed by the spirit's searing flames.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 12
description:
A towering inferno looms over the wooded expanse,
threatening to raze all with blazing fists.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 13
description:
When the fox spirit appears, the moon will dim
and the verdant temple will glow with her flames.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 14
description: A low howl emerges from the dark forest as a baneful odor crushes the bravest souls.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 15
description:
The silent flash of her divine swords
instantly rends all life in the overgrowth.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 16
description: The canopy is wrapped in a fierce blaze that consumes existence.

name: Forest Ruins - Area 17
description: A great commander manifests in the green. Wielding her subordinate's might, she pollutes the forest with despair.

name: Seeking the Key to Peace
description: Freed has doubts about the end of the Ancient War that once threw the world into chaos.

name: Determination to Leave
description: Freed resolves to set out on a trip to investigate the end of the war after gaining new intel from Rishley.

name: His Research Buddy
description: Now that Freed has decided to set out on his journey for truth, he asks a friend for help.

name: The Four Searchers
description: The journey starts with the researcher Louvet and the shady Onfuan, former intelligence operative of La Riiz.

name: Beauty and the Beast
description: A legendary beast appears so soon after the journey begins! What is it after?

name: The Uninvited Madam
description: Sonije, the girl the party saved from the monster, forces her way into the group.

name: A Cheerful Journey
description: The five travelers enjoy a pleasant journey. However, these five will eventually be known as the Five Freedom Fighters.

name: Approaching the Sealed Fortress
description: The travelers head toward Gormarey. What lies in the fortress sealed away by the Five Great Nations?

name: The Truth of History
description: As the history they've been taught starts to fall apart, the travelers move to investigate the depths of Gormarey.

name: The Truth that Awaits
description: The truth of the end of the Ancient War awaits them in the depths of the fortress.

name: 【EX1】 Guardian of Orphanage
description: A woman who has guarded this orphanage for a very long time now unleashes her power. Who is she, really?

name: 【EX2】 The Fierce Princess
description: The lovely princess reveals her hidden expression of a vicious, axe-wielding warrior.

name: 【SPEX】Android and the Princess
description: The axe-wielding princess and the heavy-weapon android give chase. You must fight back with all your might!

name: Battle in Another Place
description:
While Celia stays in Bamint, Rayas
and the others head to 
the Magus Empire of La Riiz.

name: The Path Each One Goes
description:
The party moves through La Riiz.
Rayas seems to be worried about Celia.

name: Celia's Abilities
description:
While Celia is busy investigating 
about the conspiracy,
Rayas asks Melia a question.

name: Behind the Alliance
description:
There seems to be something fishy 
going on between Bamint and La Riiz...

name: The Radicals' Hideout
description:
Although being attacked, Rayas and the others 
can't stop now. On the other hand, Celia heads 
to the hideout of the radicals.

name: The Surprising Intrigue
description:
There is a connection between
La Riiz and the Demons.
Rayas doesn't know yet...

name: Hot Heart, Cold Head
description:
Celia understood that she was a pawn 
in the Demons plans,
but she doesn't lose her temper.

name: The Urgent Message
description:
Rayas and the others are headed toward 
the center of La Riiz. At the same time, 
Celia receives an urgent message.

name: Riot Spreads
description:
From the outset of La Riiz and Bamint,
riot spreads across the world.

name: Each One's Duties
description:
Celia has finally tracked down the radicals.
Now she must end this battle.

name: [EX1] The Princess Teaches You
description:
The first Princess of Bamint, Celia will be
teaching sword skills to Rayas.

name: [SPEX] Noble Power
description:
It is time for the Princess of a high noble family 
to show her real powers.
Do not hesitate and challenge her.

name: Secret Deal with the Messenger
description: After getting caught up in the shock from the Five Freedom Fighters' fight at Gormarey, he awakens in an unfamiliar forest.

name: Assassin Approaching
description: Grohl has been watching Sonije and her family. His blade draws near...

name: The Lady's Worries
description: Sonije mulls over inviting Onfuan to their abode after she is deceived by the disguised Grohl.

name: Assassin's Trap
description: Grohl pursues Sonije as she does just what he set her up to do. What will she do next...?

name: The Gap Deepens
description: Onfuan tries to show Sonije how she's been deceived, but battle seems inevitable.

name: The Scholar's Premonition
description: As Sonije and Onfuan face off, Louvet gets a bad feeling...

name: Risking One's Life
description: Grohl returns to the battlefield to find only Onfuan's corpse and Sonije's severed arm.

name: The Last Target
description: Grohl moves on the last two of the Five Freedom Fighters, now unprotected by their barrier.

name: The Secret Days
description: At the same time, a shocking event leads to the end of Rishley and Freed's quiet life in hiding.

name: Reunion
description: Freed is bewildered by Rishley's last words. That face beneath the mask, that voice... Could it be?

name: 【EX1】 Sorcerer of Barrier
description: Former intelligence operative Onfuan's mastery of barrier magic protected the Five Freedom Fighters. Can you take him?

name: 【EX2】 Dragon Scholar's Insight
description: Dragon scholar Louvet has pierced the veil covering the truth of history. Stand against his brilliant tactics!

name: 【SPEX】 Fighters' Last Wishes
description: The Five Freedom Fighters tried to change history. Surpass their power and inherit their final wish!

name: The Shadow of Marzex
description: Rayas doubts the mysterious lady claiming to know of Marzex's sudden return.

name: An Acquaintance of Ganan
description: Though Riana says she knows Ganan, there is an unusual age gap between them.

name: Heir of the Sword Master
description: She turns out to be a descendant of the Sword Master, and her words greatly confuse Rayas.

name: The Youthful Swordswoman
description: Cursed with perennial youth, Riana's body remains in top condition...at a price.

name: Miasma
description: What does Marzex have to do with this dark energy?

name: Riana & Ganan
description: Riana spares no detail in telling Rayas of her most romantic encounter.

name: A Reason to Live
description: In yet another tale, Riana shares how family led her to an eye-opening realization.

name: Riana & Est
description: Following in her mother's footsteps, Est makes Riana proud.

name: Est's Sentiment
description: As Est recognizes her feelings towards her parents, her mother beams as if connected by the heart.

name: The Miasma's True Form
description: Rayas & Riana climb up Demonseal Tower Medera. What secrets does this miasma hold?

name: [EX] The Capricious Combatant
description: Can you take on this fencing fiend?!

name: [SPEX] The Sword Master
description: Try to hold out against the warrior of legendary lineage!

name: [SPEX Hyper] The Shining Blade
description: Time to surpass the miasma-absorbing swordswoman!

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 1
description:
Ruins are appearing in various places.
It seems there is special divine protection…

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 2
description:
Only those celebrated by light can enter.
The shining ruins will catch your breath.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 3
description:
So silent, it is like the ruins are completely forgotten.
Be careful and move forward.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 4
description:
Even one step feels so loud.
The cold light makes you lonely.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 5
description:
Even light feels so heavy.
Will you be able to conquer whatever waits ahead?

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 6
description:
Suddenly darkness fills the area.
The guardian shining so bright stands in your way!

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 7
description:
A shadow stands in the way of the adventurer.
From the dark, the Hadean Dragon shows itself.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 8
description: Having laid the Hadean Dragon to rest, you climb its corpse and head forth. A figure lies in wait with a greatsword in hand, ready to do battle.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 9
description: At the end of a long path through the light-flooded ruins. A devil's armor casts a shadow over the destination.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 10
description:
When the cursed armor shatters, another 
path is formed. A powerful new enemy then 
attacks, leaving no time for shock.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 11
description: Princess of insects emerges from the pouring light. The spearhead glints ominously as she points it at you.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 12
description:
Silvery wings cast a shadow against the 
white light. With a great roar, the  
adventurers shiver with fear.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 13
description:
A shadow of madness wavers in the radiance.
Light-rending claws assault all who approach.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 14
description:
A divine blaze overpowers the ruins' gleam.
That torrent of heat engulfs the brave souls.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 15
description: An ominous gloom pervades these sacred grounds. Deep-rooted malice clings around those who enter.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 16
description:
Inside the complete void of the Spirit,
everything becomes nothing.

name: Luminous Ruins - Area 17
description: A great commander manifests in the light. Her absolute justice holds sway over the holy domain.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 1
description:
Ruins are appearing in various places.
It seems there is special divine protection...

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 2
description:
Only those with shadows can enter.
Don't let the darkness get you...

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 3
description:
It feels depressing inside.
Don't lose yourself...

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 4
description:
Not only the monsters but the dark pressure
makes you want to escape...

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 5
description:
Suddenly a huge roar fills the area.
The Demonic Dragon bares its fangs.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 6
description:
The dragon is gone and light shines.
The guardian full of darkness is in your way!

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 7
description:
A flash lightened up the darkness in this pitch-dark ruin.
Now the Radiant Dragon has arrived to give judgement to the adventurer.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 8
description: Overcoming the Radiant Dragon, you press forth. The light envelops a figure standing in prayer.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 9
description: At the deepest end of the ruins shrouded in darkness. Benevolent Annihilator's blinding flash rips through the gloom.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 10
description:
A heavenly presence protects this passage.
At the end, a Spirit of light awaits with an eerie smile.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 11
description: An agent of corrosion emerges from the gloom. Its cursed roar echoes through the dusty halls.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 12
description:
A god of death sneers in the lightless ruins.
Avoid the fatal edge of its scythe and defeat it!

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 13
description:
When the master of the arcane awakens,
uncanny visions will illuminate the darkness.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 14
description:
Jade lightning echoes from the black depths,
ready to cast judgment upon the foolish intruders.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 15
description: Time slows to a halt then reverses direction as a defiant deity wields his powers with impunity.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 16
description:
A heavy, dull sound paralyzes the adventurers.
Her spear has just pierced an ally's skull.

name: Shadow Ruins - Area 17
description: A great commander manifests in the darkness. His surging willpower clears away the haze.

name: Strange Request
description: Rayas has been given a truly odd job by Fen. What is he after?

name: An Assassin's Mind
description: Rayas is struggling with this unusual job of pretending to be an assassin.

name: All over the Land
description: Rayas continues his survey of the target areas in a route that stretches across Gramenia.

name: Presidential Approval
description: Rayas is enjoying his trip since the pass he received gives him unrestricted access to Gramenia.

name: Hidden Menace
description: There are more threats against the president than just assassins. Rayas hurries toward his objective.

name: Obstacle Clearance
description: Dangerous monsters could appear at any moment. Rayas' exhausting search continues.

name: The Strange Plan
description: The survey areas are filled with peril. Why is the president even taking this tour?

name: Private Meeting
description: Fen and Kane are Rayas' clients for this job, but what are the two really after?

name: Final Stretch
description: The survey is nearing its end, but not before Rayas senses a terrible presence.

name: The Abnormality
description: The reports never mentioned this beast! This is the true threat to the president's tour!

name: [EX1] Fen's Comrade
description: Rayas has been challenged to a match by a man calling himself an old friend of Fen's. How strong is he?

name: [EX2] National Defense
description: Face the might that protects an entire nation!

name: [SPEX] The Man at the Top
description: Kane is president of the Gramenia Republic. See just how much power the leader of this nation bears!

name: 【EX】 Dragon General Stands
description: A Dragon general whose name echoes through history arrive, surrounded in solemnity. Can you answer his fearful blade?

name: 【SPEX】 The Dragon Sword's Attack
description: An unparalleled general of the Dragons attacks. Evade his all destroying blade and strike back!

name: 【AWK】 Dragon General's Conviction
description: A Dragon General who seeks an end to Humanity itself appears. Face him with all your resolve to preserve a future for all!

name: An 'Alien' Encounter
description: A monster on the loose and girls in pursuit?! Rayas has to chase them to find out what's going on!

name: Three Mysterious Girls
description: Strange girls appear as Rayas and Mira travel through the forest. Who could they be?

name: Chasing the Mystery Monster
description: Ryuko and the others have joined Rayas, and now must find the beast to discover the truth!

name: The Painful Truth!
description: It appears the monster wasn't driven by Life Fibers... But then what is the monster standing before them?!

name: [EX1] Puppet Monster
description: This monster is controlled by something similar to Life Fibers... But now, the starved monster bares its fangs!

name: [EX2] Pulling the Strings
description: Mutation has given rise to bizarre creatures... They must defeat the outsider controlling the monsters!

name: [SPEX] Assault of the Mimics
description: The monsters are controlling the doppelgangers! But beware... their hidden strength is nothing to laugh at.

name: [SPEX Hyper] The Mutant Species
description: Crossover Gem has a chance to drop from this challenging five-times-daily quest!

name: [SPEX Nui] The Bloody Rematch
description:
Better chance to get Crossover Equips!
Five times per day only "Bonus Quest".

name: Damage Battle
description: More rewards for more DMG! Take along KILL la KILL Crossover units for an edge!

name: Challenge Quest Satsuki
description: Test your might against Satsuki! Come out on top and get Crossover Tickets!

name: Challenge Quest Sanageyama
description: Test your might against Uzu! Come out on top and get Crossover Tickets!

name: The Forest Archer
description: Rayas awakens in an unfamiliar forest. He finds a lone girl training intently with a bow.

name: Towards the Kingdom
description: The Crimson Stars are headed towards the kingdom for a performance. It's about time to set up camp.

name: The Grand Kingdom
description: The Crimson Stars have reached their destinaiton. The city is bustling in preparation for the once-in-a-decade festival!

name: In Search of a Spot
description: Mamori is looking for a place to set up their stage, but she's having some trouble.

name: Proper Base Building
description: Diaz and Pientz are looking for a place to set up camp, but for some reason, they seem to be very intent about the location...

name: The Show Begins!
description: The Crimson Stars put on their first performance. There's still a few days until the festival, but the seats are full and everyone is abuzz.

name: Chaos and Confusion
description: It is the morning after the mysterious attack, and Mamori has gone to the nearby woods to calm her nerves.

name: The Crimson Stars' Decision
description: The Crimson Stars put their performance on hold after the attack and try to figure out what's going on.

name: Before the Great Festival
description: The night before the kingdom's great festival, Mamori sits alone, staring up at the sky in disappointment.

name: Why Fight?
description: Mamori is stunned by the true strength of her allies as they face the assassins' attack.

name: [EX1] Master Assassin
description: Can you evade the bullets of this master assassin, stained with the blood of countless targets?

name: [EX2] The Art of Killing
description: This master assassin will take any contract if the price is right. Don't let your guard down for an instant, lest it cost you your life.

name: [SPEX] Assassin's Pride
description: The legendary assassin shows his pride. It will take all your skill to survive this battle!

name: 【EX】Pierrot in Flames
description: A pierrot clad in flame appears. What does this smiling man want?

name: 【SPEX】 Unleashed Magic Beasts
description: The beasts called out by the pierrot surround you. Fight your way free!

name: 【AWK】 Greatest Show of the Century
description: The unending herd of beasts goes into a frenzy. Muster all your strength for this life and death battle!

name: All Alone
description: Mamori has been sent away by Diaz and Pientz, and now wanders the woods, dazed and alone.

name: Like Ashe Toto
description: Mamori has mimicked tales of the heroes her whole life.  Now, what does she have to defend?

name: Two Avengers
description: The Crimson Stars set about fulfilling their true goals now that Mamori has left them.

name: Best Laid Plans...
description: The assassins are still after Diaz and Pientz.  Are their plans so easily shattered?

name: This Girl Saves the World
description: Diaz lied. It was all for Mamori, who is destined to save the world...

name: The Two Assassins
description: This pair still seeks to kill the Crimson Stars.  Both are among the best at what they do, but they're not the best match.

name: The Royal Army Awaits
description: Sly has alerted the Royal Army. It doesn't look like the two can fight through...

name: Crimson Hatred
description: The two seek vengeance for the pain of their childhoods. And the Crimson Stars are on the warpath now.

name: Morning Ceremony
description: It is the morning before the king reveals himself to his people in a once-in-a-decade ceremony. And someone is moving in the quiet streets.

name: The Crimson Stars
description: Diaz and Pientz have placed their lives on the line to get their revenge. What will come of it? What future have they found?

name: [EX1] War-hungry Cursed Sword
description: Voghan has sculpted his body to kill. Shatter his blood-red blade!

name: [EX2] Assassin's Joy
description: Voghan says his greatest reward is the thrill of the kill.  Can you resist his warped delights?

name: [SPEX] Bloodthirst
description: The beast laughs as it shreds flesh and spills blood. Can you cut it down?

name: Sword Princess Savior
description: Tallis, a hero who served to save her nation... And a powerful swordswoman known as the Ogre Slayer.

name: Great Wish of Gods
description: Tallis' master the King desires a permanent peace between all the races and devotes himself to tireless diplomacy.

name: Six Nation Summit
description: The representative of all the nations besides the Giants and Dragons agreed to a meeting. What shall it bring about?

name: Restraint and Observation
description: The representatives are clearly suspicious of each other. Tallis is careful as she pushes forward with the talks.

name: A Peaceful Approach
description: Tensions are easing as the members start to get a sense of each other. The real talk begins in earnest.

name: Human's Hospitality
description: Jill and the others of the Human host country offer a grand feast, and everyone enjoys the pleasant atmosphere...

name: Suspicious Look
description: The meal was cursed. Lozze and Vicious turn their doubting eyes on Tallis.

name: Uncleared Doubt
description: Tallis insists on her innocence and fervent wish for peace, but Lozze refuses to listen.

name: Full Defense
description: Tallis' defense never falters. But Lozze and Vicious keep stepping up their attacks.

name: Seeking a Perfect World
description: Tallis and Pheles refuse to strike hard and resort to persuasion, all in service to their ideals.

name: [EX1] Radiant Ittoryu
description: Your duel with Tallis, mistress of the Radiant Ittoryu school and Royal Army Fencing Instructor, begins!

name: [EX2] Furious Instincts
description: Can you dodge the wild attacks of the raging PrinceLozze as he gives in to his instincts?

name: [SPEX] Orge Slayer
description: Can you withstand the radiant blade of the salvation of her country, the Ogre Slayer herself?

name: 【EX】Machina Warrior Vicious
description: A Machine warrior born to battle stands in your way. What do her eyes see?

name: 【SPEX】To Stand in Battle
description: Unlike before, she now has her own reasons to fight. But what are they?

name: 【AWK】Weapon Questioning Peace
description: This weapon that knowns only battle has a question. What is a peaceful world? Can you show her the answer?

name: For Peace
description: Will this Six Nation Summit called for peace end in bloodshed?

name: Vicious' Look
description: Tallis' words have moved Lozze' heart. But Vicious fights on without cease.

name: Inefficient Battle
description: Vicious shows no sign of relenting against her three opponents. Tallis and the other can simply endure.

name: Warrior's True Intention
description: Vicious' assault rains down upon the other three. Why does she fight so?

name: Mixie, Once again
description: The Demons have been behind this fight all along. But Tallis, the Savior of the Nation, will never lower her blade.

name: What Lies in the Heart
description: Even greater attacks land on Tallis, to make mockery of her plans. The chaotic battle grows more frantic.

name: Machine's Hatred
description: Mixe falls to Vicious' surprise attack. The Machine is after Talils' life.

name: With Only Revenge
description: Vicious shows her hatred of Tallis for all to see, and steps up her attack again.

name: Ferocious Vicious
description: Hatred is overtaking the cool-headed Machine. Amidst her rampage, Vicious speaks a shocking name.

name: Tallis' Decision
description: Tallis stands against Vicious' rage, twisted will, and assault. All for a distant future...

name: [EX1] A Mysterious Smile
description: A glittering smile plays on the beautiful girl's face as she whispers. Resist the spine-chilling truth behind the smile!

name: [EX2] The Princess Schemer
description: The real beast hiding behind her gentle demeanor runs wild. Expose the truth behind the Ancient War!

name: [SPEX] Mastermind's Exclusion
description: This she-beast lies at the heart of all the doubts about the Ancient War. Expose her to the light!

name: 1st Initiation
description: The tower of tribulations new adventurers face. Show the entrance guards you're worthy!

name: 2nd Initiation
description: Heavily-armored block your way to the next floor. You must defeat him to go forward.

name: 3rd Initiation
description: A giant thrashes the entire floor. Take down this menace before this hulk destroys the tower!

name: 4th Initiation
description: A Pirate King parched for battle strikes! Can you prove yourself to this outrageous warrior?

name: 5th Initiation
description: A dark dragon fuming with fury awaits a new hero... If fear is what you feel, turn back now.

name: 6th Initiation
description: A soldier who harnesses the power of dragons stops your way. Resist his flames and go forth.

name: 7th Initiation
description: A Spirit Archer tests your skills with her arrows. Do not hold back and make your mark!

name: 8th Initiation
description: The path ahead is still long, and you there's no time to be stopped by a shape-shifting soldier!

name: 9th Initiation
description: There is no way to stop to escape her demon scythe, short of ending her life...

name: 10th Initiation
description: There is no way to avoid crossing blades with this prideful Beast Saint. Face him down.

name: 11th Initiation
description: A legendary Dragon God tests your courage. Do not flinch from its burning breath and defeat it.

name: 12th Initiation
description: The angry winged-dragon tests how quickly you fight and think on your feet. Outsmart it to survive!

name: 13th Initiation
description: The cursed bird of storms test your agility! Weave between the lightning bolts and stop its rein!

name: 14th Initiation
description: The Frozen Dragon tests your burning desire to become a true adventurer! Show the fire inside!

name: 15th Initiation
description: The adventurer's journey never ends... Not even against a giant bird spewing down hellfire.

name: To End it All
description: Alvina stands before her mother's grave to say farewell... What is she intending to put an end to?

name: A Letter's Path
description: Alvina sets out on a journey to deliver her mother's words. Who will she find at the end of the road?

name: The Sword and the Spear
description: Alvina searches for a place to stay in the bustling town, filled with travelers.

name: Gate to the Gods Empire
description: Alvina and Lucia sign on as the town's guards. Can they defend the border of the Gods Empire?

name: A Brief Chat
description: Alvina and Lucia grow closer as they keep the town safe.

name: A Demon's Pride
description: Riffili, embarrassed by her run-in with Alvina and Lucia, calls on her Demon friend for help.

name: The Two Temptresses
description: The Demon Army presses on, but Alvina and Lucia refuse to give any ground.

name: Alvina's Will to Kill
description: Alvina pushes Corsair against a wall, but something is happening inside of her...

name: Alvina and Corsair
description: Corsair takes Alvina's relentless attacks. Alvina makes no attempt to hide her murderous rage.

name: Meaning of Family
description: Alvina now defends Corsair, while Corsair watches her back. The bonds of sisterhood run deep.

name: 【EX1】The Azul Spear
description: Alvina freezes all her opponents in ice. Can you resist her vicious spear?

name: 【EX2】Beyond the Blade Master
description: Can you overcome the frigid spear blows that bested Corsair of the Three Blade Masters?

name: 【SPEX】Sorcery of the Frost Spear
description: Will the Frost Spear that mastered the powers of darkness protect Rayas until the end?

name: 【EX】Edgeless Nogia
description:
Nogia, bearer of the Sacred Sword, calmly prepares himself.
Could it be time to draw his blade?

name: 【SPEX】The Sacred Sword
description: Nogia quietly draws his sword. What power will this sword, which slashes that which can't be slashed, show us?

name: 【AWK】The Chosen One
description: Nogia, bearer of the sacred blade's destiny, appears. Follow the path of his destiny with the sacred blade on his back.

name: One who Burns the Earth
description: Palamicia receives orders to subdue a mysterious High Demon that is scorching the lands of Raktehelm.

name: Heart Seeks the Strong
description: Palamicia goes to face Ifrit, hoping that this opponent is truly mighty...

name: Facing the Misfortune
description: Palamicia faces Ifrit, who is scorching the land clean. What kind of battle awaits her?

name: What cannot be Slashed
description: Saved in the nick of time by a mysterious man, Palamicia has no choice but to withdraw.

name: Power of the Stars
description: The man who saved Palamicia tells his story, and his purpose in the pursuit of Ifrit.

name: To Slash Calamity
description: The two prepare to go in search of Ifrit for a new match. Will they find his trail?

name: Palamicia's Determination
description: Palamicia's pace grows forceful as she comes to believe what she's heard about Ifrit's true face.

name: Standing on Burnt Ground
description: Palamicia begins looking for a certain man as she steps foot on the scorched earth left by Ifrit.

name: Another Duel
description: Palamicia and Ifrit are finally facing each other again. What feelings do they bear?

name: Inferno God and Silent Divine
description: Can Palamicia's silent blades strike down this power that incinerates all it touches?

name: 【EX1】 Furious Flames
description: The fiery fighter raises a new battle cry. Withstand his flame-wreathed fists of fury!

name: 【EX2】 Silent Sword Master
description: The beautiful divine swordswoman searching for a mighty opponent silently draws her blades. Stand against the greatest sword arm of the Gods!

name: 【SPEX】 Warrior's Pleasure
description: The Silent Divine and Inferno God's eyes fill with delight. Face the superlative skill of two Gods at once!

name: A Town in Trouble
description:
Reigrad is under attack from countless monsters!
Hurry back and save the city!

name: Heroes Unite!
description: A man of few words introduces himself as a "Hero", offering help. Protect Reigrad with him!

name: The Showdown
description: As Rayas and friends fight to protect the city, the ultimate battle starts in the shadows.

name: ONE PUNCH
description: Rayas and friends hold back the attacks on the city, while Roy's fight comes to a shocking end...

name: 【EX1】 Leader of "Dark Matter"
description: The alien invaders "Dark Matter" stormed the universe and arrived with Boros to Raktehelm...

name: 【EX2】 True Power Unleashed
description: Boros' tremendous power was sealed inside his armor. Now that is unrestrained, you have to face his true strength.

name: 【SPEX】 Ruler of the Universe
description:
The Ruler scoured the galaxy for an equal.
See his power now that his wish has come true!

name: Path to Coexistence
description: The Gods and Demons, and all the races caught up in their conflict... This is a story of hope for those torn by unending enmity.

name: A Young Sorcerer's Fate
description: Early in the Ancient War, one sorcerer fought tooth and nail for his people, even as war swept over them.

name: Lord of the Cave
description: Daki, a sorcerer in the 3rd Dove Brigade, heads to the front lines with his aide, a Meiol named Meo.

name: To the Plains
description: They pass on through the cave. It becomes a struggle to rejoin their squad, as enemies attack from places that should be clear.

name: A Familiar Face
description: Daki speaks to Meo about a man he can't seem to forget. Meo's soul feels the stirrings of fate.

name: What Lies Ahead
description: The plains have become a battlefield, and Daki must cut his way through. Meanwhile, Meo cannot shake his doubts.

name: Conflict Rages
description: Why do we fight? wonders Meo. Even as the war rages around them, Daki listens closely.

name: Mad Demons
description: Daki and Meo have passed through the plains and reached the wastelands. Even as they struggle with their doubts, enemies keep coming.

name: Bound by Fate
description: The dual sword-wielding warrior of the wasteland is that unforgettable man. Daki prepares himself even as he is assailed by doubt.

name: Amidst Struggle
description: Meo's questions continue to echo. What lies beyond battle? And when the duel is decided...

name: [EX1] Warrior of Twin Blades
description: A Demon of the 3rd Raven Brigade. Despite the powerful attacks, there is a softness to this swordsmanship...

name: [EX2] Heart of a Master Swordsman
description: The twin-blade warrior raises a battle cry. To rouse his own spirit, and to honor his mighty father.

name: [SPEX] Thunderous Demon Wings
description: The winged twin-blade warrior has unleashed his ultimate strength. What sights lie beyond this battle?

name: Path to Coexistence
description: The Gods and Demons, and all the races caught up in their conflict... This is a story of hope for those torn by unending enmity.

name: A Young Swordsman's Fate
description: Early in the Ancient War, one twin-blade warrior fought tooth and nail for his people, even as war swept over them.

name: Awakening Master
description: Raki, a twin-blade wielder in the Third Demonic Infantry, heads for battle with his servant Gobl, Gobbie.

name: Plains of Truth
description: They head through the cave, struggling to rejoin their squad as enemies attack from places that should be clear.

name: Face Fate
description: Raki has an odd dream. Who was that man he saw? The answer comes to him in an unexpected way.

name: Amidst Confusion
description: The God sorcerer facing Raki explains their relationship, but Raki finds it hard to believe.

name: Clash of Wills
description: A confused Raki fights but soon realizes... He and Daki share the same hopes.

name: Truth Revealed
description: Unexpected hands bring their fight to an end. The shrouded past is made clear at last.

name: Parting
description: A wall too high to overcome, for now... The two struggle with the fate of their servants.

name: Hopeful Hearts
description: The two have accepted their parents' hopes for them. Now, they can only trust that they will meet again.

name: [EX1] Sorcerer of the Divine Staff
description: A God of the 3rd Raven Brigade. His magic is overwhelming, and he is filled with steely resolve!

name: [EX2] The Heart of the Sorcerer
description: The sorcerer with the divine staff prays to rouse his own spirit as he thinks of his gentle mother.

name: [SPEX] Divine Fury
description: The sorcerer with the divine staff unleashes his power. What sights lie beyond this battle?

name: [EX] Howl of Fury
description: The beast approaches you with a terrifying howl. Face it without being overwhelmed.

name: [SPEX] The Raging Rampage
description: Zerkalo destroys all he sees. Resist the temptation of running away and fight him.

name: [AWK] Manifestation of the Tragedy
description: Stop with all your might the blow of the tragedy of the battle that Zerkalo pours out on you!

name: The Strange Island
description: Rayas wakes up on a beach after getting caught up in a storm on his way to the island in the Far East...

name: The Outstanding Swordswoman
description: An enemy attack! Sakura's blade is graceful, as much as lethal.

name: Soldier of a Foreign Country
description: Rayas fights together with Sakura. The enemies begin to be overwhelmed by their offensive.

name: Enemies from Overseas
description: Sakura suddenly faints. Will Rayas be able to defend the city from the enemies alone?

name: Two Fates into One
description: When Sakura wakes up, she asks Rayas an unexpected question.

name: Seeking to Meet Again
description: Sakura asks Rayas to summon her friend Yomi in order to see her once more.

name: To the Training Ground
description: Rayas follows Sakura to her and Yomi's favorite training ground.

name: The Path of Training
description: The path to the training ground is full of monsters. It would be a difficult task for a normal person to even get there.

name: Scars from Training
description: Scars from the past become visible, and the two girls' blades are extraordinarily sharp.

name: What Was Left
description: What is Sakura's real intention? Why did she call for Yomi?

name: 【EX1】Shower of Sakura
description: Mira leans the Sakura Itto-Ryu techniques. Behold, her glittering dance and countless slashes!

name: 【EX2】Sakura, in the Wind
description: Her swirling attack is almost like a storm of petals. Will you be able to face it?

name: 【SPEX】Blooming Flowers
description: The blade's attack is like a cherry tree in full blossom. Carve out the essence of the Sakura Itto-Ryu in your enemy!

name: Visitor from the Sealed Land
description: The Machine Norn comes to Raktehelm. A young knight welcomes her...

name: Cold Reception
description: Roy shares their orders, but Norn's attitude gets on his nerves.

name: She Has Her Reasons
description: Roy realizes Norn does feel some kind of emotion, and asks about her true motives.

name: Uncrossable Gap
description: Roy wants to know what Norn really thinks, but there is a profound gap between their worlds.

name: Roy's Hope
description: Roy and Norn continue their mission, though their relationship makes no progress. Roy slowly tries to break the ice.

name: A New Leaf
description: Norn is changed somehow. She finally begins to open her eyes and heart to see what Humans really are.

name: Comprehension Attainable?
description: Roy and Norn continue their information gathering journey. Along the way, they find unsettling news.

name: In Search of Intel
description: Roy and Norn continue their intelligence work. They're growing better at working together.

name: Into the Ruins
description: The pair investigate an ancient ruin, but its vast size begins to take a toll on their reserves.

name: A Reasonable Decision
description: A savage enemy appears before the exhausted pair. Roy and Norn make a "reasonable" choice.

name: [EX1] The Machine's Test Run
description: "Your strength needs to be tested", Norn says as she readies her electromagnetic cannons. Her power is truly something else!

name: [EX2] Norn the Machine Warrior
description: The warrior Norn came to Raktehelm to represent all Machines. She now bares her hidden power.

name: [SPEX] Weapons At Full Power
description: Norn has unleashed all her potential. Withstand her relentless firepower and grasp victory!

name: [EX1] Guardian Giant of Flames
description: A Giant of Flames stands in the way of Rayas within the weathered ruins. Are you ready to survive his assault of fiery punches?

name: [SPEX] Fiery Fists of Destruction
description: In front of Rayas stands an ancient Guardian Giant clad in flames. He's already lost what he once protected, so why does he still fight?

name: [AWK] Ancient Flames
description: The Giant continues to go berserk within the ruins. Extinguish his raging flames and move ahead!

name: Looking for Ingredients
description: Rayas is looking for ingredients inside a cave, when a huge roar suddenly fills the air!

name: The Two Visitors
description: Rayas talks with Sugimoto and Asirpa in the cave. Who exactly are they?

name: A Resounding Roar
description: Everyone has finished their meal and are resting for tomorrow when a mysterious roar fills the air once again.

name: Another Man
description: Sugimoto and Asirpa have gone back to their world, but the story isn't over yet...

name: [EX1] Battle in the Snowy Mountain
description: A mysterious white bird has shown up in the snow fields. It seems much stronger than the last monster.

name: [EX2] The Violent Snow Bird
description: The violent snow bird has strong magical powers. In the severe cold, it unleashes its full strength!

name: [SPEX] Giant Bird in the Snow Field
description: The snow bird flies through the frozen fields. Fight back its attacks with all your might!

name: [SPEX Hyper] White Bird of Fury
description: This bird of prey will not allow any intruders into its sanctuary. A white madness descends upon the frozen earth.

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 100
description: Finally, the master of Mokyuon appears. Defeat it to put an end to the invasion!

name: Forbidden Forest
description: Rayas was invited to this restricted territory by the Hero. What is this secret trick to strength he mentioned?

name: The Hero's Question
description: Zeorg asks what the meaning of "hero" really is. What is behind that smile?

name: In Pursuit of Strength
description: The strength to bring about the miracles spoken of in the epics... They continue, in pursuit of such power...

name: The Cursed Sword and the Hero
description: The two move on, defeating the evil natural spirits dwelling in the Forbidden Forest. What is awaiting them ahead?

name: The Cursed Sword's Thrall
description: There was a man whose soul was devoured by a cursed sword... His story is one of foolishness... and sorrow.

name: The Sealed Cavern
description: The two leave the forest and enter a cavern. An ominous aura comes from its depths.

name: The Sword's Call
description: The Hero is urged to the depths by the legendary sword. It pulses as if hungering after new power.

name: The Fate of Man
description: The Hero of Famelle continues to question what a hero truly is. It's as if he's trying to cast off some lingering regret...

name: The Forbidden Cursed Sword
description: The two finally arrive at the end of the cave. The Hero suddenly steps to the sword, as he speaks of age and fate.

name: The Hero's Sword
description: The Hero takes up the blade in a trance and bellows with rage. Can Rayas stop him?!

name: [EX1] The Hero's Resolve
description: Zeorg has taken up the cursed sword. Can you withstand the blade's cunning assault?

name: [EX2] Disciple of the Cursed Sword
description: The blade glows with baleful light. Show this grizzled veteran grinning behind its steel your true strength!

name: [SPEX] Rite of Purification
description: The Hero has repelled the evil temptation of the sword and made its power his own. Can you surpass the warrior mightier than ever?

name: [EX] The Malevolent Puppeteer
description: The gaze lurking beneath the mask, peers at Rayas with unknown intentions. The masked man, with a grin on his face, seeks to...

name: [SPEX] Reveration of the Mask
description: The words he whispers in the midst of battle, "work of art", are filled with madness. You must not fall to the madness! You must overcome it!

name: [AWK] Dance of Madness
description: As the fight intensifies the man's madness turns into a mixture of joy and twistedness. Put an end to his warped desires!

name: Assassin of Despair
description: After losing the battle with Rayas, Ashe wakes up. He begins to walk on, alone, led by despair...

name: The Cost of Power
description: A town abandoned after a devasting magic experiment. There's not a single sign of human inhabitants...

name: Poisoned Forest
description: Ashe's path takes him to an ominous forest. What portents lie in the twisted trees?

name: Scars from the Experiments
description: Ashe continues on the research-scarred path. Fragmented memories begin to surface.

name: The Defender's Oath
description: Ashe enters the old research facility, and his path leads him to a once-forbidden ground.

name: Flowers of Remembrance
description: Flowers are laid near the research documents. Someone has left them here in remembrance... But who?

name: Gate to the Abandoned Garden
description: A tree-filled garden lies just beyond the lab. The miasma-twisted trees cover the gate...

name: Recollections in the Garden
description: The rotted gate collapses at a touch. What memories does this flowering field hold for Ashe?

name: To the Sunny Hillside
description: Ashe heads for Riiz Garden. Does he seek atonement at the massive grave, or something else?

name: Flowers of Promise
description: Ashe finally arrives at the grave. What awaits him there?

name: [EX1] Twin Blade Dance
description: The assassin Ashe was made powerful through sorcerous experiments. Surpass his dancing twin blades!

name: [EX2] Darkness-Weaving Blade
description: Countless blades out of the obscurity. Hit the dweller in the dark with a deadly shot!

name: [SPEX] Infinite Shadow Blade
description: Countless blades dance without a sound. Overcome the resolve smoldering in the assassin's eyes!

name: Everlasting Granadia
description: Leone is next in line for the throne after Princess Juno's death. Now her and her companions hold the kingdom's future in their hands.

name: Threat from Neighboring Nation
description:
Dielgrant is the nation bordering Granadia. 
It quietly bares its fangs to feed its leader's ambition.

name: The Meaning of Training
description: Vox and the others take over the major training sessions. However, Berwick is nowhere to be seen.

name: The Knights are Ready
description: The Templars keep training to be ready for their neighbor's strike. What enemy observes them now?

name: What Supports the Nation
description: Young Leone bears enormous responsibility for her nation. And now, her dearest sister is replaced at her side by her Templars.

name: Today's Dinner
description: Leone and her friends go out shopping, and see a familiar face in the crowd.
