name: Go After Berwick!
description:
Berwick is headed for a forbidden area. 
What is he up to?

name: The Army Approaches
description:
The Dielgrant army has gathered at the border. 
There's not a moment to lose!

name: A Mighty Warrior
description: Berwick faces down Zelm's army by himself, and mows down his enemies with raging flames.

name: Hell Flames of Demon Blood
description:
What is this that appears before Berwick?
Now is the time to show his true power and save the kingdom!

name: [EX1] The Ice Dragon
description: An Ice Dragon suddenly appears in the sea of trees! Be ready to defend your nation with all your might!

name: [EX2] Freezing Roar
description: The Ice Dragon's howls have turned the sea of trees to a frozen waste. Burn away the enemy's ambitions with your blazing spirit!

name: [SPEX] Permafrost
description: The Ice Dragon's absolute zero breath freezes all it touches. Burn away the ice and grasp victory!

name: [Limited EX] Blazes are here!
description:
He attacks, his fighting spirit blazing like the stars themselves! 
Fight for victory with all your body and soul!

name: After Zelm
description: Wild howls shake everyone to the bone. The group hurries off, leaving Berwick to cover their backs.

name: A Woman's Wrath
description: The female warrior who protects the Princess smiles as mighty enemies approach, swinging her axes.

name: Loyalty and Resolution
description: Dielgrant's invasion moves ever forward. Who will stand before the invaders?

name: Before the Deluge
description: Only the strong survive in battle. The Templars' strength carries them forward.

name: The Sword's Point
description: The warriors are worn down by the ceaseless battle. The enemy sees its chance!

name: Faster! Ever! Faster!
description: The warriors withstand coordinated, attack after attack. They must join the Princess, and fast!

name: Into the Lost Forest
description: Leone escapes her pursuers. But her heart is filled with thoughts of her exhausted warriors...

name: The Shape of Despair
description: Though Leone has escaped her pursuers, she is now deep behind enemy lines. What awaits her now?

name: Beneath the Crest
description: The will to fight lives on in the outnumbered warriors. The only way out he sees is--

name: One Mind, One Body
description: The Juno Templars face off against Zelm. Now is the time to end this!

name: [EX1] Devourer of Fear
description: A being of pure darkness has appeared from the Otherworld. Hold back your terror, and stand against the beast!

name: [EX2] Ravening Dragon
description: Its talons gleam with hideous light. Destroy this dragon that feeds on your own fear!

name: [SPEX] Fallen Beast God
description: Its howls drown out all other sound. End this grisly battle for once and for all!

name: [Limited EX] Blood Drenched Axe
description: The female warrior grins as she wields her deadly axes. Control her blows to grasp victory!

name: The Night Racer
description: A figure goes racing by Rayas in the dark of night. It looks like it's holding a young girl!

name: After the Shadow!
description: A figure in black is sneaking past with a girl in its arms. This definitely calls for action!

name: About a Thief
description: Rayas goes to the Guild in search of news about the night shadow...

name: Shadow of the Cult
description: The Cult will do anything to achieve their goals. It appears they're connected to the Phantom Thief.

name: Sender Unknown
description: Rumors of the thief are spreading through the town, but no one knows his identity. Where could clues lie?

name: Calling Card
description: Rayas and friends are on the trail of Melia's secret. Who will win the battle of wits?

name: Clock Chimes
description: The calling card's time is coming soon. The team must be ready for the Phantom Thief!

name: Tactical Mistake
description: Iris was abducted, and Melia is nowhere to be found. There's no way to pursue the thief now!

name: Unmasking
description: The theft was a success. However, Iris seems oddly heavy...

name: Illusory Twin Blades
description: Rayas is taken aback by this unexpected enemy. Iris falls into Nier's clutches!

name: [EX1] Scourge of the Cracked Sky
description: With a shriek of wind, demonic whips attack from a crack in the sky. Fear not, and face down Nier's ambitions!

name: [EX2] Sadistic Blows
description: The whips rain down in sadistic blows, sure to leave mortal wounds. Face down the battle-hungry succubus!

name: [SPEX] Demon of Ecstasy
description: A whip cracks, hungry to feed the Demon's sadistic urges. Bring down the vicious Demoness!

name: Challenge Quest
description:
All that fill those eyes is illusion...
Strive to glimpse the Cult's fastest blades!

name: [EX] The Ice Dragon's Curse
description: Every strike is imbued with the foul strength of the Ice Dragon.

name: [SPEX] Scaled Murderer
description: Both his body and mind are turning into those of a Dragon's. He hungers for the power to stop that process.

name: [AWK] Unbreakable Tenacity
description: Though his goal is distant, his spirit is adamant to overcome the many merciless battles ahead...

name: The Gods Resistance Army Congress
description: The Demons have prepared an alliance to fight the Gods. The Granadians head to join the royal round-table.

name: Conflict of Interests
description: The Juno Templars have earned high expectations from earlier successes. But something seems amiss at this meeting...

name: Black Feather
description: The Templars are preparing to venture forth. Duke works out all alone...

name: Far from Granadia
description: Vox' feet quicken him toward the battle field as he senses a fierce fight coming. What thoughts are running through his head?

name: Unreasonable Orders
description: The Juno Templars arrive at the battlefield. A cunning Demon awaits them there.

name: Promise of the Night Wind
description: After his promise with Riviera, Thetis feels anew his dedication to his nation and dear comrades.

name: The Defense of Famelle
description: The Demon Alliance has formed ranks and prepares to hold off the Gods. Riviera sets out on a scouting mission, but...

name: The Scouts Fall Apart
description: A new danger pursues Riviera in her recon party after Zelm's plan falls apart.

name: A Path Worth Following
description: Thetis fights alone to protect what he must. And now no one can stop him.

name: Immovable Shield
description: Behind him is all he values. Soon the Gods will see that none shall pass his guard!

name: [EX1] Sword of the Holy Knights
description: A proud knight stands before you. Break your way through!

name: [EX2] Merciless Blade
description: The justice in her eyes blazes brighter than the sparks off her blade. You must surpass this ultimate swordswoman!

name: [SPEX] Rain of Falling Stars
description: Her overflowing conviction falls as a shower of light. Get past her blade and defeat the knight!

name: Challenge Quest
description: The faith in his shield gives him endless strength. Break through that wall of steel and cut a path forward!

name: [SPEX Hyper] Frozen Fury
description:
A myriad of Icicle Spears incessantly pour down in a frozen mist.
Go through the deadly blow and show your power!

name: Northern Famelle
description: The war with the Gods is claiming ever more victims. This cannot stand, and those who can change it begin to move...

name: To Avoid the Carnage
description: Vox proposes a daring surprise attack. His resolve offers the others courage.

name: In the Dusk
description: The Juno Templars follow an untrodden path. The sky darkens as the sun begins to set.

name: Like the Wind, Like the Trees
description: Vox hurries forward, with bated breath. The decisive battle approaches.

name: The Battle Begins
description: The Templars look down from the mountain at the enemy base. It's time to begin!

name: The Divine Knights
description: The surprise attack was no surprise. Divine blades thirst for Templar blood!

name: Sunset
description: The blades of the Divine Knights topple one comrade after another. Can the outnumbered Templars turn the tables?

name: The Blades of Two
description: Two warriors, Vox and Nies, dominate the battlefield. The time for them to face off approaches.

name: Flashing Warrior
description: Vox' efforts resound over the battlefield. Now the Invincible Shield of the Divine Knights stands before him.

name: A Swordsman's Wish
description: The warrior's plea takes wings through a sky filled with hope and despair.

name: [EX1] Pride of the Divine Knights
description: Nies, the leader of the Divine Knights, draws his blade without a sound. Face that blade-point without flinching!

name: [EX2] A Blow to Pierce the Heavens
description: The mightiest blade of the Divine Knights grows ever sharper. Battle on, though death is all that awaits!

name: [SPEX] Azure Guardian Sword
description: The will to battle slumbers in Nies' eyes. Strike now to end it all and defeat the supreme knight!

name: Challenge Quest
description: Vox has named you a sparring partner. Withstand his attacks and get past his blade!

name: Investigating the Mines
description: Rayas and the others head to the mines to identify the cause of the mysterious rumbling of the ground.

name: A New Encounter
description:
A blue monster called slime appears in front of Rayas.
It seems it's not a bad monster.

name: Heading to Reigrad
description:
Benimaru, Rirumu's subordinate(?) joins the crew.
The crew heads to the exit with the two.

name: At the Exit of the Mine
description:
It's almost the exit of the mines.
Who is it that awaits the crew?

name: Rimuru and Mikyuo
description:
Rirumu named the Mikyuon "Mikyuo."
It seems that Mikyuo likes Rirumu a lot.

name: The Bustle of Reigrad
description:
Rayas and the others are now back in Reigrad.
Rirumu is quite interested in the city.

name: To the Mine Again
description: Once again, the crew is heading to the mines to find Mikyuo's ore.

name: Searching for a Mysterious Ore
description:
The mysterious ore that contains magic...
This is their only clue to get the two back to their world.

name: Going after Mikyuo
description:
Mikyuo guides the crew into the mines.
Mikyuo somewhat seems to be in high spirits.

name: Powers are Revealed
description:
Rirumu feels anger towards the dragon that suddenly appeared.
Now, his true powers are revealed...

name: 【EX1】Dragon Hidden in the Mines
description:
Deep in the mines, the Haden Dragon shows itself.
It'll cause a disaster if you don't stop it now!

name: 【EX2】Roar of the Haden Dragon
description:
The Haden Dragon is a dangerous species.
Why did it appear near Reigrad?

name: 【SPEX】Dark Dragon Calls Disaster
description:
It is said that a disaster will happen when the Haden Dragon appears.
Its powers are now raging.

name: Mysterious Hand and Shadow
description:
The mysterious hand Mikyuo drew and the old man who appeared.
What is going to happen?

name: Another Visitor
description:
A young girl appeared at the same time
as Rimuru and Benimaru. Who is this girl
who calls them besties with Rimuru?

name: Reviving Memories
description:
Rimuru absorbs Magicules and mimics a human shape.
His fading memories start returning.

name: Finding Clues
description:
The appearance of Rimuru, Benimaru and the dragon.
This cave must hold some clues.

name: Deep in the Mine
description:
Rayas and the others trek deeper into the cave. 
Who resides in its depths?

name: A Dangerous Person
description: The Summoner, Dolon is somewhat deranged, but has incredibly dangerous plans. He holds the key to all!

name: Bringer of Fear
description:
Dolon planned to summon the Fallen Beast God.
They must stop his ambition!

name: After Dolon
description:
Demon Lord Milim defeated the Fallen Beast God in a single blow.
Dolon immediately flees, so the team pursues.

name: The Fallen Beast God
description:
Rayas and the others chase Dolon. But Dolon still hasn't given up.
Keep cautious!

name: Beyond this World
description:
Mikyuo has evolved to repay his debt to Rimuru.
You must answer his call to action!

name: Special Crossover Quest 4
description:
Solid, stinging, frenzied, crafty, strong.
This foe is only for seasoned warriors.

name: Special Crossover Quest 5
description: The emissary of fire strikes from high and low. Fearless fighters will find their match here.

name: Special Crossover Quest 1
description: Play this limited-time Quest up to 5 times a day for boosted drop rates on Crossover Equips!

name: Coffin in the Sky
description: The skies of Granadia haven't changed in two years. Except for one thing...

name: A Hint of Doubt
description: Rosetta is a gifted sorcerer. The mood feels somehow oppressive.

name: Red Ceiling
description: Riviera speaks of past events. Something happened at a blazing shrine.

name: Frustration
description: Berwick has lost his sorcery. His face grows tight with frustration.

name: Self-proclaimed Genius
description: Rosetta joins in the Templars' battle training. Soon, her true ability is revealed.

name: Student of Magic
description: Rosetta has her doubts about the source of Magia Drive. She heads to the Academy Library.

name: Into the Lost Forest
description: Berwick ventures through the forest alone. His spirit wrestles with memories of that day.

name: Despairing Sorcerer
description: We don't need anyone who can't fight-- Duke's words are carved deep into his heart.

name: Unexpected Battle
description: Chasing Berwick, Rosetta gets lost in the forest. Something comes from above--

name: Oath of Flame
description: A sword is found in the Granadia Castle dungeon. It holds the memory of a lost swordsman.

name: [EX1] Cursed Blade of Death
description: The Goddess's cursed blade brings death to all opponents. Search for survival amidst the flashing attacks.

name: [EX2] Divine Spear of Calamity
description: This spear of calamity rains down destruction. Dodge its attacks to land a single blow of death.

name: [SPEX] Queen of the Underworld
description: The ruler of the underworld smiles grimly-- Strike down the haughty God!

name: Challenge Quest
description: Brand an image of your blazing sword on the enemies’ souls!

name: A Genius Girl
description: Rosetta prepares for the ceremony with a specially-made item.

name: A Girl's Loneliness
description: The genius girl keeps her heart closed off, but she has her worries.

name: Leone and Rosetta
description: Rosetta continues her research into Magia Drive at the academy. She thinks back to a smiling face...

name: Breaking and Entering
description: Rosetta is planning to break into the lab. The key to her plan is a certain someone...

name: Demon Blood
description: Rosetta finds a book in the lab: a record of the Queens of Granadia.

name: Before the Ceremony
description: The Leone Templars are preparing for the Coffin Ceremony. A tense atmosphere fills the Granadian night.

name: Day of Destiny
description: Leone faces this fateful day with all the resolve of a queen.

name: Crimson Blood
description: Suddenly, the air is filled with flames. Leone grows afraid of the power running in her veins.

name: After the Queen
description: Rosetta and Duke search for the queen. What stands in their way?

name: The Promised Sky
description: Leone stops... The sights of that day still lingers in her heart...

name: [EX1] Phoenix of Hatred
description: The soaring darkness turns its talons on you. Cut through the roaring winds of evil and bestow punishment!

name: [EX2] Master of Time and Space
description: A warp in reality defends the beast. Focus all your strength on a single point of attack!

name: [SPEX] The Heavens Above
description: This God shows power beyond the ken of man...

name: [Limited EX] Heavenly Witch
description: The witch writes runes to rain blows like falling stars...

name: To a Foreign Land
description: The team serves as Captain Forte's escorts as she travels to another country. Wade through the monsters infesting the path like true heroes!

name: Preparing the Escort
description: The team will soon arrive at their destination. Gather information, but don't miss the train!

name: Arcana Express
description: The Arcana Express is on the move, but the delayed departure has Captain Forte in a bad mood.

name: Battle Atop the Cars
description: The escorts fight atop the train while Forte stays inside. What do the ambush troops want?

name: Fierce Fighting
description: The ambush troops keep coming. Forte may be in danger inside, but currently, your hands are full!

name: Into the Lost Woods
description: It's time to disembark. The entrance to a vast forest almost seems to beckon you inside...

name: Unwavering Resolve
description: The Lost Woods is deeper and darker than imagined. As they travel through the forest, the past of Forte is revealed.

name: Survival
description: The captain and her escorts have grown closer. They must get through the long journey to Gala together!

name: Solitude and Loneliness
description: The group searches for a place to spend the night in safety. What does Kane reveal to Forte, illuminated by the light of the moon?

name: The Giant's Howl
description: The Giant loses control of himself in his rage. Fight together, but be careful!

name: [EX1] Raging Giant
description: This ancient city lost its grandeur in an ancient flood. Now, it is the domain of a Giant.

name: [EX2] Resentful Giant
description: The Giant fights relentlessly. It's almost like he's saying for the party to pay for invading the holy ground...

name: [SPEX] Mad Giant
description: The maddened Giant continues to fight. To defeat the creature, you must first survive its onslaught of attacks!

name: [Limited EX] Spy of Darkness
description: Light glints off the muzzle of a gun as it points in your direction...

name: [SPEX Hyper] Cry of the Dragon
description: The Dragon's strike slices through the earth! Dodge the warrior's fierce attacks and discover the firm resolve hidden behind her fury!

name: Beyond the Ruins
description: The group rushes away from the Giant's dwelling, deeper into the ruins. All they can do is pray that their comrade is safe.

name: Believing in Reunion
description: Ru and the others keep a look out for Fen as they move on. The deep silence of the ruins seems to swallow all sound.

name: A Ruler's Smile
description: As Forte and her team move on, her soldiers report to the King back home.

name: The Power of Faith
description: The soldiers and townspeople alike pray that the peace conference succeeds, and await the captain's return.

name: Premonition and Confidence
description: They have finally left the ruins. Ru thinks back on what Kane said when planning this escort duty.

name: Unease
description: Despite the lack of cover, attackers continue to come from nowhere. What could they be after?

name: Glinting Gun Point
description: The muzzle of a gun shines in the light. Awaiting Forte and her companions beyond the ruins is a gunman clad in black.

name: In Hopes of Peace
description: Forte and her companions have finally reunited with Fen. They can see a castle in the distance. They will soon arrive at Garrah!

name: Ups and Downs
description: Upon arriving at Garrah, the travelers are greeted by a warm welcome.

name: Shadow Guardians
description: A few days have passed since the peace conference. Forte announces she is parting ways with her escorts and returning home. However...

name: [EX1] The Emerald Fortress
description: A demon bird sleeps in this marsh. They say that disturbing its sleep would mean the end for a foolish adventurer.

name: [EX2] The Demon Bird's Scream
description: A piercing shriek echoes over the marshes. Has the bird found new prey at last? Dodge its swooping talons!

name: [SPEX] Howling Demon Bird
description: Its wingbeats crush rock, and its howl shakes the ground... Penetrate the marsh and bring down the mighty beast!

name: [Limited EX] Swordsman of Stealth
description: Time to give everything I've got! Can you withstand this relentless assault?

name: Armored Adventurer
description:
A man in full plate armor appears at
Reigrad's Adventurer's Guild. Who could he be?

name: Journey of Mystery
description:
Gobls rampaging at a farm, and
adventurers from another world... This marks the start of a journey full of mystery.

name: Night in the farm
description:
Rayas' party heads for a farm outside of town. 
They need to hear what Lute has to say.

name: Lute's Concern
description:
Lute was witness to the chaos at the farm. 
The boy's eyes are filled with worry.

name: The Mystery of the Scroll
description: The Priestess stammers out her story.  It's a recollection of their time before coming to Raktehelm.

name: The Forest Dweller's Guidance
description: The High Elf Archer leads Goblin Slayer through the quiet woods. They are near the ruins now...

name: The Gobl's Lair
description: The team has reached the forest ruins.  What are Goblin Salyer's thoughts before the Gobl's lair?

name: Friendly Fire
description:
Rayas and friends spot two familiar
figures as they head deep into the ruins.

name: The Cursed Sword's Call
description:
Lute faces his fears. 
He recalls a past mischief...

name: The Slayer of Goblins
description:
Countless goblins appear before them. 
The armored man reveals his bloodlust...

name: [EX1] The Giant Goblin
description:
Ax has lost all reason. 
His body has been overcome by endless madness.

name: [EX2] Goblin Assault
description:
Ax absorbs all the hatred around him, gaining incredible power. 
You must stop this monster!

name: [SPEX] Unhappy Duel
description:
This massive goblin has seen the power to surpass time and space. 
End this battle of misery.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Crossover Challenge Quest
description: A Giant of disaster appears from the frozen wastes. Stop the destruction it brings, and seal it away again!

name: [Limited EX] Daily Crossover Quest
description:
Better chance to get Crossover Equips!
One time per day only "Bonus Quest".

name: Sky Ark of Hope
description: Granadia is forced in a life-or-death battle, but the flame of hope burns still!

name: Premonitions of Battle
description: Berwick senses the Divine Knights. He feels a showdown approaching.

name: The Coffin's Crest
description: Rosetta finishes working out the Crest Sorcery formula, and now she's repairing the Coffin. It's a battle with time!

name: Forbidden Coffin
description: Leone has sworn not to approach the Coffin. Rosetta's face fills with relief.

name: The Bloody Battle Begins
description: The Gods Army attacks. The Bloody Battle begins in northern Granadia.

name: Like Flowing Water
description: Nies easily parries Berwick's onslaught. Truly, this is the strongest of the Divine Knights.

name: Like Raging Fire
description: Berwick does not rest his hand. His blade strikes ever faster.

name: Signal of Counter-Attack
description: Rosetta finishes repairing the Coffin. Now, the counter-attack begins!

name: A Flash in the Blue Sky
description: The Sky Ark's magical cannons belch flame. They must drive the Gods Army out from Granadia!

name: The Dusk World
description: At the end of the fierce fighting, the young girl says a prayer for the world sinking into darkness...

name: [EX1] White Blade of the Heavens
description: The knight of the heavens brandishes her sword. Strike with all your body and soul!

name: [EX2] Shining Guardian Knight
description: Her cutting edge glitters as it grazes your cheek. Stand firm, and show your might!

name: [SPEX] Flashing Twin Stars
description: Two Divine Knights stand before your eyes. They are ready to unleash unbridled power!

name: Endurance Challenge Quest
description: The Princess' blood paints the woodlands crimson...

name: The Eclipsed Land
description: Granadia has been painted crimson, as if the queen's blood stained every inch.

name: An Ill Wind
description: The Divine Knights have regrouped, but a dark wind blows toward them.

name: The Knight's Decision
description: Seeing the damage wrought upon his army, the knight makes a hard decision.

name: The Miasma's Locus
description: Miasma flows from the people toward Granadia's Castle.

name: The Vessel Armor
description: Duke already knows the truth of the jet-black armor hidden below the ruins.

name: Below the Castle
description: Duke confronts the armor of destiny below Granadia's Castle.

name: The Stars' Rage
description: The Stars show their anger at the unending war between Gods and Demons.

name: The Titan and the Maiden
description: The Ancient Titan has awakened below the castle. The Stars' fury comes for Leone.

name: The Princess' Wish
description: The Princess' wish embraces the whole world, encompassing all her hopes and dreams.

name: The Crest of Granadia
description: Time passes, and green shoots return to Granadia.

name: [EX1] Ancient Great God
description: The Titan's rage falls like lightning. Defend yourself before its might!

name: [EX2] The Will of the Stars
description: This spirit of calamity was born of the Stars' will. Fight to survive, with all your body and soul.

name: [SPEX] The Hollow Devil
description: The howls of this hollow spirit fill the air with despair. Carve your superhuman power into its flesh!

name: Challenge Quest
description: Our pledge to our ruler! The call to justice running deep in our crimson blood!

name: A Quiet Village
description:
The Shinobi have chosen to live in peace.
Still, they never forget to train to protect themselves.

name: Skills to Live
description: The Shinobi lived a self-sufficient life in tune with the seasons. Or at least, they believed so...

name: Sunset Sky
description:
The sun was setting, as it always did.
But ominous clouds came in from the west.

name: Crimson Morning
description: It was so sudden... Having different desires, war cries rose from the Shinobi.

name: Bellows and Sighs
description: Amane, Yakuno village's first line of defense, stands before Shiki and Saku.

name: The Two Leaders
description:
Mizuki from Imari, Shuri from Yakuno...
Deadly blades clash in battle.

name: Morning of Loss
description: Imari Village was harshly damaged by Yakuno's sudden attack.

name: The Leader Stands Alone
description: Shiki is striving for even greater strength, but what does Mizuki, burdened with the village, have in mind?

name: Lost in Feelings
description:
Hope, duty, loneliness, and pride...
The village's defenders are in confusion.

name: The Path in Blood
description: The guideposts to the village's hopes and future are smeared with sadness and blood.

name: [EX1] The Violent Monster
description:
The beast is filled with an evil spirit.
A soul-devouring creature raises its birth cries.

name: [EX2] Cursed Howls
description: Its breath rots flowers, and its bellow soils the sky.

name: [SPEX] Magnificent Catastrophe
description: This evil beast, emanating ominous waves, has lost its mind and has become an incarnation of destruction.

name: [Limited EX] Shadows and Fangs
description:
What are they craving for?
A tide of raging blood awakens the power to slaughter monsters.

name: A New Morning
description: One cannot understand the value of a peaceful life until one experiences dreadful days.

name: A Challenge against Hell
description:
Ominous creatures stand in the gap between life and death.
The shinobi must ready his blades.

name: Hellish Illusion
description:
Illusions surround Saku and bare their fangs.
They offer no respite as the air fills with the stink of blood.

name: Night of the Full Moon
description:
The circle of the moon rests in the sky.
A shadow steals up on Saku as he is lost in thought.

name: Waiting for Whom Will Not Come
description:
Kisaragi and the other wait for Saku in the village.
Everyone is worried about his absence.

name: Day of Departure
description:
Saku has finally returned.
Everyone raises their hands in triumph at his success.

name: Heartrending News
description: The message stroke like a cold shower, and sent ripples through the heart of all who hear it.

name: People from the Past
description: The unease grows into chaos and sends echoes through history.

name: The Decision is Made
description: Kisaragi has thrown off her hesitation and stands resolute before Shuri.

name: The Unexpected Conclusion
description: Everyone strives for someone, but no one knows the despair that is coming closer.

name: [EX1] The Mecha Girl
description: This girl did not hesitate to find ways to make up for what she lacked.

name: [EX2] Slaughter Doll
description:
She altered herself in pursuit of strength... 
To love and to be loved.

name: [SPEX] Beautiful Chaotic Mecha
description:
Once a girl, the Slaughter Doll stood there... 
She beautifully started the battle.

name: Challenge Quest
description:
An encounter with the two heads of the village.
Raging flames and relentless hammers come on the attack.

name: Monster Onslaught
description: Innumerous monsters come swarming from the ruins. The whole of Isliid is in danger!

name: The Battle for Reigrad
description: The monster swarm threatens Reigrad. Rayas and Ganan defend the town, but then someone appears...

name: Danger Spreads
description: The monsters begin attacking all over Isliid. Disaster strikes all around!

name: Sisters of Chance
description: One of our friends gets wrapped up in the threat... But fate brings along an unexpected encounter.

name: The Girl and the Hero
description: Everyone gives their all to defend the town. And then... He appears.

name: Gathering of Powers
description: Rayas and Genos head to the ruins, only to meet someone truly powerful. But the strongest man is approaching the heart of the matter...

name: Overflowing Evil
description: One man controls the ruins and spreads destruction. He is insane!

name: Manifestation of Destruction
description: The cornered man calls up a forbidden entity. No normal warrior could defeat it...

name: Finally, the Hero
description: The warriors fall one by one before the crimson beast. But he is on his way...

name: Destruction vs. One Hit
description: Roy and Saitama escape by the skin of their teeth. Now is not the time for words. They let their fists do the talking.

name: [EX1] Crimson Dragon
description: This beast calls itself "Destroyer of Worlds". It is no ordinary monster...

name: [EX2] The Heart of Envy
description: This crimson beast calls itself "Heart of Envy". Put its massive destructive power to rest!

name: [SPEX] Fate of the Strong
description: No one, no matter how strong, is immortal. Show the Destroyer its fate.

name: Damage Challenge Quest
description: These heroes have awakened power that transcends time and space. Now, show them one single, all-powerful hit!

name: [SPEX Hyper] Battle Instincts
description: A soul bathed in blood seeks out for battle. With a hunger that cannot be satiated, save for victory.

name: Beyond Loss
description: The wounds have started to heal, but are still tender. Even with the slightest touch, the scar still hurts.

name: The Dead Spirit's Parade
description:
Mindless, rotten, implacable...
A procession of the dead spirits begins.

name: The Pain from the Past
description:
She would do anything for her.
She would believe anything if she said so.

name: Where the Light Leads
description:
Though she had seen it only once,
the gentle light took her heart and soul.

name: The Writhing Creatures
description:
The bizarre spectacle spreads in silence.
Mizuki and Shiki stand fast.

name: Looking Back to the Past
description:
The threat has passed.
Now, Mizuki trudges toward its source.

name: Enduring Obedience
description:
Ena, a nation that vanished in a single night...
Now the truth is revealed.

name: The Root of Conspiracy
description:
The poison spreads steadily.
No one knows how much time remains.

name: The Mystery Returns
description:
Sealed for 1,000 years... 
The lid of the cauldron flies off with a piercing laugh.

name: Rain of Chaos
description: It's a mere coincidence that she was born at this time. But still, she must gain that strength.

name: [EX1] Dance of the Dead
description:
Clear each hurdle and slay the living.
This is the realm of the dead. It reeks, and it is dark.

name: [EX2] Hole to the Underworld
description:
It is the realm of the dead. It reeks and it's dark...
Rotten flesh wraps around your body...

name: [SPEX] The Indignant Corpse
description:
It has lost all pain, all sadness, and all suffering.
All that is left in their shredded flesh is rage.

name: [Limited EX] Like a Demon
description: When the gleam of red eyes heralds, death approaches and those who try to escape will find their souls shredded.

name: The Curtain Opens
description: Tamae's plan is moving forward, and the ninjas are trapped in the middle.

name: Against the Capital
description: Mizuki and Kisaragi face down the capital, now a dead city filled with evil spirits.

name: A Guardian's Will
description:
The master will lay the foundation for the road ahead.
The orders will now be fullfilled...

name: The Towering Castle
description: Forward, with hearts steeled by pain and misery.

name: Time of Change
description: When they finally reached the entrance of the castle, they found Shiki standing there.

name: Fool's Teaparty
description:
The girl is in deep sorrow.
Now the suspicious fools dance.

name: The Moon in the Sky
description:
Those who were scattered gather once more.
When wills overlap, strength is born.

name: Souls Going Forth
description: They gather beneath the full moon, according to the ancient law. An awakening soul cries out to the sky.

name: Day of Arrival
description: The time has come for darkness of the underworld and the darkness of the human heart to come together.

name: Cry of a Thousand Years
description:
The wish is fulfilled...
They stand tall for the sake of someone.

name: [EX1] Demon Fox Ugetsu
description: After all these long centuries, the Demon Fox Ugetsu has returned. And with her comes untold rage and hate.

name: [EX2] Phantasm Surrender
description: Gods, Demons, Humans... All races bow before this majestic aura.

name: [SPEX] Ex Nihilo
description: Her howls tear heaven and earth, and raise a sea of blood.

name: Challenge Quest
description: The grand Fox's power is the source of countless evils. Now, taste deep of that darkness.

name: Hidden Challenge Quest
description: You may wish for all this to be a terrible nightmare. The Demon Fox, touched by towering rage rends the earth.

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 1
description: A throng of Mokyuon appear on a sunny hill. Fight them off to restore peace!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 2
description: The Mokyuon regroup and attack. Stand fearlessly and mow them down!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 3
description: The crowding Mokyuon rush in. Avoid getting caught in the stampede!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 4
description: Mokyuon attack in droves, blanketing the ground. Don't be daunted by their numbers!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 5
description: Endless Mokyuon march through the forest. Wipe them out all at once!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 6
description: The land trembles beneath the crazed Mokyuon. Carve a path through them!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 7
description: Mokyuon as far as the eye can see. Wield your weapons to seize victory!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 8
description: Waves of Mokyuon even topple the trees. Pierce through the horde to stop them!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 9
description: The Mokyuons' fury shakes the air. Dig deep and eradicate them!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 10
description: Herds and herds of Mokyuon approach. Don't stop until they're all gone!

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 11
description: A mountain of Mokyuon towers above you. The battle is far from over.

name: Mokyuon Challenge Round 12
description: A mountain of Mokyuon towers above you. The battle is far from over.
