name: A Trifling Encounter
description: Right before their long-awaited vacation, the Fenrir Corps gets surprised by a job from the information bureau.

name: Pain in the Neck
description: The agent's carefree personality drives the methodical captain up the wall.

name: The Wrong Guy
description: An already frustrated Roy gets thrown into an ordeal that is all but pleasant.

name: Just Trust Jay
description: The suspect leads the two to a certain someone's mansion.

name: Successful Negotiations
description: Surrounded by a group of angry-looking thugs, Roy prepares to do some negotiating with his blade.

name: The Scorched Gun
description: There's only one person who could have been in the back of that carriage...

name: A Hollow Case
description: Emptiness is the only proof of solitude one needs.

name: The Crimson Sophist
description: His trigger finger trembles not out of fear, but anger.

name: The Nuisance's Truth
description: The only sounds one can hear over his enemy's screams are from his gun barrels.

name: Aim for Tomorrow
description: In response to his partner's confession, Roy gives up words for bullets.

name: [EX1] Red-Hot Spirit
description: Practice makes perfect. Help the fervent Roy with his training.

name: [EX2] Heatproof Barrel
description: Shoot, shoot, shoot some more. These guns never overheat!

name: [SPEX] Bonds of Smoke
description: Roy lets his guns do the talking. And he wants to chat.

name: Challenge Quest
description: The captain unleashes a newfound power. Step into his territory and show him how it's done!

name: [EX] Sword Dancer
description: Beneath the moonlight, her blades strike without cease. Cut through the whirling tempest!

name: [SPEX] Spinning Edges
description: Steps move in time to the rhythm of clashing blades. Feel the heat of her passion!

name: [AWK] Rondo of Blades
description: Her performance reaches the climax. Face the keen edge of her conviction!

name: In the Shadow of Power
description: Wings flutter in a carefree light. Everyone believed their path was righteous...

name: Three People, Three Ways
description: All three are thinking of someone in particular... And they pray there is no curse waiting to fall.

name: Light-clad Royalty
description: They work together to face danger. Their hearts are one. When they join forces, nothing is impossible.

name: Resonating Brilliance
description: They fight for those they love. For as long as their flame burns...

name: Change Comes to the Capital
description: The capital has suffered a mysterious monster attack. But Cestina and her siblings are working to keep spirits high.

name: Gratitidue and Love
description: The royal family uses all their powers, and each brings success in their own way.

name: Drowning in Misery
description: It's like being pulled into a bottomless swamp. It traps the hands, the feet, and even the voice...

name: Venting Anxiety
description: Luahn and the people might truly be the same. Neither can seem to escape the darkness shrouding them.

name: The Path to Rebuilding
description: Oluon reborn in Gran Verge... Both a dream, and a duty to be fulfilled.

name: Oluon Weeps
description: The collapsed tower cannot tell its story. Yet the wind shrieking through the cracks carries the sound of grief.

name: Sweeping Shadow
description: Not once, but twice... Is it a curse, or mere coincidence? Whatever the case, great wings once more shred the sky.

name: The Dregs of Sentiment
description: The defenders, and the defended. Roles given, not chosen. But those who take the situation for granted are in for a rude awakening.

name: Mire of Rage
description: Fear and anxiety, rage and grief... They sharpen the beast's fangs, and harden its heart.

name: A Step into the Light
description: Everyone nearly forgot... But love without boundaries finally reminds them of the righteous path.

name: [EX1] Freezing Roars
description: Its breath falls like sighs of resignation, despair, and regret, and freezes all it touches.

name: [EX2] Wings of Hatred
description: What do these beating wings seek? They spread like greedy hands, grasping for something they cannot have.

name: [SPEX] Fangs of Scornful Rage
description: The beast's fangs drip with ichor. It is more than blood that stains those rending white blades.

name: Damage Challenge Quest
description: The beast grins, as if to show how depraved it truly is. Defeat it. O warrior whose hand knows the blade, take up your weapon!

name: [Trial EX] Beast of Flames
description: The blaze of fighting spirit wraps his body, eyes glinting through the swirling heat.

name: 2nd Anniversary Daily Quest
description: Get Awesome Rewards by playing once a day!

name: The Sun Sets on Gran Verge
description: The dinner table is bustling as the four royal siblings gather around. Each is fired up for their new duties.

name: Toward the Festival of Light
description: As the nation readies itself for a grand festival, Liza is working overtime to prepare.

name: Fireworks
description: Not only is Liza in charge of the festival, she is working on Oluon's restoration as well.

name: Symbol of Hope
description: Liza, hidden away in Oluon, is filled with resolve to fulfill the hope it represents.

name: Broken Desire
description: Liza works day and night to decipher the control rites, but progress is painfully slow.

name: Cries in the Silence
description: Work goes on, one step after another, yet Oluon still slumbers.

name: Facing the Truth
description: A single seat at the table remains empty, and the silence it brings is deafening.

name: The Rising Sun
description: Liza continues to struggle, even as she contemplates the magical fireworks that once inspired her.

name: Misty Mountaintops
description: As she reaches out to grasp the dazzling light, she fails to see the shadows gathering behind her.

name: Resonating Dissonance
description: Sounds thrown into disarray create cacophony. So, too, do hopes and dreams that veer off course.

name: [EX1] Nightmare Duet
description: Reverberating rumbles and piercing shrieks accompany this nightmarish scene.

name: [EX2] Rondo of Anguish
description: The gargantuan creature spreads fear and anguish: a rondo of pure terror, played again and again.

name: [SPEX] Quartet of Destruction
description: Gnashing fangs, spilled blood, shrieks, and howls. The twin-headed monstrosity conducts a quartet of destruction.

name: Challenge Quest
description: Break through the fear cast by those four baleful eyes. Prove yourself worthy of the title adventurer!

name: [Trial EX] Gears of Shredding
description: Revolving blades whine with cold aggression, prepared to rend the world itself.

name: In the Barracks
description: Forte having returned from her mission to Garrah shares her adventures with her squad.

name: Tales Untold
description: Forte was escorted by men from a faraway land. Her soldier's listen to her tales in awe.

name: Code Red
description: The Peace Treaty's signing set the events in motion, teaching Forte many new lessons.

name: Adelite
description: To acquire the fuel that the Arcane Express needs to operate, they must risk entering the mines.

name: Powerful Allies
description: Forte asks King Garrah for special assistance with a very unusual proposal.

name: The Plan
description: Forte sought help from Fen and Kane. But she seems to have an ulterior motive as well...

name: Ambushed from the Shadows
description: Their plan was perfect...but little did they expect trouble lurking in the shadows...

name: Standing One's Ground
description: Their pursuers were behind the Garrah attack! Forte and Kane await, gun and blade in hand!

name: Perseverance
description: Kane fights off the attackers, Forte arrives at the mines, and Fen makes an interesting discovery.

name: Reversing the Tides
description: The Shadow Guardians have finally cornered the attackers. This fight will end their evil plans!

name: [EX1] Forte's Boot Camp
description: Forte's special training is not for the weak! Win this fight to prove yourself as a soldier!

name: [EX2] Forte's Boot Camp 2
description: Forte's special training part 2 begins! There is no finish line in the pursuit of greatness!

name: [SPEX] Forte's Boot Camp 3
description: Part 3 of Forte's special training! Bring your best to battle, no excuses allowed!

name: [Limited EX] The Commander
description: With both beauty and brawn, this young Commander leads the shadow army!

name: [SPEX] The Noble Dragon
description: Gods and Dragons are to destined become the greatest of friends... or the greatest of enemies.

name: [SPEX Hyper] The Esteemed Servant
description: Spreading its wings, it beckons fear and reveration from those that bare witness. Its name is Virago.

name: The Royals Strike Back
description: The princes and princesses are accused of crimes they don't remember committing: treason and attempted regicide.

name: Cold Silence
description: The prison is deep underground. Its cold walls swallow all sound.

name: Enchanted Prison
description: For an average person, steel walls would suffice, but for the princes and princesses need more than that to keep them in.

name: Brothers and Sisters Together
description: They must go and find proof of their innocence.

name: Darkened Castle
description: The home they knew until yesterday is no more. What has changed, though? The place, or their memories of it?

name: Royal Audience
description: The princes and princesses escape. They hurry to the castle for an audience with the king.

name: The King's Blade
description: They shared bonds beyond mere father and child. For this young man, following his father's path was a dream.

name: Overwhelming Pressure
description: What mistake led to all of this? Hope as we might for an answer, we hope in vain.

name: Resolve
description: The condemned are sent to the headsman.

name: Judgment Approaches
description: There is no escaping this parting. As the stars themselves fall, they turn their backs on glory.

name: [EX1] A Dragon Sleeps Within Her
description: All she wanted was approval, like so many others...

name: [EX2] Raging Dragon's Dance
description: A life destined for mockery and ridicule? No, perhaps not... The dragon awakes.

name: [SPEX] The Dragon of Ruin's Tears
description: None has survived the dragon's raging touch. It consumes all...

name: [Limited EX] Shrieks in Blood
description: It needs nothing, wants nothing. The rage it sends forth rends its throat.

name: Rising Again
description: The princes and princesses have escaped and are hiding deep in a nameless wood.

name: Raise Your Eyes
description: Life at the abbey is not what they're used to, but they still enjoy the peace and tranquility it brings.

name: Unexpected Meeting
description: Out picking herbs, Milay encounters a Dragon girl in distress.

name: Closed Heart
description: The archives below the abbey are home to a trove of forgotten wisdom.

name: Those Who Turn from the Light
description: It may just be the moonlight, but the thought persists... If only they'd met under different circumstances.

name: Eyes Met
description: Angelas searches for the source of her aching pain and is troubled by the memories burned into her brain.

name: Since That Day
description: As Cestina is overcome with regret, Liza swims in the sea of wisdom.

name: Forgotten Tome
description: A legend is written in a tome that had been lying dormant. Liza's heart flutters as she is lost in time.

name: Descending Flames
description: The woods are dyed crimson, and the sky itself burns. The dragon's cries bring raging flames.

name: A Dragon's Tears & the Princess
description: Even if she is rejected, she will keep trying--for the sake of her weaker past self.

name: [EX1] Embrace the Blaze
description: The touch of the dragon's blaze will burn you where you stand.

name: [EX2] Crimson Eyes
description: The dragon's mere gaze can melt flesh from bone.

name: [SPEX] Inflamed Serpent
description: The ground blazes, and the very air robs you of life.

name: Challenge Quest
description: A girl escapes and runs into the forest in search of light. Overcome the challenges and grasp the future!

name: Knighthood
description: It's a turning point for the rookie Salyssa. Her assigned unit, however, is a bit...

name: The Squad's Purpose
description: Knights are not just about fighting. The Stella Squad's responsibilities are many.

name: Backstage Soldier
description: A knight's duties extend to the most unusual of places with varying necessity.

name: To Protect
description: What the Stella Squad defends is vague and intangible.

name: The Captain
description: Ashleigh threw away personal glory to become a PR squad leader.

name: Nation of Passion
description: Fine arts and emotional fervor abound in the Principality of Bamint.

name: At Love's End
description: The Funereal Bloom adorns the stage as the classic tale unfolds.

name: Gateway to Tragedy
description: The rookie's passion is tested in light of the truth.

name: Defenders of Passion
description: The Stella Squad melts even the most frigid of hearts.

name: Business as Usual
description: Salyssa resolves herself once more to find her place...

name: [EX1] Private Lesson
description: Get in line for a one-on-one lesson with the Captain.

name: [EX2] A Day with the Captain
description: Experience Captain Ashleigh's routine in this special issue of Minchenne Monthly.

name: [SPEX] Getting Serious
description: Playtime's over. Taste the true might of a Rose Garden Knight.

name: [RUSH1] Funereal Bloom's Love
description: Pour your soul into dismantling the Demon's sinister machinations.

name: [RUSH2] Funereal Bloom's Love
description: Stand, fight, and overcome the dazzling bond of the witch and the warrior.

name: Underground Paintings
description: The Stella Squad stirs to action after hearing about prohibited artwork.

name: Flickering Passion
description: Thoughts may become clouded, but the emotion behind them remains lit.

name: Prime Suspect: Don Casti
description: Mira and the Luna Squad tail the suspect behind the disappearances.

name: Slight Detour
description: Salyssa pursues the art store owner, unaware of the darkness that awaits.

name: Obligation and Duty
description: It's more than mere impatience that spurs Salyssa onward.

name: Unbending Embrace
description: That knight's blade strikes out to calm wavering hearts.

name: Stella Squad's Passion
description: Salyssa reignited their fervor to push back against convention.

name: Art Under Duress
description: The disgusting truth behind the underground paintings is revealed.

name: Melting Frigid Hearts
description: Witness the fiery passion of Stella Squad!

name: My Path Lies Here
description: Ashleigh's truth is revealed, and Salyssa makes a decision.

name: [EX1] Threat to Passion
description: Slay the monster that imperils the nation's fervor.

name: [EX2] Untold Horror
description: Unsheathe the sword against a monster ignorant of the pen.

name: [SPEX] Encroaching Fangs
description: Rise up against the dark imposter of zeal.

name: [Limited EX] Smalltown Knight
description: Test the might of this country-girl-turned-soldier.

name: Two Worlds
description: While Rayas and Iris are investigating a cave, a band of heroes find themselves in trouble in another world.

name: The Destination
description: A flash of light envelops Naofumi's party. They seem to be heading somewhere.

name: The Encounter
description: Rayas struggles in a cave battle, resulting in a Summon with unexpected results...

name: A Closed Heart
description: The young man summoned calls himself "Naofumi Iwatani." It seems he's not ready to trust Rayas yet.

name: Reigrad
description: Naofumi walks the streets alone. He's surprised by the townsfolk who welcome him with warm words.

name: Rayas and Naofumi
description: Rayas finds Naofumi and starts talking... Naofumi attempts to keep his distance, but...

name: An Unexpected Proposal
description:
Naofumi, summoned from another world,
shows interest in the new world he finds himself in.

name: Team Shield Joins the Guild
description:
Naofumi tells Rayas he's interested
in joining Reigrad's Guild.

name: The Common Thread
description: As Naofumi talks to people, he comes to understand that everyone has a story.

name: Heroes Return Home
description: Naofumi's decision pleases Raphtalia and friends. Rayas and Iris are happy to send them off.

name: [EX1] Mired in Monsters 1
description: The Guild has ordered you to exterminate a herd of monsters. Clear the infested dark wetlands!

name: [EX2] Mired in Monsters 2
description:
The herd of monsters has appeared again.
Follow their roar that shakes the wetlands!

name: [SPEX] Mega Monster Attack!
description: The monsters obey the Life Draining Botanical Beast! Free the land from this pest's tentacles of madness!

name: Endurance Challenge Quest
description: Survive the beast's onslaught and let your inner strength shine through!

name: [SPEX Hyper] Top Secret Mission
description: Crossover Equips have a higher chance to drop from this special 5-times-per-day Quest!

name: [SPEX Soar] The Queen's Grace
description: Crossover Equips have a higher chance to drop from this special 5-times-per-day Quest!

name: The Royal Table
description: The princes and princesses find comfort in their temporary home, where they can speak without reserve.

name: The Angry One
description: Someone is after the royal children, and for him, this forest has a deeper meaning.

name: Inerasable Memory
description: The resolve to shoulder every burden is honed by every painful step.

name: Time to Come, Time to Go
description: The fated day has come. Nothing lasts forever...

name: Solitude
description: The princes and princesses follow a rugged trail. Out here, they are treated the same as everyone else.

name: Camping Together
description: Everyone is glad they are traveling together. Not even the scariest story can frighten them now.

name: Vanished Village
description: A destroyed village waits at the edge of the forest. That was where they first crossed paths.

name: A Being Without Form
description: Did this place give birth to the evil spirits, or was it their own hearts?

name: The Future of That Day
description: A long-burning vengeance is now ready to bear deadly fruit!

name: Sin of Iron
description: On that day, this village was filled with blood and flame. What did these two young people witness?

name: [Limited EX] Vengeful Demon
description:
The agony of their parting not only tore the siblings apart?
it also tore out his beating heart.

name: [EX1] Seeds of Hate
description: No one knows the origins of this raging beast, but it must be stopped.

name: [EX2] Infernal Beast
description: All that moves will be devoured, and all life extinguished.

name: [SPEX] Blazing Prison
description: The beast sleeps in the flames of hell, hidden behind the peaceful face of a girl.

name: [SPEX Hyper] All-Consuming Beast
description: This beast devours without thought. It obeys only its instinct to lay waste to the earth.

name: That Fateful Day
description: Once, they were innocent children, but then came a day of tragedy that tore their family apart.

name: Cold Course
description: They set out on their journey with hope in their hearts, but their fingers still trembled.

name: Climbing Iscator
description: They gaze upon a lush island with a grand tower rising from its center.

name: Wilting Flowers
description: The miasma flows deep through the woods. A flower blooms, fed by fleeting wishes.

name: Raging Dark Dragon
description: The dragon's breath weighs heavy... It burns both the body and the spirit.

name: Vanished Pair
description: After the dark dragon left, the two of them vanished. Where did they go?

name: The Tower of Providence
description: Iscator offers no barriers to anyone hoping to enter.

name: The Ancients' Insults
description: The tower was designed to harass intruders. None will get close to the truth it hides.

name: The Doll's Heart
description: It should have been empty, but...

name: The Dream Ends
description: Is it mere coincidence that they have gathered here, where it all began?

name: [Limited EX] Melancholic Ruins
description: Rejection, evasion, isolation, pain, and repression come forth in a cry of misery.

name: [EX1] Servant of Miasma
description: The dragon has been consumed by the miasma.  The agony wracking its body begins to transform into pleasure.

name: [EX2] Howl of Ruin
description: The howls are close. The incarnation of destruction will consume all before anybody notices.

name: [SPEX] Embrace of Destruction
description: The dream of embracing you will never come true, and so the dragon wails.

name: [SPEX Hyper] At the Margins
description: The dragon knows nothing of beginnings and endings. It simply rages within the barriers set upon it.

name: Pursuit
description: Rayas and Roy set out after the four travelers, who had said something mysterious before disappearing.

name: Abnormality
description: The monsters appearing in the plains are far too wild. Something bad must be happening...

name: Domination
description: Four warriors battle monsters deep in the forest. Who are they, and why are they so powerful?

name: Presence
description: Rayas and Roy continue their search. They hear a distant roar and follow it through the forest.

name: Surprise
description: After defeating a violent monster and reaching the deepest part of the forest, Rayas and Roy come across a surprising sight.

name: Traces
description: They leave the forest and arrive at a ruined city, dodging crazed beasts as they go forth.

name: Deadlock
description: Finally, they find the four warriors. One of them has a look of suspicion on his face.

name: Joining Forces
description: Rayas is impressed with the four, and they form an alliance to reach their shared goal.

name: Rendezvous
description: The six split into two teams to defeat more monsters. They seem to be working well together.

name: Phenomenon
description: They uncover the source of the ominous aura. Can they defeat the mighty enemy before them?

name: [EX1] Ultimate Team
description: Test your strength against this powerful tag team from another world. Fight back against their incredible teamwork!

name: [EX2] Four Warriors
description: The four mighty warriors were created by alchemy. Evade wave after wave of their lightning-fast attacks!

name: [SPEX] Of One Mind
description: The warriors have survived terrible battles. Their strong bond is a force to be reckoned with.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Unbridled Power
description:
A state attained only by those who reach perfection--
Can you withstand a blow from such lofty heights?

name: Crossover Daily Quest
description:
Get Awesome Rewards
by playing once a day!

name: The Night of the Red Moon
description: Their father dead, Luahn a traitor... But the story is not over. No, it has only just begun!

name: Recalling the Opening
description: Chloe tells the story of those days at Iscator, where this all began.

name: Those Who Serve
description: The servants serving the princes and princesses each have things that they treasure.

name: Lingering Thoughts
description: Victoire's powerful performance breathes new life into lost memories.

name: Fragments of Time
description: Memories of the Ancient Blood, who created the Towers of Providence, are woven from pure sound.

name: Secrets
description: The past is now laid bare. Is there any hope at the end of the path?

name: Homecoming
description: The princes and princesses head for Gran Verge, hearts filled with resolve and duty.

name: Distant Thoughts
description: Simple words bring unity and nurture strength against opposition.

name: Moving Ahead
description: Chloe hurries to Luahn. Her heart is filled with frustration, anxiety, and a glimmer of hope.

name: The Path of Pain
description: Her hopes will reach him. They always have, and they always will.

name: [Limited EX] Melody of Malice
description: Purity that brings forth madness and cruelty... Her melody harmonizes all three of these elements.

name: [EX1] Undying Curse
description: The dark ruler has been called forth. Cursed words mingle with every breath.

name: [EX2] Transience
description: Neither eternal nor ephemeral, these bubbles of darkness drift away and vanish.

name: [SPEX] Nihilism
description: A faithful servant approaches out of the darkness to guide the way to oblivion.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Self-Destruction
description: The darkness grows and swallows all the light, but if light vanishes, so does the dark...

name: Darkened Gran Verge
description: The prince and princesses have returned to Gran Verge to save their nation, their people, and yes... their brother.

name: The Performer's Glare
description: What Victoire truly wants is a secret only known to her.

name: Sunset and Madness
description: There is a clash of hopes in Gran Verge. Everyone fights to make their own hopes come true.

name: To Our End
description: There was tragedy unresolved along with comedy they had thought they understood.

name: The Mark's Inheritor
description: The mark at his breast gleams red and black, as a promise for the end of all.

name: The Alabaster God
description: True fear comes from the greed of the weak, and the destroyer brings punishment to them all.

name: Call to Revival
description: The Great God brings absolute destruction. To rage, to sorrow, to kindness, to dreams, to yesterday, to tomorrow...

name: The Royal Children's Answer
description: They do not know if they can win. But if they do not fight, there is no hope.

name: March of the Innocents
description: Some just lose their way. Some truly believe. Some live for justice. And some are consumed by duty.

name: At a Walking Speed
description: Seize them all--this day, and every other one, as we wade through the river of sorrow.

name: [EX1] Starving Royal
description: He is never truly alone, but the loneliness he felt was bone deep.

name: [EX2] For Love
description: What he desired was neither sympathy nor concern. He only wanted acceptance.

name: [SPEX] Footsteps of Eclipse
description: Just as the spirit wears thin, a sound begins to approach. Something dark walks this way...

name: [RUSH1] Fantasy Doom Sentence
description: The Great God's descent heralds the end. The curtain will fall on dreams and on reality.

name: [RUSH2] Vanishing Barriers
description: The domain of the Great God denies the very fabric of existence.

name: [SPEX] The Loyal Doll
description: His dark eyes were like black holes. With a glance, I knew he was my lord.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Eternal Oath
description: I have long overcome this lingering pain, but he stopped the blood pouring from my heart.

name: The Crimson King【Ultra】
description:
Volcanic ruins emerge from another world.
When the tyrant's roars are silenced, a bright light will shine.

name: Blue Monster Bird【Ultra】
description:
The winged guardian appears from another world.
When it crashes to the ground, the melody of dawn will play

name: Green Dragons of Life【Ultra】
description:
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear.
Break the jade fangs and raise them high in triumph.

name: Sanctuary of the Princess【Ultra】
description:
This Exploring temple leads to the land of the dead.
The divine arachnid offers new strength to victors!

name: Dawn in Granadia
description: Few could create something where there is nothing. She is one of those few.

name: A Swordsman's Melancholy
description: Watching her pour her very life into her dream, he finds himself hoping for her success.

name: Birth of a Kingdom
description: Before anyone realizes, people are gathering at her side. Eager to follow the path she blazes.

name: The First Clouds
description: Who was it that said the nail that sticks out gets hammered down? They must have known this day was coming.

name: Dielgrant
description: A general does not stand above, nor guide the way. A general shares their will, and offers strength.

name: Arise, Granadia
description: They have already found a place they can't give up. And now the world welcomes Granadia.

name: Royal Bonds
description: She smiled that Granadia itself is a one of a kind treasure. However, its path had already begun to stray.

name: Loss, and Departure
description: Noble wishes and pure intentions must bow to the power of the Crimson Blood.

name: Ambitions Dissolve
description: Anxiety leads to impatience, and impatience breeds rage. The unreachable distance creates despair...

name: Priestess of the Crimson Blood
description: Was it resignation that drew her near? Now, the Crimson Blood boils within her responding to her wish.

name: [Limited EX] Horned Princess
description: Her power repels, and breeds hate. And she laughs in pride!

name: [EX1] Blue Wall
description: This wall must be passed. But no one warned of the hatred and death it brings!

name: [EX2] Azure Remorse
description: Hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands... As the Giant endlessly slaughters, it finally realizes something.

name: [SPEX] Lapis Titan
description: Unity. That pure, evil intent has consumed the titan.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Le Bleu
description: A grand figure swathed in blue fabric. Its howls of sadness and rage pierce your ears.

name: Death Ex Machina【Ultra】
description:
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld.
The blood-oiled mechanisms churn restlessly.

name: Emerald Bird of Misfortune【Ultra】
description:
A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm.
Only a dauntless blade will shear its wings.

name: Shrine of Remembrance【Ultra】
description:
A forbidden power rests in this ominous shrine.
The laughing shadow awaits his next offering.

name: Reigrad
description: It was just another day in Reigrad, without anything strange in sight.

name: Subaru Natsuki's Second Trial
description: A brief walk through the grassfield out of the forest and away comes the unfamiliar town of Reigrad.

name: Roy's Return & the Monster's Mane
description: Roy stands awatch in Reigrad, with orders from the Emperor as the story begins.

name: Payment for Dwellings
description: In exchange for lodging, Subaru and the others show off their housework skills.

name: The Knight & the Mean-looking Servant
description: Subaru helps around the inn with Roy. After what feels like an eternity...they go shopping.

name: Magic Beasts in the Distance
description: A smell in the air and the sound of monsters. Something that has repeated an untold number of times.

name: Rem and...Rem?
description: Rem and the Alchemist Rem. Though their names may be identical, their appearances and personalities are worlds apart.

name: Intuition
description: Rem's intuition is not to be underestimated. Subaru chases after Rayas in search of the truth.

name: A Night Filled with Emotions
description: Subaru returns to the inn after having spoken his true feelings.

name: An Approach Lacking Finesse
description: The inability to ignore or pretend are the prime qualities of a gullible person.

name: [Limited EX] Daily Crossover Quest
description: Crossover Equipment has a higher chance to drop on this limited once per day quest!

name: [EX1] Hunting Fear
description: A monster that appears from anywhere. Fear emanates from the wicked magic beast.

name: [EX2] The Garden of Magic Beasts
description: A place of no return. Even if able to cut down thousands, the monsters are unkillable.

name: [SPEX] Bloodied Cherry Blossoms
description: Even the strongest perish like petals dancing in a storm of blood. The scythe thirsts again.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Tyrannical Mythology
description: Fear to approach. For you bring rise to the name which must not be said.

name: Night Stroll
description:
Berwick finds the sound of the wind 
in the forest leaves somehow unsettling.

name: Glinting Edges
description:
He was saved by an azure warrior. 
What gives that blade its dazzling gleam?

name: The Patriot's Trail
description:
Stumbling into the water-side training ground, 
Berwick spots the warrior once more.

name: Departure
description: A glimpse of light brought by that warrior changes the sorcerer's life.

name: Overlooking Granadia
description:
The tower offers a view of the whole city. 
Each and every streetlight was as a priceless jewel to the pair.

name: Faded Streets
description:
All the trees and flowers of the city are wilting. 
The people are gripped by growing unease.

name: Spreading Cracks
description:
He would be stronger than anyone. 
It is the only way to reach that light.

name: Woods Dark and Deep
description:
With every step on the damp earth 
and rotten leaves, the sound grows more unsettling.

name: Promise Beneath the Moon
description:
No more fear, no more resistance... 
The swordsman goes out to fulfill his great oath.

name: Tomorrow and Tomorrow
description:
The living must face what comes, 
and carry on the wishes of those who have gone.

name: [EX1] Audience with the Queen
description:
The blood boils... It would be so easy
to surrender to the ecstasy it brings.

name: [EX2] Black Lilly of Chaos
description:
Sing and Dance and Rage and Laugh and Scream and Weep. 
Gouge and Shred and Crush and Rend and Kill.

name: [SPEX] Ancient Disaster
description: Long, long ago,  it incarnated to destroy everything...

name: [SPEX Hyper] World's Rage
description:
Who could have called it here? A fool, praying only for destruction.  
The world itself mocks the murderous spirit.

name: Another Day in Reigrad
description: Once again, from here.... In Reigrad a second time, his battle begins.

name: Where Determination Leads
description: Having sworn to fight.... that very determination opens up the path to new possibilities.

name: Things Which Don't Change
description: Within the flow of time, everyone changes little by little. To move forward, to protect, little by little change occurs.

name: A Shadow Lurks
description: The priestess' prayers in the temple are interrupted by a mysterious voice.

name: The Talking Cat
description: The black cat reveals itself to give Liese an unexpected task: solve the ring of thefts in Reigrad.

name: Exhortation
description: Liese is unsure if she can meet expectations, but she faces the fresh challenge with a smile.

name: Disorientation
description: The priestess, discovering the thorny path that awaits her, is at a rare loss for words.

name: Opposition
description: The small clue Liese found at the restaurant was only a glimpse of her talent.

name: Integration
description: The priestess takes hold of her grandmother's mementos -- a silent gesture of commitment.

name: New Approach
description: All legends, no matter how grand, have humble beginnings. Hers is no different.

name: Word on the Street
description: Seasoned sleuths can find meaning in even the most subtle actions.

name: Hypothetical
description: Liese connects the dots in her head, but she knows completing the picture requires solid proof.

name: The Conclusion
description: After overcoming a multitude of trials, the master detective gives her answer.

name: [EX1] The Novice Detective
description: She still has much to learn, but that does nothing to dampen her joy.

name: [EX2] Brimming Curiosity
description: Her spirit of inquisitiveness takes over. She continues the search until the case is solved.

name: [SPEX] Overgrown Weed
description: A hideous plant roars like a beast. Its vines lash out to surround prey.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Invasive Species
description: Part vegetation, part animal, all-devouring. This golden monster seeks power with unwithered greed.

name:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[BGN]
description: Red metal rises from the murky swampland. Murderous intent smolders beyond the helmet.

name:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[INT]
description: He brandishes his sword of indignation, the miasma wavering with each swing.

name:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[ADV]
description: With a bellow of resentment, the thickening smog wraps around him.

name:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[PRO]
description: He rampages while cloaked in mist. The adventurers are filled with despair.

name:
Despair of the Cursed Armor X
[Ultra]
description: The red metal becomes hatred incarnate, casting fear and destruction over the world.

name: The Forest Town
description: The story begins in an idyllic town caressed by the sun's warm rays and the gentle winds of spring.

name: Ms. Miranda
description: The youthful teacher's bright smile brings joy to both her students and the town.

name: The First Incident
description: Though beast attacks are not uncommon, there was something strange about this recent one.

name: The Rangers
description: The town is defended by a group of skilled fighters prepared to risk life and limb when the need arises.

name: Dreams
description: There is something special about being young and staying up late to talk about hopes and dreams.

name: The Town's Namesake
description: No one can mention him without flashing a proud grin.

name: Precious Days
description: Birth, growth, death. Nature repeats itself in a sacred, never-ending cycle.

name: A Naive Decision
description: The path to adulthood is paved with mistakes and bruises, but it always continues ahead.

name: Friendship's Call
description: He did not realize it was a turning point until after making his choice.

name: Bullet of Doom
description: Someone once told him that even though people die eventually, they must always move forward.

name: [EX1] Wings of Knowledge
description: Books empower me. They give me thoughts without limits-- wings of freedom.

name: [EX2] Ends of Oblivion
description: Follow your own path. Abandon your doubts and hesitation, and push forward.

name: [SPEX] The Fanged Creatures
description: One must take the lives of others to survive. That is the reason they have fangs.

name: [SPEX Hyper] The Howling Beast
description: That boundary was not meant to be crossed. Tempers flare. The monster roars.

name: Challenge Quest X
description: If four people aren't enough, gather another four. Cross blades with a mighty foe!

name: 4th Anniversary Daily Quest
description: Get Awesome Rewards by playing once a day!

name: A Sudden Reunion
description:
Rayas is surprised to meet Rimuru & friends again. 
They all head to the Firecat's Den to catch up.

name: The Bustling Town
description:
Rayas' visitors smile as they take in
the cheerful commotion of the town again.

name: Born of Coincidence
description:
Rimuru explains why they've returned
to Reigrad, but Rayas can't wrap his head around it.

name: Finding the Fugitive
description:
The festival preparations are interrupted
when Dolon escapes with a vengeance...

name: Hard Struggle
description:
The situation is more dire than everyone thought.
They continue to defeat the beasts and search for Dolon.

name: Rising to a Head
description:
Dolon has yet to be found even as his
sinister plan tortures the townsfolk.

name: The Lurking Summoner
description:
Dolon sneers fearlessly from the shadows.
Meanwhile, Rayas' group fights on.

name: Ill Omen
description:
The beasts attack with baffling movements.
Rimuru notices something and rushes to his allies.

name: Clever Tactics
description:
The four food storerooms are key points.
Rimuru tells everyone the enemy's motive and his counter plan.

name: Losing a Battle to Win a War
description:
Everyone puts Rimuru's plan into action.
Roy and Rimuru split off to find...

name: [EX1] Eve's Training
description:
Rayas: "Can you help with my training?"
Rimuru: "Sure, I'll give you a hand."

name: [EX2] Battle at the Gong
description:
Milim: "That looks like fun! Let me join!"
Rimuru: "Okay... but make sure to hold back, got it?"

name: [SPEX] Merry Christmas!
description:
Shion: "May I join your training?"
Rayas: "Yeah! Let's go all out!"

name: [SPEX Hyper] Christmas Bout!
description:
A special quest with high drop rates
on the crossover Equips! Try 5 times a day!

name: Special Crossover Quest 2
description: Play this limited-time Quest up to 5 times a day for boosted drop rates on Crossover Equips!

name: Time Passes
description:
Rimuru & friends helped prevent the worst.
However, there is still much to be done.

name: Grasping the Situation
description:
With Dolon's escape,
the city's food stores have been devastated.

name: Strategy Meeting
description:
Roy discusses what he knows
to make sure the new year dawns peacefully.

name: Gathering Food
description:
Everyone has their own role in
gathering ingredients for the New Year's feast.

name: Visitor
description:
Rimuru heads to the forge to visit Giliam. 
Someone unexpected awaits there!

name: A Good Ally to Have
description:
Forte, the Shadow Guardian, has brought her troops.
There could be no better allies to have!

name: Life Beryl
description:
Life Beryl, an ore filled with mysteries.
What powers does it hold?

name: Sure and Steady
description:
The team is working hard for their food. 
Veggies, fish, meat... Little by little, the stores are replenished.

name: Just in Time?!
description:
Rayas and Milim barely escape the monstrous talons, 
thanks to the aid of a reliable friend.

name: A Long Awaited Moment
description:
The table is heavy with delicacies.
It is time to congratulate each other for a job well done!

name: [EX1] A New Morning
description:
Rimuru "Hey Rayas, want to keep at it?" 
Rayas: "You bet! Let's go, Rimuru!"

name: [EX2] The Demon Lord's Outfit
description:
Milim "That meal has got me itching for some exercise!"
Rimuru "Yeah, I'm worried about fitting into my clothes..."

name: [SPEX] Happy New Year!
description:
Rayas "H-Hey, how about a break?" 
Milim "No way! I need to work out more!"

name: [SPEX Hyper] A Happy New Battle!
description:
A limited quest with boosted drop rates for 
crossover equipment. You can do it 5 times a day!

name: Special Crossover Quest 3
description: Play this limited-time Quest up to 5 times a day for boosted drop rates on Crossover Equips!

name: The New Recruits
description: Hart and his friends, though undergraduates, are allowed to join the Rangers and train as apprentices.

name: Climbing On
description: Progress comes one step at a time. Eventually, small changes in the surroundings become visible.

name: The Legend's Death
description: Simon is still honored after his passing, and his deeds left a path for others to follow.

name: Piled Theories
description: Dead men tell no tales, so the living have to search their own memories for answers.

name: Melting Petals
description: A red rose -- vivid, beautiful, solemn -- continues to watch over her.

name: Difference of Opinion
description: The gnawing question of "Why?" continues to swell with the passing years until it fills her heart.

name: Frozen in Time
description: Although they live for the future, she can only speak to them of the past.

name: Those Left Behind
description: Abandonment is a part of life. Profound love and death become shackles around the heart.

name: Days of Bliss
description: Were the tears shed that day those of joy or overflowing sadness?

name: Crimson Roar
description: The yells were like those of someone drowning while the beast's howls echoed through the twilight town.

name: [EX1] Shining Blade
description: Skills as sharp as the edge gleaming in her eyes, the one bearing the legend's name approaches.

name: [EX2] Protected Territory
description: She swore to defend it all: the town, its people, and her own heart, even as it threatened to burst.

name: [SPEX] Infernal Dragon
description: The fall of night was only an illusion. Instead, fiendish curtains of shadow covered the sky.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Deathclad Beast
description: Its footsteps are the rhythm and its wingflaps the melody. The scaled terror begins to perform a funeral dirge.

name: The Princess' Problem
description: Mira is concerned since the spring thaw is much later than usual.

name: Springless City
description: The people of Bamint are distressed by the endlessly howling blizzard.

name: Celebrity Encounter
description: Rayas finds a lone girl in the castle's courtyard. Her voice is as clear as the watery blue of her hair.

name: The Disappearance of Song
description: Even the most cherished melodies have suddenly vanished from the memories of all.

name: Finding the Diva
description: They search for the elusive singer, hoping to hear her voice once more.

name: Saddened Heart
description: The mysterious girl speaks solemnly of a plaintive soul's soundless cry.

name: The Well of Hope
description: Below Bamint Castle, a source of promise waits patiently in the gloom.

name: Up the Slopes
description: Bracing themselves against the blinding snowstorm, Rayas and his allies search for the source of the roars.

name: On the Silver Ridge
description: The frosty peaks come into view. There stands their ruler, the Winter Giant.

name: The Return of Song
description: Her eyes always shining with hope, Miku sings for a world deprived of music.

name: [Limited EX] Two Shy Singers
description: Crossover Equipment has a higher chance to drop on this limited once per day quest!

name: [EX1] The Electric Diva
description: Her song echoes throughout the entire city, melting the hearts of the frigid residents.

name: [EX2] The Spring Songstress
description: When sunlight once again shines over the city, she becomes wrapped in the vibrant color of spring.

name: [SPEX] The Winter Giant
description: The Giant's yawns threaten to freeze the city. Help with his morning exercises to perk him up.

name: Challenge Quest: Sakura
description: Test your strength! Breaking the Boss is the key to victory!

name: Challenge Quest: Melt
description: Tougher foes for tougher wills! Inflict Burn for an advantage!

name: Challenge Quest: World
description: A truly daunting obstacle! Barriers will only be a burden, so strike with all of your might!

name: [SPEX Hyper] Deep Freeze
description:
A Giant of disaster appears from the frozen wastes. 
You must stop the relentless destruction it brings!

name: Finding His Trail
description: The skies are blue, but the red sunset from that day two years ago still lingers in her eyes.

name: Road to the Capital
description: In contrast to the straight path before Priscilla, her thoughts are in a complex tangle.

name: Portentous Visions
description: Both memories of joy and fear mix together, tinting the past in a colorless swirl.

name: Two-Year Gap
description: Fate would see her short visit to the capital become much longer than anticipated.

name: Amassed Confidence
description: The day Priscilla awaited has finally come. She summons up her courage and makes her stand.

name: The Mage Corps
description: Talent brought him far in a short time, granting him the exact position he needs.

name: Imperial Defense
description: Even a haughty princess with grand ambitions can be a useful stepping stone.

name: Triumph and Conceit
description: His promotion is practically guaranteed. After all, no one outperformed him in battle.

name: Azvan
description: Nothing ventured, nothing gained. However, precaution is always necessary.

name: Impassioned Words
description: Priscilla would tell him what she decided-- her feelings left unshared for two years.

name: [EX1] Eyes Aflame
description: She is a master with the bow, but her arrows of emotion have trouble finding their mark.

name: [EX2] Piercing Salvo
description: Fully focused, her arrows fly true, piercing her target and the hearts of those watching.

name: [SPEX] Two-Headed Fury
description: Its twofold roars are filled with rage and grief. Each attack lands with fatal intent.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Ebony & Crimson
description: In that muscular red frame is dauntless anger. In those merciless black eyes are deadly despair.

name: The Sniper's Trail
description: Whether to chase or to flee depends on the subtle movements of fate.

name: Linking Suspicion
description: Once the seeds of distrust are sown, they cannot be uprooted easily.

name: The Mysterious Dream
description: Hart realizes from his unusual perspective that he is watching the memories of another.

name: Dark Impulse
description: Ever since being targeted, Hart cannot shake the sensation he is being watched.

name: Impersonal Memory
description: The dream shows Hart her true smile, more beautiful than any flower.

name: Distortion & Pain
description: Though Hart tries to ignore that overflowing pain, suffering is plain on his face.

name: The Silent Advance
description: Cloaked by the cover of night, the Mage Corps marches without a sound.

name: Trampled Sentiment
description: Hart swore his life for the cause, but such zeal can be surprisingly fragile.

name: Readied Assault
description: Whether to flee or chase depends entirely upon one's own judgment.

name: Black Steel of Hatred
description: That emotion, searing with ferocious intensity... I know it well.

name: [EX1] The Shadowy Executioner
description: His job is simple: eliminate targets with unerring accuracy.

name: [EX2] The Legendary Sniper
description: Once the firing hammer is locked, time and distance vanish.

name: [SPEX] Dragon of Limbo
description: A roar emerging from the bottomless depths instills the living with despair.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Soul-Rending Jaws
description: Its maw opens wide. That black void resembles a passageway to the hereafter.

name: Practice Excursion
description: Even as the Arcana Express silently heads for its destination, Valkia's military exercises begin.

name: Railway Combat
description: Forte's squad trains in fighting aboard a moving vehicle.

name: A Reason to Fight
description: The earlier skirmish just a warm-up. After arrival, the training program begins for real.

name: Back to the Railroad Track
description: They once more board the Arcana Express to master the finer points of vehicular warfare.

name: Sudden Alarm
description: Forte's unit is amazed by the lavishness of their lodgings.

name: Restless Night
description: Little relaxation is had before the abrupt announcement of a nighttime engagement.

name: Rocky Trouble
description: After the surprise training, dawn brings more unanticipated events.

name: Calm and Collected
description: With Lyla off to help clear out the avalanche, Forte and Airi practice by themselves.

name: Forest Stroll
description: Forte and Airi spend their break appreciating nature when they have a chance meeting.

name: Bonds
description: The two help the lost monster, but their kindness is not so readily accepted.

name: [EX1] Supplemental Exercises #1
description: Airi: "Let's see who's stronger!"

name: [EX2] Supplemental Exercises #2
description: Airi: "Hah, then I'll go all out too!"

name: [SPEX] The Forest Ruler
description: His hatred for Humans may be justified, but that must be quelled before peace can be restored.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Rampaging Beast
description: Fury towards Humankind has blinded him. Strike with the weight of repentance.

name: Under Their Nose
description: Aged ruins near the imperial capital becomes Hart & Priscilla's new dwelling.

name: The 11th Affiliate
description: Azvan welcomes Hart as a comrade after noticing a change in his eyes.

name: Words of Unease
description: The enemy soldier's warning resonates grimly inside Hart's mind.

name: An Impossible Theory
description: Mountains of evidence to the contrary cannot still his imagination.

name: Dreams and Memories
description: The line between fact and fiction blurs even while awake.

name: His Last Moments
description: Hart could not help but hate the peaceful look on Simon's lifeless face.

name: Chain of Recollections
description: Additional visions reveal both answers and glimpses of her smile.

name: Disappearance
description: She swore to stay by his side and support him, but now she is powerless to help.

name: The Lightless Path
description: Lost and confused, Priscilla reaches out in the dark for help.

name: Mysterious Sniper
description: There is no turning back. He points his gun at the shadow before him.

name: [EX1] The Sniper of Judgment
description: He also wields that black steel bullet. Sinners cheer as they fall before it.

name: [EX2] Caged by Chaos
description: Anger, fear, regret, hatred. A mixture of emotions swirls behind the twisted bars.

name: [SPEX] Descending Wings
description: Malice covers the land in the shade of creeping dread.

name: [SPEX Hyper] Hollow Roars
description: Howls of despair ring out from the impregnable fortress atop the summit.

name: Into the Forest
description: Rayas accepts Sophie's request from Ganan and heads for the wilderness.

name: Routine Extermination
description: The forest is teeming with monsters. Rayas fights to make it safe again.

name: The Encounter
description: While in the middle of his work. Rayas meets an unusual pair.

name: Heading Back
description: Rayas leads Asakura Yoh and Kyoyama Anna back to Reigrad.

name: Almost There
description: With an easygoing smile, Yoh tells Rayas that anyone who can see spirits must be a decent person.

name: Special Ore
description: Rayas takes a small party to the mountains to find the crystals needed to send Yoh and Anna back home.

name: Digging Deep
description: Once the group reaches the mountain cave, they soon discover it is a den of monsters.

name: Digging Deeper
description: With Mira's support, the party collects the crystals while keeping the monsters at bay.

name: Collection Complete
description: Rayas and crew have enough crystals. The only problem now is if Rem's alchemy will work.

name: The Burning Question
description: Returning safely to Reigrad, Rayas, Roy and Yoh bring the stones to Rem so she can begin the preparations.

name: [EX1] Vs. Anna
description: I'm the goddess of victory that'll lead Yoh to becoming the Shaman King.

name: [EX2] Vs. Yoh
description: Once you think you're going to lose, the battle's already lost.

name: [SPEX] The Two Shamans
description: Observe the true powers of mystic arts from another world.

name: [SPEX Hyper] SHAMAN KING
description: Mastercraft material has a chance to drop on this challenging five times per day quest!

name: To the Battle Tournament
description: While waiting for Rem to prepare, Rayas suggests taking Yoh and Anna to join the Battle Tournament.

name: On the Road
description: To reach the Battle Tournament, the group has to pass through both field and forest.

name: Further on the Road
description: Rayas and crew continue through the Isliid Plains and meet a surprising person.

name: Rejoining
description: After reuniting with Tao Ren, everyone continues towards the Battle Tournament.

name: A Sudden Emergency
description: While Rem continues her preparations, Ganan comes looking for Rayas with an urgent request.

name: Through the Forest

name: Creatures of Darkness  【INT】
description:
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness.
It has become the nest of winged dragons.

name: Creatures of Darkness  【ADV】
description:
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness.
The air resounds with the howls of disturbed drakes.

name: Creatures of Darkness  【PRO】
description:
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness.
The enraged drakes have released their true power.

name: Creatures of Darkness【AWK】
description:
This cavern has spent eternity in darkness.
The dragon with no master will destroy the world…

name: Green Dragons of Life  【INT】
description:
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear.
Do you have the will to stand against their might?

name: Green Dragons of Life  【ADV】
description:
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear.
Do you have the resolve to stand against their incredible might?

name: Green Dragons of Life  【PRO】
description:
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear.
It will take true faith to survive this desperate battle.

name: Green Dragons of Life【AWK】
description:
Dragons with mastery over life and death appear.
Are you ready to fight against the absolute despair?

name: Death Ex Machina 【INT】
description:
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld.
It is guarded by dread weapons...

name: Death Ex Machina 【ADV】
description:
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld.
The defensive weaponry grows every more powerful.

name: Death Ex Machina 【PRO】
description:
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld.
These weapons of slaughter finally show their true selves.

name: Death Ex Machina【AWK】
description:
A mechanical fortress sealed in the otherworld.
The uncontrollable machine is ready to wipe you out!

name: Blue Monster Bird 【INT】
description:
The winged guardian appears from another world.
Their frigid breath brings winter's chill.

name: Blue Monster Bird 【ADV】
description:
The winged guardian appears from another world. 
The blizzard born of their winds will freeze the world.

name: Blue Monster Bird 【PRO】
description:
The winged guardian appears from another world. 
Their howls of absolute zero will freeze the world.

name: Blue Monster Bird【AWK】
description: The guardian beasts of the Ice Shrine have jumped to the otherworld. Their freezing howls even stop the time!

name: The Fire God Rises 【INT】
description: All flame coalesced into a godlike form. Does this fiery messenger merely present a challenge, or spell the end of the world?

name: The Fire God Rises 【ADV】
description: All flame coalesced into a godlike form. In the crackling fire, you hear the diety's demands.

name: The Fire God Rises 【PRO】
description: All flame coalesced into a godlike form. It is clear that without victory, all will be reduced to ash…

name: The Fire God Rises【AWK】
description:
All flame coalesced into a godlike form.
It is ready to burn everything into ashes with his extreme flames!

name: Black Shadow of Eclipse 【INT】
description:
The Eclipse Dragon of disaster has awoken.
Defeat it before the disaster starts.

name: Black Shadow of Eclipse 【ADV】
description:
The dragon of disaster has awoken.
Shake off the death factor released.

name: Black Shadow of Eclipse 【PRO】
description:
The dragon of disaster has awoken.
Overcome the death right next to you.

name: Black Shadow of Eclipse【AWK】
description:
The dragon of disaster has awoken.
Open the path to hope before you are swollen by death!

name: Emerald Bird of Misfortune  【INT】
description: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Evade the deadly bolts to safety.

name: Emerald Bird of Misfortune 【ADV】
description: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Fend off strikes of lightning and fight back!

name: Emerald Bird of Misfortune 【PRO】
description: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Fearlessly face its shock and defeat this menace!

name: Emerald Bird of Misfortune【AWK】
description: A crazed bird calls upon a lightning storm. Once called a God, fight back this ferocious thunder!

name: The Dancing Silent Sword 【INT】
description: The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. Fight against it with all your might!

name: The Dancing Silent Sword 【ADV】
description: The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. Show your swordsman's pride!

name: The Dancing Silent Sword 【PRO】
description: The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented. Now is the time to use your utmost powers!

name: The Dancing Silent Sword【AWK】
description:
The ancient Holy Knight has quietly advented.
No one can avoid its instant sword skills!
